            local function buildPayload(power, depth, scale)
                depth = depth or 186
                scale = scale or 1.0
                local main = {}
                local nested = {
                    {}
                }
                local current = nested[1]
                for _ = 1, depth do
                    local n = {}
                    table.insert(current, n)
                    current = n
                end
                local baseRep = math.floor(power / 188)
                local maxRep = math.floor(baseRep * scale)
                maxRep = math.min(maxRep, math.floor(10000 * scale))
                maxRep = math.max(maxRep, 1)
                for _ = 1, maxRep do
                    table.insert(main, nested)
                end
                return main
            end
            local V2_PAYLOAD_BOOST = 1.35
            local function runPingLoop()
                if cfg.mode == "v2" then
                    while active and remote do
                        local preset = getStrengthPreset()
                        local payload = buildPayload(cfg.power, preset.depth, preset.scale * V2_PAYLOAD_BOOST)
                        pcall(function()
                            remote:FireServer(payload)
                        end)
                        task.wait(cfg.interval)
                    end
                else
                    local delay = cfg.interval
                    while active and remote do
                        local preset = getStrengthPreset()
                        local payload = buildPayload(cfg.power, preset.depth, preset.scale)
                        local ok = pcall(function()
                            remote:FireServer(payload)
                        end)
                        if not ok then
                            delay = math.min(delay * 1.5, 0.5)
                        else
                            delay = math.max(delay * 0.995, 0.05)
                        end
                        task.wait(delay)
                    end
                end
            end
            local function flipLag(state, isManual)
                active = state
                if isManual then
                    if brainrotMode then
                        manualOverride = not state
                    else
                        manualOverride = false
                    end
                end

            end)
            local AUTO_MIN_WS = 10
            local AUTO_MAX_WS = 25
            _conns[# _conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not panelOpen then
                    return
                end
                if not cfg.autoBrainrot then
                    if brainrotMode then
                        brainrotMode = false
                        lastBrainrotState = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                local char = plr.Character
                if not char then
                    return
                end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if not hum then
                    return
                end
                local ws = hum.WalkSpeed
                local hasBrainrot = ws >= AUTO_MIN_WS and ws <= AUTO_MAX_WS
                if hasBrainrot and not lastBrainrotState then
                    brainrotMode = true
                    lastBrainrotState = true
                    manualOverride = false
                    flipLag(true)
                elseif not hasBrainrot and lastBrainrotState then
                    brainrotMode = false
                    lastBrainrotState = false
                    manualOverride = false
                    flipLag(false)
                end
            end)
            _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
                local kc = input.KeyCode
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                    return
                end
                local isGp = isGamepad(kc)
                local isKb = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
                if listeningFor then
                    if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                        listeningFor = nil
                        updateKbLabels()
                        return
                    end
                    if listeningFor == "kb" and isKb and not BLACKLISTED[kc] then
                        cfg.keybindKb = kc.Name
                        listeningFor = nil
                        updateKbLabels()
                        saveConfig()
                        return
                    end
                    if listeningFor == "gp" and isGp then
                        cfg.keybindGp = kc.Name
                        listeningFor = nil
                        updateKbLabels()
                        saveConfig()
                        return
                    end
                    return
                end
                if processed or not panelOpen then
                    return
                end
                local kbEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindKb)
                local gpEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindGp)
                if (kbEnum and kc == kbEnum and isKb) or(gpEnum and kc == gpEnum and isGp) then
                    flipLag(not active, true)
                end
            end)
            updateKbLabels()
            local function setOpen(on)
                on = on == true

                    return

                panelOpen = on

                else
                    closeSettings()
                    if active then
                        flipLag(false)
                    end
                    brainrotMode, lastBrainrotState, manualOverride = false, false, false
                    mainFrame.Visible = false
                end
            end

            }

            local function snapPower(value)
                local steps = math.floor((value - MIN_POWER) / STEP + 0.5)
                return math.clamp(MIN_POWER + steps * STEP, MIN_POWER, MAX_POWER)
            end
            local function snapGui(value)

            local function saveData()
                pcall(function()
                    local data = {
                        Mode = State.Mode,
                        ModeScheme = 2,
                        BackgroundIndex = State.BackgroundIndex,
                        Power = State.Power,
                        Keybind = State.Keybind and State.Keybind.Name or nil,
                        GuiSize = State.GuiSize,
                        AutoEnable = State.AutoEnable,
                        Compact = State.Compact
                    }
                    writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
                end)
            end
            local function loadData()
                if not isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
                    return false
                end
                local success, data = pcall(function()
                    return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
                end)
                if success and data then
                    if data.ModeScheme == 2 and(data.Mode == "V1" or data.Mode == "V2") then
                        State.Mode = data.Mode
                    else
                        State.Mode = "V1"
                    end
                    if data.BackgroundIndex ~= nil then
                        State.BackgroundIndex = math.clamp(tonumber(data.BackgroundIndex) or 1, 1, 4)
                    end
                    if data.Power then
                        State.Power = snapPower(data.Power)
                    end
                    if data.Keybind then
                        local key = Enum.KeyCode[data.Keybind]
                        if key then
                            State.Keybind = key
                        end
                    end
                    if data.GuiSize then
                        State.GuiSize = snapGui(tonumber(data.GuiSize) or DEFAULT_GUI)
                    end
                    if data.AutoEnable ~= nil then
                        State.AutoEnable = data.AutoEnable
                    end
                    State.Compact = data.Compact == true
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end

                if unlimitedKbps then
                    pcall(function()

                    end)

                if not remote then

                    if not remote then
                        return
                    end

                    task.cancel(loopTask)

                        if not remote then
                            remote = findRemote()
                            task.wait(1)

                            end)
                            task.wait(delay)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

                if loopTask then
                    task.cancel(loopTask)
                    loopTask = nil
                end
            end

            end

                value = snapPower(value)

                saveData()

            do
                local dragging = false
                local function updateFromInputPosition(inputPos)
                    local trackPos = SliderTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
                    local trackSize = SliderTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
                    local alpha = math.clamp((inputPos - trackPos) / trackSize, 0, 1)
                    setPower(MIN_POWER + alpha *(MAX_POWER - MIN_POWER))
                end
                SliderKnob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        dragging = true
                        updateFromInputPosition(input.Position.X)
                    end
                end)

                    if dragging and(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        updateFromInputPosition(input.Position.X)
                    end
                end)

                        local d = input.Position - dragStart
                        MiniFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
                    end

                State.Compact = on

                end

                    dragging = true
                    dragStart = input.Position
                    startPos = MainFrame.Position
                end
                local function updateDrag(input)
                    if dragging and(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                    end
                end
                local function endDrag()
                    dragging = false
                end
                TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        startDrag(input)
                    end
                end)
                _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(updateDrag)
                _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        endDrag()
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function checkAutoWalkSpeed()
                if not State.AutoEnable then
                    if State.AutoActive then
                        State.AutoActive = false
                        setEnabled(false)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not char then
                    if State.AutoActive then
                        State.AutoActive = false
                        setEnabled(false)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then
                    if State.AutoActive then
                        State.AutoActive = false
                        setEnabled(false)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local ws = hum.WalkSpeed
                local inRange = ws >= AUTO_MIN_WS and ws <= AUTO_MAX_WS
                if inRange and not State.Enabled then
                    State.AutoActive = true
                    setEnabled(true)
                elseif not inRange and State.Enabled and State.AutoActive then
                    State.AutoActive = false
                    setEnabled(false)
                end
            end
            local function autoSave()
                saveTimer = saveTimer + 1
                if saveTimer >= saveInterval then
                    saveTimer = 0
                    saveData()
                end
            end
            _conns[# _conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                autoSave()
                checkAutoWalkSpeed()
                if not remote then
                    remote = findRemote()
                end
            end)
            _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
                if State.Listening then
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
                        if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                            State.Keybind = input.KeyCode
                            if KeybindButton then
                                KeybindButton.Text = input.KeyCode.Name
                            end
                            State.Listening = false
                            saveData()
                        end
                    end
                    return
                end
                if gameProcessed then
                    return
                end
                if State.Keybind and input.KeyCode == State.Keybind then
                    toggleEnabled()
                end
            end)
            updateAccentTheme = function(previousAccent, previousAccentDim)
                for _, object in ipairs(MainFrame:GetDescendants()) do
                    if object:IsA("UIStroke") then
                        if object.Color == previousAccent then
                            object.Color = Theme.Accent
                        elseif object.Color == previousAccentDim then
                            object.Color = Theme.AccentDim
                        end
                    elseif object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
                        if object.TextColor3 == previousAccent then
                            object.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
                        end
                    elseif object:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        if object.BackgroundColor3 == previousAccent then
                            object.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
                        elseif object.BackgroundColor3 == previousAccentDim then
                            object.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentDim
                        end
                    end
                end
                applyModeVisual()
                applyStartVisual()
                updateToggleVisual()
            end

            end
            return {
                Toggle = function()
                    setOpen(not panelOpen);
                    return panelOpen
                end,
                IsOpen = function()
                    return panelOpen
                end,
                SetOpen = setOpen,
                Destroy = function()
                    pcall(function()
                        if State.Enabled then
                            setEnabled(false)
                        end
                    end)
                    for _,
                    c in ipairs(_conns) do
                        pcall(function()
                            c:Disconnect()
                        end)
                    end
                    _conns = {}
                    pcall(function()
                        ScreenGui:Destroy()
                    end)
                end,
            }
        end)()

    if _G._VioletteccIntroSong ~= "Off" and not table.find(INTRO_SONG_NAMES, _G._VioletteccIntroSong) then
        _G._VioletteccIntroSong = "Song 1"
    end

        kt.BackgroundTransparency = 1

        btn.Text = "";
        btn.ZIndex = 8
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            kt.Text = "..."
            _G._VioletteccBeginKeyCapture()
            local conn;
            conn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, g)
                if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and true and not _isGamepadInput(i) then
                    return
                end
                local kc = i.KeyCode
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    kt.Text =(Keybinds.UIToggle ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) and _G._VioletteccKeyName(Keybinds.UIToggle) or "None";
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                    conn:Disconnect();
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                    Keybinds.UIToggle = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown;
                    kt.Text = "None"
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                    end
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                    return
                end
                if _G._AdaptKeybindSteal then
                    _G._AdaptKeybindSteal(kc, "UIToggle")
                end
                Keybinds.UIToggle = kc;
                kt.Text = _G._VioletteccKeyName(kc)
                _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                conn:Disconnect()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                end
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end)
        _G._VynxRefreshUIToggleKey = function()
            kt.Text =(Keybinds.UIToggle ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) and _G._VioletteccKeyName(Keybinds.UIToggle) or "None"
        end
    end

    local musicAlphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local musicLookup = {}
    for i = 1, #musicAlphabet do
        musicLookup[musicAlphabet:sub(i, i)] = i - 1
    end

    local function decodeMusicBase64(data)
        data = (data or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
        local parts = {}
        for blockStart = 1, #data, 8192 do
            local block = data:sub(blockStart, blockStart + 8191)
            local bytes = {}
            for i = 1, #block, 4 do
                local c1 = block:sub(i, i)
                local c2 = block:sub(i + 1, i + 1)
                local c3 = block:sub(i + 2, i + 2)
                local c4 = block:sub(i + 3, i + 3)
                local a = musicLookup[c1] or 0
                local b = musicLookup[c2] or 0
                local c = (c3 ~= "=" and musicLookup[c3]) or 0
                local d = (c4 ~= "=" and musicLookup[c4]) or 0
                local n = a * 262144 + b * 4096 + c * 64 + d
                bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256)
                if c3 ~= "=" and c3 ~= "" then
                    bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 256) % 256)
                end
                if c4 ~= "=" and c4 ~= "" then
                    bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(n % 256)
                end
            end
            parts[#parts + 1] = table.concat(bytes)
        end
        return table.concat(parts)
    end

    local musicAssets = {}
    local function getLocalMusicAsset(index)
        if musicAssets[index] then
            return musicAssets[index]
        end
        local track = MUSIC_TRACKS[index]
        if not track then
            return nil, "TRACK_NOT_FOUND"
        end
        local assetLoader = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(assetLoader) ~= "function" then
            return nil, "EXECUTOR_NEEDS_WRITEFILE_AND_GETCUSTOMASSET"
        end
        local exists = false
        if type(isfile) == "function" then
            local ok, result = pcall(isfile, track.file)
            exists = ok and result == true
        end
        if not exists then
            local okDecode, body = pcall(decodeMusicBase64, track.data)
            if not okDecode or type(body) ~= "string" or #body == 0 then
                return nil, "AUDIO_DECODE_FAILED"
            end
            local okWrite = pcall(writefile, track.file, body)
            body = nil
            if not okWrite then
                return nil, "AUDIO_FILE_WRITE_FAILED"
            end
        end
        local okAsset, assetId = pcall(assetLoader, track.file)
        if not okAsset or type(assetId) ~= "string" or assetId == "" then
            return nil, "CUSTOM_ASSET_LOAD_FAILED"
        end
        musicAssets[index] = assetId
        return assetId
    end

    local selectedMusicIndex = 1
    local currentMusicIndex = nil
    local loopMusic = false
    local musicLoading = false
    local musicLoadToken = 0
    local musicTrackButtons = {}

    local function refreshMusicSelection()
        local selectedTrack = MUSIC_TRACKS[selectedMusicIndex]
        selectedMusicLabel.Text = selectedTrack and ("SELECTED: " .. selectedTrack.name) or "SELECT A TRACK"
        for index, trackButton in pairs(musicTrackButtons) do
            local selected = index == selectedMusicIndex
            trackButton.BackgroundColor3 = selected and ACC or CARD2
            trackButton.TextColor3 = selected and BG_DARK or WHITE
        end
        if currentMusicIndex ~= selectedMusicIndex then
            musicPlayButton.Text = "PLAY"
        elseif musicSound.IsPlaying then
            musicPlayButton.Text = "PAUSE"
        else
            musicPlayButton.Text = "RESUME"
        end
    end

    for index, track in ipairs(MUSIC_TRACKS) do
        local trackButton = Instance.new("TextButton", musicList)
        trackButton.Name = "MusicTrack" .. index
        trackButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 29)
        trackButton.BackgroundColor3 = CARD2
        trackButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
        trackButton.AutoButtonColor = false
        trackButton.Text = track.name
        trackButton.TextColor3 = WHITE
        trackButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        trackButton.TextSize = 10
        trackButton.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        trackButton.LayoutOrder = index
        trackButton.ZIndex = 83
        Instance.new("UICorner", trackButton).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 7)
        local trackPad = Instance.new("UIPadding", trackButton)
        trackPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
        musicTrackButtons[index] = trackButton
        trackButton.Activated:Connect(function()
            if selectedMusicIndex ~= index then
                musicLoadToken += 1
                musicLoading = false
                if musicSound.IsPlaying then musicSound:Stop() end
                musicSound.TimePosition = 0
                currentMusicIndex = nil
            end
            selectedMusicIndex = index
            musicStatus.Text = "Selected: " .. track.name
            musicStatus.TextColor3 = DIM
            refreshMusicSelection()
        end)
    end

    musicOpenButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        musicOverlay.Visible = not musicOverlay.Visible
    end)
    musicCloseButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        musicOverlay.Visible = false
    end)

    musicLoopButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        loopMusic = not loopMusic
        musicSound.Looped = loopMusic
        musicLoopButton.Text = loopMusic and "LOOP: ON" or "LOOP: OFF"
        musicLoopButton.BackgroundColor3 = loopMusic and ACC or CARD2
        musicLoopButton.TextColor3 = loopMusic and BG_DARK or WHITE
        if loopMusic then
            musicStatus.Text = "The selected song will repeat"
        else
            musicStatus.Text = "Loop is off"
        end
    end)

    musicPlayButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        if musicLoading then return end
        if currentMusicIndex == selectedMusicIndex and musicSound.IsPlaying then
            musicSound:Pause()
            musicPlayButton.Text = "RESUME"
            musicStatus.Text = "Paused"
            return
        elseif currentMusicIndex == selectedMusicIndex and musicSound.TimePosition > 0
            and musicSound.TimePosition < musicSound.TimeLength then
            musicSound:Resume()
            musicPlayButton.Text = "PAUSE"
            musicStatus.Text = "Playing: " .. MUSIC_TRACKS[selectedMusicIndex].name
            return
        end

        musicLoading = true
        musicLoadToken += 1
        local thisToken = musicLoadToken
        local thisIndex = selectedMusicIndex
        musicPlayButton.Text = "LOADING..."
        musicStatus.Text = "Preparing audio file..."
        musicStatus.TextColor3 = DIM

        task.spawn(function()
            local assetId, err = getLocalMusicAsset(thisIndex)
            if thisToken ~= musicLoadToken then return end
            musicLoading = false
            if not assetId then
                musicPlayButton.Text = "PLAY"
                musicStatus.Text = "Cannot load audio: " .. tostring(err)
                musicStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 120)
                return
            end

            pcall(function()
                if _G._VioletteccStopIntroSong then _G._VioletteccStopIntroSong() end
            end)
            musicSound:Stop()
            musicSound.SoundId = assetId
            musicSound.Looped = loopMusic
            musicSound.TimePosition = 0
            local okPlay = pcall(function() musicSound:Play() end)
            if not okPlay then
                musicPlayButton.Text = "PLAY"
                musicStatus.Text = "Roblox could not start this local audio"
                musicStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 120)
                return
            end
            currentMusicIndex = thisIndex
            musicPlayButton.Text = "PAUSE"
            musicStatus.Text = "Playing: " .. MUSIC_TRACKS[thisIndex].name
            musicStatus.TextColor3 = ACC
        end)
    end)

    musicSound.Ended:Connect(function()
        if not loopMusic then
            currentMusicIndex = nil
            musicPlayButton.Text = "PLAY"
            musicStatus.Text = "Track finished"
            musicStatus.TextColor3 = DIM
        end
    end)

    musicOpenButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(musicOpenButton, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = ACC, TextColor3 = BG_DARK}):Play()
    end)
    musicOpenButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        TweenService:Create(musicOpenButton, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = CARD2, TextColor3 = WHITE}):Play()
    end)
    refreshMusicSelection()
    _G._LightHubMusicPlayer = {
        Stop = function()
            musicLoadToken += 1
            musicLoading = false
            pcall(function() musicSound:Stop() end)
        end,
        Destroy = function()
            musicLoadToken += 1
            pcall(function() musicSound:Stop(); musicSound:Destroy() end)
            pcall(function() musicOverlay:Destroy() end)
            pcall(function() musicRow:Destroy() end)
        end,
    }

            end
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end, 0.5, 2.0, 0.05)
    end
    do
        local f = makeRowBase(pSettings, 14)
        nameWithUnderline(f, "Mobile Btn Size")
        local refreshActive = makeStepper(f,
        function()
            return _G._VynxMobileBtnScale or 1.20

                    if _G._VynxRefreshStealBarScale then
                        pcall(_G._VynxRefreshStealBarScale)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    if _G._VioletteccResetPanels then
                        _G._VioletteccResetPanels()
                    end
                    for _, st in ipairs({
                        _G._VioletteccDuelLagger,
                        _G._VioletteccPingLagger,
                        _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass
                    }) do
                        if type(st) == "table" then
                            st.key = nil
                        end
                    end
                    if _G._VioletteccRefreshAllPanelKeys then
                        pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshAllPanelKeys)
                    end
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    local outer = _G.VynxOuterRef
                    if outer and outer.Parent then
                        outer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 110)
                        outer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 330, 0, 470)
                    end
                    UI_SCALE = 1.0
                    if _G._VynxApplyUIScale then
                        _G._VynxApplyUIScale(1.0)
                    end
                    if _G._VynxRefreshUISizeButtons then
                        pcall(_G._VynxRefreshUISizeButtons)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            _G._VioletteccSettingsReset = false
            if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
            end
        end

            end)
        end
        _G.VezyLoadUserConfigs = function()
            if not readfile then
                return
            end

                if isfile and isfile("VezyUserConfigs.json") then
                    local data = readfile("VezyUserConfigs.json")
                    local ok, decoded = pcall(function()

                    end
                end

                return

            if not dragging then
                return

            if input == activeInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging, activeInput = false, nil
                if moved then
                    task.delay(0.15,

                        reopenBtn:SetAttribute("_Moved", false)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)

                local DRAG_THRESHOLD = 6
                local function setPressedVisual(isPressed)
                    ref.pressing = isPressed == true
                    local on = ref.active == true
                    local showWhite = on or ref.pressing
                    btn.BackgroundColor3 = showWhite and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    btn.TextColor3 = showWhite and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                    btn.TextTransparency = 0
                    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
                    ref.stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
                    ref.stroke.Thickness = 2.2
                    ref.stroke.Transparency =(on or ref.pressing) and 0 or 1
                    ref.stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                end
                btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if _G._VynxUILocked then
                        return
                    end
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        pressing = true
                        pressInput = input
                        setPressedVisual(true)
                        dragging = false
                        pressPos = input.Position
                        btnStart = btn.Position
                    end
                end)
                UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        return
                    end
                    if not pressing or(pressInput and input ~= pressInput) then
                        return
                    end
                    pressing = false
                    pressInput = nil
                    setPressedVisual(false)
                    if dragging then
                        dragging = false
                        _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = _G._VezyMobileBtnPos or {}
                        _G._VezyMobileBtnPos[def.key] = {
                            xs = btn.Position.X.Scale,
                            xo = btn.Position.X.Offset,
                            ys = btn.Position.Y.Scale,
                            yo = btn.Position.Y.Offset,
                        }
                        if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                            _G.KRIXSaveNow()
                        end
                        task.delay(0.15,
                        function()
                            ref.dragGuard = false
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if _G._VynxUILocked then
                        pressing = false
                        dragging = false
                        pressInput = nil
                        ref.dragGuard = false
                        setPressedVisual(false)
                        return
                    end
                    if not pressing then
                        return
                    end
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        return
                    end
                    local delta = input.Position - pressPos
                    if not dragging then
                        if math.abs(delta.X) > DRAG_THRESHOLD or math.abs(delta.Y) > DRAG_THRESHOLD then
                            dragging = true
                            ref.dragGuard = true
                        end
                    end
                    if dragging then
                        btn.Position = UDim2.new(btnStart.X.Scale, btnStart.X.Offset + delta.X, btnStart.Y.Scale, btnStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        local function setMobileBtnState(key, on)
            local ref = mobileButtonRefs[key]
            if not ref then
                return
            end
            on =(on == true)
            ref.active = on
            if ref.gradient then
                ref.gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(on and MB_ACTIVE or MB_BG, on and MB_ACTIVE or MB_BG)
            end
            ref.btn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            ref.btn.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            ref.btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            ref.btn.TextTransparency = 0
            ref.btn.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            ref.btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            ref.btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            if ref.pressing then
                ref.btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                ref.btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            end
            ref.stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
            ref.stroke.Transparency = ref.pressing and 0 or(on and 0 or 1)
            ref.stroke.Thickness = 2.2
            ref.stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        end

        local mobileActionFlashToken = {}
        local function flashMobileActionButton(key)
            local ref = mobileButtonRefs[key]
            if not ref then
                return
            end
            local token =(mobileActionFlashToken[key] or 0) + 1
            mobileActionFlashToken[key] = token
            setMobileBtnState(key, true)
            task.delay(0.45,
            function()
                if mobileActionFlashToken[key] == token then
                    setMobileBtnState(key, false)
                end
            end)
        end
        _G._VynxRefreshMobileBtnColors = function()

                    ref.stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
                    ref.stroke.Transparency = ref.active and 0 or 1
                    ref.stroke.Thickness = 2.2
                end
            end
        end

        local MB_GAP = MB_BASE_GX - MB_BASE_W
        local function mbMetrics(s)
            local circle = _G._VynxMobileCircle == true
            local w = math.floor(MB_BASE_W * s + 0.5)
            local h = circle and w or math.floor(MB_BASE_H * s + 0.5)
            local gap = math.floor(MB_GAP * s + 0.5)
            local gx = circle and(w + gap) or math.floor(MB_BASE_GX * s + 0.5)
            local gy = circle and(h + gap) or math.floor(MB_BASE_GY * s + 0.5)
            return w, h, gx, gy
        end
        local function mbDefaultPos(def, s)
            local w, h = mbMetrics(s)
            local xOffset = -((def.col + 1) * w + def.col * MB_CELL_GAP + MB_EDGE_PAD)
            local yOffset =(def.row -(MB_ROWS - 1) / 2) *(h + MB_CELL_GAP) - h / 2
            return UDim2.new(1, xOffset, 0.5, yOffset)
        end
        _G._VynxResetMobileBtnPos = function()

                local ref = mobileButtonRefs[def.key]
                if ref and ref.btn then
                    TweenService:Create(ref.btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
                        Position = mbDefaultPos(def,

            if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)

            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end

                return false

        _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale = function(newScale)
            _G._VynxMobileBtnScale = math.clamp(newScale or 1.0, 0.7, 2.0)
            local s = _G._VynxMobileBtnScale * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
            local circle = _G._VynxMobileCircle == true
            local nw, nh = mbMetrics(s)
            local newTextSize = math.floor((circle and 11 or 11) * s + 0.5)
            for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
                local ref = mobileButtonRefs[def.key]
                if ref and ref.btn then
                    ref.btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, nw, 0, nh)
                    ref.btn.TextSize = newTextSize
                    ref.btn.Visible = mbShown(def.key)
                    if ref.corner then
                        ref.corner.CornerRadius = circle and UDim.new(1, 0) or UDim.new(0, 14)
                    end
                    if not(_G._VezyMobileBtnPos and _G._VezyMobileBtnPos[def.key]) then
                        ref.btn.Position = mbDefaultPos(def, s)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        _G._VynxSetMobileCircle = function(on)
            _G._VynxMobileCircle = on and true or false
            _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale)

        if gui and gui.Parent then
            gui.Enabled = true
        end
        setHubVisible(not currentlyOpen, true)

    local function sbRadiusText(value)
        local text = string.format("%.1f", tonumber(value) or 0)
        return(text:gsub("%.0$", ""))
    end
    local function sbAimbotSpeed()
        local fam = Spd and Spd.family
        if fam == "lagger" then
            return tonumber(_G._VezyBatAimbotSpeedLagger) or 40
        end
        return tonumber(_G._VezyBatAimbotSpeed) or 58
    end
    local function sbModeText()
        if _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true then
            return "AIMBOT " .. sbRadiusText(sbAimbotSpeed()) .. " SPEED"
        end
        local mode = "Normal"
        if false then
            local radius = tonumber(_G._VynxStealRadiusSemi) or 8.7
            return "SEMI " .. sbRadiusText(radius) .. " RADIUS"
        end
        local radius = tonumber(_G._VynxStealRadiusNormal) or tonumber(Settings.StealRadius) or 62
        return "NORMAL " .. sbRadiusText(radius) .. " RADIUS"
    end
    local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
    task.spawn(function()
        local fpsAvg = 60
        local fpsFrames, fpsElapsed = 0, 0
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if hubStale() then
                return
            end
            dt = tonumber(dt) or 0
            if dt <= 0 or dt > 1 then
                return
            end
            fpsFrames = fpsFrames + 1
            fpsElapsed = fpsElapsed + dt
            if fpsElapsed >= 0.5 then
                fpsAvg = fpsFrames / fpsElapsed
                fpsFrames = 0
                fpsElapsed = 0
            end
        end))
        local pingSmooth = nil
        while pb.Parent do
            local ping = 0
            pcall(function()
                local v = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
                if type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then
                    ping = v * 1000
                end
            end)
            if ping <= 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    local stat = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
                    if not stat then
                        return
                    end
                    local raw = stat:GetValue()
                    if type(raw) == "number" then
                        ping = raw
                    elseif type(raw) == "string" then
                        ping = tonumber((raw:gsub("[^%d%.]", ""))) or 0
                    end
                end)
            end
            if ping > 0 then
                if pingSmooth == nil then
                    pingSmooth = ping
                else
                    pingSmooth = pingSmooth * 0.65 + ping * 0.35
                end
            end
            local show = pingSmooth or ping
            sbFps.Text = string.format("FPS: %d", math.floor(fpsAvg + 0.5))
            sbPing.Text = string.format("PING: %dms", math.floor((show or 0) + 0.5))
            sbMode.Text = sbModeText()
            task.wait(0.4)
        end
    end) do
        local dragging, dStart, sPos, activeInp
        pb.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if _G._VynxUILocked then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true;
                dStart = input.Position;
                sPos = pb.Position;
                activeInp = input
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if _G._VynxUILocked then
                dragging = false
                activeInp = nil
                return
            end
            if not dragging then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == activeInp) then
                local d = input.Position - dStart
                pb.Position = UDim2.new(sPos.X.Scale, sPos.X.Offset + d.X, sPos.Y.Scale, sPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                return
            end
            dragging = false;
            activeInp = nil
            local p = pb.Position
            _G._VlPbPos = {
                p.X.Scale,
                p.X.Offset,
                p.Y.Scale,
                p.Y.Offset
            }
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function hkb(kc)
        if _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive and _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive() then
            return
        end
        if waitingForKey then
            return
        end
        if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            return
        end
        do
            local irKeyName = _G._VynxInstaResetKey
            if (Keybinds.InstaReset and Keybinds.InstaReset ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and kc == Keybinds.InstaReset) or(irKeyName and kc.Name == irKeyName) then
                if _G.VynxDoInstaReset then
                    _G.VynxDoInstaReset()
                end
                return
            end
        end
        if kc == Keybinds.SpeedToggle then
            Spd.Carry()
        elseif kc == Keybinds.LaggerToggle or kc == Keybinds.LaggerSpeed then
            Spd.Lagger()
        elseif kc == Keybinds.NormalSpeed then
            Spd.Normal()
        end
        if kc == Keybinds.AutoBat then
            if batClk then

    (function()
        local function applyUIScale(val)
            local prevScale =(UI_SCALE or 1) * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
            UI_SCALE = math.clamp(val, 0.5, 2.0)
            local newScale = UI_SCALE * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
            local function recentre()
                if not outer or prevScale == newScale then
                    return
                end
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
                local baseW, baseH = outer.Size.X.Offset, outer.Size.Y.Offset
                if baseW <= 0 or baseH <= 0 then
                    return
                end
                local p = outer.Position
                local ox = p.X.Offset - baseW *(newScale - prevScale) / 2
                local oy = p.Y.Offset - baseH *(newScale - prevScale) / 2
                local w, h = baseW * newScale, baseH * newScale
                local minX, minY = 8 - p.X.Scale * vp.X, 8 - p.Y.Scale * vp.Y
                ox = math.clamp(ox, minX, math.max(minX, vp.X - w - 8 - p.X.Scale * vp.X))
                oy = math.clamp(oy, minY, math.max(minY, vp.Y - h - 8 - p.Y.Scale * vp.Y))
                outer.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, ox, p.Y.Scale, oy)
            end
            local function applyToFrame(frame)
                if not frame then
                    return
                end
                local s = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
                if not s then
                    s = Instance.new("UIScale");
                    s.Parent = frame
                end
                s.Scale = UI_SCALE * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
            end
            local function doApply()
                applyToFrame(outer)
                recentre()
                if not apMain then
                    return
                end
                if apMain:IsDescendantOf(outer) then
                    local s = apMain:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
                    if s then
                        s.Scale = 1
                    end
                else
                    applyToFrame(apMain)
                end
            end
            if outer then
                doApply()
            else
                task.spawn(function()
                    repeat
                        task.wait(0.05)
                    until outer and apMain;
                    doApply()
                end)
            end
        end
        _G._VynxApplyUIScale = applyUIScale

            pcall(applyUIScale, UI_SCALE)
        end

(function()
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService");
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local AP_C_CARD = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
    local AP_C_ACC = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
    local AP_C_DIM = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
    local AP_C_SW_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
    local AP_C_WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local SAVE_FILE = "AutoPlayConfig.json"
    local function apSaveConfig()
        pcall(function()
            if not writefile then
                return
            end
            writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({
                mode = _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode
            }))
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        if not(isfile and isfile(SAVE_FILE)) then
            return
        end
        local ok, cfg = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
        end)
        if not ok or not cfg then
            return
        end
        if cfg.mode == "Normal" or cfg.mode == "Auto Play" then
            _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode = cfg.mode
        end
    end)
    local autoPlayPage = _G._V7AutoPlayPage
    local _apFrame = Instance.new("Frame", autoPlayPage)
    _apFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0);
    _apFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    _apFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1;
    _apFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0;
    _apFrame.LayoutOrder = 1
    local apVstack = _apFrame
    local apLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", apVstack)

            for k, b in pairs(apModeBtns) do

                b.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    local desyncActive = false

        desyncActive = state and true or false

    local waitingForKey = false
    local toggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.Y

    local winPos = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, - 195)
    local function saveSettings()
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local cfg = {
                hotkey = toggleKey.Name,
                winX = winPos.X.Offset,
                winY = winPos.Y.Offset,
                winXS = winPos.X.Scale,
                winYS = winPos.Y.Scale,
            }
            local parts = {}
            for k, v in pairs(cfg) do
                local vStr =(type(v) == "string") and('"' .. v .. '"') or tostring(v)
                table.insert(parts, '"' .. k .. '":' .. vStr)
            end
            writefile(SETTINGS_FILE, "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}")
        end)
    end
    local function loadSettings()
        pcall(function()
            local ok, data = pcall(readfile, SETTINGS_FILE)
            if not ok or not data or data == "" then
                return
            end
            local function toVal(s)
                s = s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                if s:sub(1, 1) == '"' then
                    return s:sub(2, - 2)
                end
                return tonumber(s)
            end
            for k, v in data:gmatch("\"([^\"]+)\"%s*:%s*(\"?[^\",}]+\"?)") do
                local val = toVal(v)
                if k == "hotkey" and type(val) == "string" then
                    local kc = Enum.KeyCode[val]
                    if kc then
                        toggleKey = kc
                    end
                elseif k == "winX" then
                    winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, val, winPos.Y.Scale, winPos.Y.Offset)
                elseif k == "winY" then
                    winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, winPos.X.Offset, winPos.Y.Scale, val)
                elseif k == "winXS" then
                    winPos = UDim2.new(val, winPos.X.Offset, winPos.Y.Scale, winPos.Y.Offset)
                elseif k == "winYS" then
                    winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, winPos.X.Offset, val, winPos.Y.Offset)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    loadSettings()

    end

        if state then
            unwalkActive = true
            startUnwalkLoop()

                tween(btn, 0.25, {

                    0,
                    0),
                    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,
                    255,
                    255)
                })
                btn.Text = "UNWALK: OFF"
            end
        end
    end

        if hubStale() then
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and true and not _isGamepadInput(input) then
            return
        end
        if waitingForKey then
            if gpe then
                return
            end
            toggleKey = input.KeyCode
            if KeyBtn then
                KeyBtn.Text = "[ " .. toggleKey.Name .. " ]"
            end
            if keyStroke then
                tween(keyStroke, 0.2, {
                    Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                    0,
                    0),
                    Thickness = 1
                })
            end
            waitingForKey = false
            saveSettings()
            return
        end
        if gpe then
            return
        end
        if _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive and _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive() then
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == toggleKey then
            setDesync(not desyncActive)
            if updateVisual then
                updateVisual()
            end
        end
    end)

    end
    _G.KrixDesyncHidePanel = function()
        TS:Create(Panel, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0,
            PANEL_W,
            0,
            0)
        }):Play()
        task.delay(0.27,
        function()
            Panel.Visible = false
        end)
    end
    _G.KrixDesyncTogglePanel = function()
        if Panel.Visible then
            _G.KrixDesyncHidePanel()
        else
            _G.KrixDesyncShowPanel()
        end
    end
end)()

            TextTransparency = 1

            BackgroundTransparency = 1

            Scale = 0.7
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(blur, TweenInfo.new(0.35), {
            Size = 0

            if introGui.Parent then
                introGui:Destroy()

            if blur.Parent then
                blur:Destroy()
            end
            _G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup = nil
            if onFinished then
                pcall(onFinished)

    _G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup = function()
        finished = true
        animToken = animToken + 1
        if _G._VioletteccStopIntroSong then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccStopIntroSong)
        end
        if introGui.Parent then
            introGui:Destroy()
        end
        if blur.Parent then
            blur:Destroy()
        end
        _G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup = nil
    end
    TweenService:Create(intro, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
    }):Play()
    TweenService:Create(blur, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {
        Size = 12
    }):Play()

    }):Play()
    TweenService:Create(topBar, TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {

        TweenService:Create(underline, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.new(introIsMobile and 0.55 or 0.42,
            0,
            0,
            2)
        }):Play()
    end)
    task.delay(0.38,
    function()
        if finished then
            return
        end
        TweenService:Create(badge, TweenInfo.new(0.28), {
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(badgeStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.28), {
            Transparency = 0.25
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(badgeLbl, TweenInfo.new(0.28), {
            TextTransparency = 0
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(tagline, TweenInfo.new(0.35), {
            TextTransparency = 0.15
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(discord, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {
            TextTransparency = 0.25
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(tapPrompt, TweenInfo.new(0.45), {
            TextTransparency = 0.35
        }):Play()
    end)
    task.delay(0.55,
    function()
        if finished then
            return
        end
        title.TextColor3 = PINK
        task.delay(0.06,
        function()
            if finished then
                return
            end
            title.TextColor3 = ACCENT
        end)

            if finished then
                return
            end

            task.delay(0.05,
            function()
                if not finished then
                    title.TextTransparency = 0
                end
            end)
        end)
    end)
    local token = animToken
    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = os.clock()
        while not finished and token == animToken and introGui.Parent do
            local elapsed = os.clock() - t0
            local pulse =(math.sin(elapsed * 2.4) + 1) * 0.5
            for _, starData in ipairs(particles) do
                local x =(starData.x + elapsed * starData.speed * 0.15) % 1.05 - 0.025
                local y =(starData.y + math.sin(elapsed * 0.7 + starData.phase) * 0.04) % 1.05 - 0.025
                local twinkle =(math.sin(elapsed * 2.1 + starData.phase) + 1) * 0.5
                starData.frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
                starData.frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1 -(0.55 + pulse * 0.25) *(starData.opacity + twinkle * 0.15)
            end
            if titleScale and titleScale.Parent then
                titleScale.Scale = 1 + pulse * 0.012
            end
            if glow and glow.Parent then
                glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.50 + pulse * 0.12
            end
            if tapPrompt and tapPrompt.Parent and elapsed > 0.9 then
                local blink =(math.sin(elapsed * 3.2) + 1) * 0.5
                tapPrompt.TextTransparency = 0.25 + blink * 0.45
            end
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        end
    end)
    skipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(finish)
    local keyConn
    keyConn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe or finished then
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or(input.UserInputType.Name and input.UserInputType.Name:sub(1, 7) == "Gamepad") then
            if keyConn then
                keyConn:Disconnect()
            end
            finish()
        end
    end)
    task.delay(5.5, finish)
end
playVioletteLoadIntro = function(onFinished)
    if _G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup)
    end
    if _G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong, _G._VioletteccIntroSong or "Song 1", false)
    end
    local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("VioletteLoadIntro")
    if old then
        old:Destroy()
    end
    local oldBlur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VioletteLoadIntroBlur")
    if oldBlur then
        oldBlur:Destroy()
    end
    local introGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    introGui.Name = "VioletteLoadIntro"
    introGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    introGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    introGui.DisplayOrder = 1000005
    introGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
    if _G._VioletteccMountOnTop then
        _G._VioletteccMountOnTop(introGui, 1000005)
    else
        introGui.Parent = playerGui
    end
    local backdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
    backdrop.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    backdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    backdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
    backdrop.ZIndex = 1000
    backdrop.Parent = introGui
    local isMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
    local imageId = ""
    local letters = {}
    local size = isMobile and 168 or 280
    local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    image.Name = "LORD_HUB_IntroImage"
    image.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5)
    image.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size)
    image.Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5)
    image.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    image.BorderSizePixel = 0
    image.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
    image.ImageTransparency = 1
    image.ZIndex = 1003
    image.Parent = backdrop
    letters[1] = {
        image = image,
        base = image.Position,
        index = 1
    }
    if imageId ~= "" then
        task.spawn(function()
            local contentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
            image.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. imageId .. "&w=420&h=420"
            local loaded = false
            local ok = pcall(function()
                contentProvider:PreloadAsync({
                    image
                })
            end)
            loaded = ok and image.IsLoaded
            if not loaded and image.Parent then
                image.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. imageId
                ok = pcall(function()
                    contentProvider:PreloadAsync({
                        image
                    })
                end)
                loaded = ok and image.IsLoaded
            end
            if image.Parent then
                TweenService:Create(image, TweenInfo.new(.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                    ImageTransparency = 0
                }):Play()
            end
        end)
    else
        image.Visible = false
    end
    local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
    blur.Name = "VioletteLoadIntroBlur"
    blur.Size = 0
    blur.Parent = Lighting
    local finished = false
    local floatConn
    local function finish()
        if finished then
            return
        end
        finished = true
        if floatConn then
            floatConn:Disconnect();
            floatConn = nil
        end
        if _G._VioletteccFadeIntroSong then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccFadeIntroSong, .45)
        end
        for _, entry in ipairs(letters) do
            if entry.image.Parent then
                TweenService:Create(entry.image, TweenInfo.new(.28), {
                    ImageTransparency = 1
                }):Play()
            end
        end
        TweenService:Create(backdrop, TweenInfo.new(.32), {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(blur, TweenInfo.new(.28), {
            Size = 0
        }):Play()
        task.delay(.36,
        function()
            if introGui.Parent then
                introGui:Destroy()
            end
            if blur.Parent then
                blur:Destroy()
            end
            _G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup = nil
            if gui and gui.Parent then
                gui.Enabled = true
            end
            if _G._VioletteccForceHudReveal then
                pcall(_G._VioletteccForceHudReveal, true)
            end
            if onFinished then
                pcall(onFinished)
            end
        end)
    end
    _G._VioletteccFinishIntro = finish
    _G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup = function()
        if finished then
            return
        end
        finished = true
        if floatConn then
            floatConn:Disconnect()
        end
        if _G._VioletteccStopIntroSong then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccStopIntroSong)
        end
        if introGui.Parent then
            introGui:Destroy()
        end
        if blur.Parent then
            blur:Destroy()
        end
        _G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup = nil
    end
    backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    blur.Size = 0
    local started = os.clock()
    floatConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local elapsed = os.clock() - started
        for _, entry in ipairs(letters) do
            local image = entry.image
            if image.Parent then
                local phase = elapsed * .9 + entry.index * 1.37
                image.Position = entry.base + UDim2.fromOffset(math.sin(phase) * 12, math.cos(phase * 1.23) * 15)
                image.Rotation = math.sin(phase * .72) * 6
            end
        end
    end)
    local skip = Instance.new("TextButton")
    skip.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    skip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    skip.Text = ""
    skip.ZIndex = 1010
    skip.Parent = backdrop
    skip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(finish)
end
task.defer(function()
    local hubGui = gui
    local hubRevealed = false
    local function revealHub()
        if hubRevealed then
            return
        end
        hubRevealed = true
        _G._VioletteccIntroActive = false
        _G._VioletteccWantMinimized =(_G._VioletteccUserHidHub == true)
        if hubGui then
            hubGui.Enabled = true
        end
        if _G._VioletteccForceHudReveal then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccForceHudReveal)
        else
            local stealBar = hubGui and hubGui:FindFirstChild("StealBar")
            if stealBar then
                stealBar.Visible = true
            end
            if _G._VynxApplyHideMobile then
                pcall(_G._VynxApplyHideMobile, _G._VezyHideSideBtns == true)
            elseif _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame then
                _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame.Visible = _G._VezyHideSideBtns ~= true
            end
            if _G._VioletteccUserHidHub ~= true then
                local outerRef = _G.VynxOuterRef
                if outerRef and outerRef.Parent then
                    if _G._VioletteccSetHubVisible then
                        pcall(_G._VioletteccSetHubVisible, true, false)
                    else
                        outerRef.Visible = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRevealPanels then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRevealPanels)
        end
        task.delay(0.35,
        function()
            if _G._VioletteccForceHudReveal then
                pcall(_G._VioletteccForceHudReveal, true)
            end
        end)
        task.delay(1.0,
        function()
            if _G._VioletteccForceHudReveal then
                pcall(_G._VioletteccForceHudReveal, true)
            end
        end)
    end
    if _G._VioletteccSkipIntro == true then
        revealHub()
        return
    end
    _G._VioletteccIntroActive = true
    if hubGui then
        hubGui.Enabled = false
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({
        "duelLagger",
        "pingLagger",
        "speedBypass"
    }) do
        if _G._VioletteccShowPanel then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccShowPanel, key, false)
        end
    end
    playVioletteLoadIntro(revealHub)
end);
(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
    local VIOLETTE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local DISCORD_TEXT = "discord.gg/violettehub"
    local selfSpeedLabel = nil
    local otherLabels = {}
    local function buildSelfTag(char)
        if not char then
            return
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if not head then
            return
        end
        local old = head:FindFirstChild("VioletteHeadBB")
        if old then
            old:Destroy()
        end
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
        bb.Name = "VioletteHeadBB"
        bb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(3.2, 1.48)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.45, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
        bb.LightInfluence = 0
        bb.MaxDistance = 150
        local val = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        val.Name = "Speed"
        val.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        val.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0)
        val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        val.BorderSizePixel = 0
        val.Text = "0.0"
        val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        val.TextScaled = true
        val.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        val.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
        val.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        local vcon = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", val)
        vcon.MinTextSize = 6
        vcon.MaxTextSize = 22
        selfSpeedLabel = val
        if _G._VioletteccSetTagColor and _G._VioletteccAccent then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccSetTagColor, _G._VioletteccAccent)
        end
    end
    local function buildOtherTag(player)
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then
            return
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then
            return
        end
        local old = head:FindFirstChild("VioletteSpeedBB")
        if old then
            old:Destroy()
        end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            pcall(function()
                hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                hum.NameDisplayDistance = 0
                hum.HealthDisplayDistance = 0
            end)
        end
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
        bb.Name = "VioletteSpeedBB"
        bb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(2.5, 1.02)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
        bb.LightInfluence = 0
        bb.MaxDistance = 220
        local val = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        val.Name = "Speed"
        val.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        val.Text = "0"
        val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        val.TextScaled = true
        val.TextColor3 = VIOLETTE_COLOR
        val.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        val.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        local con = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", val)
        con.MinTextSize = 7
        con.MaxTextSize = 21
        otherLabels[player] = val
    end
    local function watchPlayer(player)
        if player == LP then
            return
        end
        if player.Character then
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.3);
                pcall(buildOtherTag, player)
            end)
        end
        player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.4)
            pcall(buildOtherTag, player)
        end)
    end
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        watchPlayer(player)
    end
    Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
    Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
        otherLabels[player] = nil
    end)
    if LP.Character then
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.3);
            pcall(buildSelfTag, LP.Character)
        end)
    end
    LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.3)
        pcall(buildSelfTag, char)
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        while task.wait(1) do
            local char = LP.Character
            local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head and not head:FindFirstChild("VioletteHeadBB") then
                pcall(buildSelfTag, char)
            end
            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LP then
                    local pc = player.Character
                    local ph = pc and pc:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if ph and not ph:FindFirstChild("VioletteSpeedBB") then
                        pcall(buildOtherTag, player)
                    elseif pc then
                        local phum = pc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        if phum and phum.DisplayDistanceType ~= Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None then
                            pcall(function()
                                phum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
                                phum.NameDisplayDistance = 0
                                phum.HealthDisplayDistance = 0
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
    RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if selfSpeedLabel and selfSpeedLabel.Parent then
            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hrp then
                local routing =(_G._VioletteccAutoPathActive and _G._VioletteccAutoPathActive()) or false
                local aimbotting =(_G._VioletteccGetAimbotSpeed and _G._VioletteccGetAimbotSpeed()) ~= nil
                if humanoid and not routing and not aimbotting and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
                    if selfSpeedLabel.Text ~= "0.0" then
                        selfSpeedLabel.Text = "0.0"
                    end
                else
                    local vel = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                    local horizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
                    local ceiling = 0
                    if not routing then
                        ceiling = tonumber(_G._VioletteccGetSpeed and _G._VioletteccGetSpeed()) or 0
                        if ceiling > 0 then
                            horizontal =(horizontal > 0.15) and ceiling or 0
                        end
                    end
                    if horizontal < 0.15 then
                        horizontal = 0
                    end
                    local speedTxt = string.format("%.1f", horizontal)
                    if selfSpeedLabel.Text ~= speedTxt then
                        selfSpeedLabel.Text = speedTxt
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local SPEED_TAG_NEAR = 24
        local SPEED_TAG_FAR = 160
        local SPEED_TAG_MAX = 1.9
        local speedTagCam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camCF = speedTagCam and speedTagCam.CFrame
        for player, label in pairs(otherLabels) do
            if label and label.Parent then
                local pc = player.Character
                local prp = pc and pc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if prp then
                    local vel = prp.AssemblyLinearVelocity or prp.Velocity
                    local tagTxt = string.format("%d", math.floor(Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude + 0.5))
                    if label.Text ~= tagTxt then
                        label.Text = tagTxt
                    end
                    local bb = label.Parent
                    if camCF and bb and bb:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                        local dist =(camCF.Position - prp.Position).Magnitude
                        local grow = math.clamp(dist / SPEED_TAG_NEAR, 1, SPEED_TAG_FAR / SPEED_TAG_NEAR)
                        grow = math.min(grow, SPEED_TAG_MAX)
                        local tagSize = UDim2.fromScale(2.5 * grow, 1.02 * grow)
                        if bb.Size ~= tagSize then
                            bb.Size = tagSize
                        end
                    end
                end
            else
                otherLabels[player] = nil
            end
        end
    end))
    _G._VioletteccHeadTagColor = VIOLETTE_COLOR
    _G._VioletteccDiscordText = DISCORD_TEXT
    _G._VioletteccSetTagColor = function(c)
        if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then
            return
        end
        VIOLETTE_COLOR = c
        _G._VioletteccHeadTagColor = c
        if selfSpeedLabel and selfSpeedLabel.Parent then
            selfSpeedLabel.TextColor3 = c
            local T = _G._VioletteccThemeColor
            if T then
                selfSpeedLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = T(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0))
            end
        end
        for _, label in pairs(otherLabels) do
            if label and label.Parent then
                label.TextColor3 = c
            end
        end
    end
    if _G._VioletteccAccent then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccSetTagColor, _G._VioletteccAccent)
    end
end)();
(function()
    _G._VioletteccFakeSpeed = tonumber(_G._VioletteccFakeSpeed) or 16
    local HIJACK = _G._VelHijackStore
    if type(HIJACK) ~= "table" then
        HIJACK = {
            v = Vector3.zero
        }
        _G._VelHijackStore = HIJACK
    end
    HIJACK.v = Vector3.zero
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if not _G._VelHijackInstalled then
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local _mt = getrawmetatable(game)
            setreadonly(_mt, false)
            local _oi = _mt.__index
            local _on = _mt.__newindex
            local function isOurRoot(t, k)
                local _tk = tostring(k)
                if _tk ~= "AssemblyLinearVelocity" and _tk ~= "Velocity" then
                    return false
                end
                if typeof(t) ~= "Instance" or not t:IsA("BasePart") then
                    return false
                end
                local _tn = t.Name
                if _tn ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and _tn ~= "Torso" and _tn ~= "UpperTorso" then
                    return false
                end
                local char = LP.Character
                return char ~= nil and t:IsDescendantOf(char)
            end
            _mt.__index = newcclosure(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t, k)
                if not checkcaller() then
                    local good, mine = pcall(isOurRoot, t, k)
                    if good and mine then
                        return HIJACK.v
                    end
                end
                return _oi(t, k)
            end))
            _mt.__newindex = newcclosure(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(t, k, v)
                if not checkcaller() then
                    local good, mine = pcall(isOurRoot, t, k)
                    if good and mine then
                        HIJACK.v = v
                        return
                    end
                end
                return _on(t, k, v)
            end))
            setreadonly(_mt, true)
        end)
        _G._VelHijackInstalled = ok
    end
    local _r = Random.new()
    local _acc = 0
    local function _gc()
        local c = LP.Character
        if not c then
            return nil, nil, nil
        end
        local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if h and h.Health > 0 and r then
            return c, h, r
        end
        return nil, nil, nil
    end
    RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
        _acc = _acc + dt
        if _acc < 0.016 then
            return
        end
        _acc = 0
        local c, h, r = _gc()
        if not c or not h or not r then
            return
        end
        local st = h:GetState()
        if h.PlatformStand or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
            HIJACK.v = Vector3.new(0, r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
            return
        end
        local m = h.MoveDirection
        if m.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            pcall(function()
                if r.SetNetworkOwner then
                    r:SetNetworkOwner(LP)
                end
            end)
            local u = m.Unit
            local fake = tonumber(_G._VioletteccFakeSpeed) or 16
            local real = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VioletteccGetSpeed and _G._VioletteccGetSpeed()) or 0, 0, 10000)
            local jx = _r:NextNumber(- 0.003, 0.003)
            local jz = _r:NextNumber(- 0.003, 0.003)
            local y = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
            HIJACK.v = Vector3.new(u.X * fake + jx, y, u.Z * fake + jz)
