            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(u.X * real + jx, y, u.Z * real + jz)
            _G._RaVeLiveSpeed = {
                t = os.clock(),
                v = real
            }
        else
            HIJACK.v = Vector3.new(0, r.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
        end
    end)
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local infJumpEnabled = false
    local CFG = {
        jumpPower = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VezyInfiniteJumpPower) or 55,
        20,
        150),
        maxJumpHeight = 55,
        roofClearance = 4.2,
    }
    local JUMP_COOLDOWN = 0.08
    local INF_JUMP_PULSE = 0.06
    local HOLD_JUMP_REFRESH = 0.12
    local Controller = {}
    if _G.VX7InfinityJump and _G.VX7InfinityJump.Destroy then
        pcall(_G.VX7InfinityJump.Destroy)
    end
    Controller.Enabled = false
    local _groundY = nil
    local _roofBlockUntil = 0
    local _lastJumpTime = 0
    local _jumpWasGrounded = true
    local _holdStall = 0
    local _padJumpHeld = false
    local _hic = {}
    local _pulseTokens = setmetatable({}, {
        __mode = "k"
    })
    local function holdModeOn()
        return string.lower(tostring(_G._VezyJumpMode or "hold")) == "hold"
    end
    local function isAliveRoot(root)
        if not(root and root.Parent) then
            return false
        end
        local char = root.Parent
        if char ~= LP.Character then
            return false
        end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
    end
    local function stopNamed(root, prefix)
        if not root then
            return
        end
        local lv = root:FindFirstChild(prefix .. "LinearVelocity")
        if lv and lv:IsA("LinearVelocity") then
            _pulseTokens[lv] = nil
            pcall(function()
                lv.Enabled = false;
                lv.LineVelocity = 0;
                lv:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        local att = root:FindFirstChild(prefix .. "Attachment")
        if att and att:IsA("Attachment") then
            pcall(function()
                att:Destroy()
            end)
        end
    end
    local function getVertical(root, prefix)
        if not isAliveRoot(root) then
            return nil
        end
        local attName, lvName = prefix .. "Attachment", prefix .. "LinearVelocity"
        local att = root:FindFirstChild(attName)
        if not(att and att:IsA("Attachment")) then
            att = Instance.new("Attachment");
            att.Name = attName;
            att.Parent = root
        end
        local lv = root:FindFirstChild(lvName)
        if not(lv and lv:IsA("LinearVelocity")) then
            lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity");
            lv.Name = lvName;
            lv.Parent = root
        end
        lv.Attachment0 = att
        lv.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
        lv.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Line
        lv.LineDirection = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        pcall(function()
            lv.ForceLimitsEnabled = false
        end)
        return lv
    end
    local function pulseVertical(root, prefix, speed, duration)
        local lv = getVertical(root, prefix)
        if not lv then
            return nil
        end
        local token = {}
        _pulseTokens[lv] = token
        lv.LineVelocity = speed or 0
        lv.Enabled = true
        task.delay(duration or 0.1,
        function()
            if _pulseTokens[lv] ~= token then
                return
            end
            _pulseTokens[lv] = nil
            if lv.Parent then
                stopNamed(root, prefix)
            end
        end)
        return lv
    end
    local function readRootVelocity(root)
        if not(root and root.Parent) then
            return Vector3.zero
        end
        local ok, v = pcall(function()
            return root:GetVelocityAtPosition(root.Position)
        end)
        return ok and v or Vector3.zero
    end
    local _roofParams = RaycastParams.new()
    _roofParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    pcall(function()
        _roofParams.RespectCanCollide = true
    end)
    local function checkRoofCollision(root, dt)
        local char = LP.Character
        if not(char and root and root.Parent) then
            return false
        end
        _roofParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
            char
        }
        local upwardSpeed = math.max(readRootVelocity(root).Y, 0)
        if upwardSpeed <= 0.25 then
            return false
        end
        local frameTime = math.clamp(dt or(1 / 60), 1 / 240, 1 / 15)
        local roofDistance =(CFG.roofClearance or 4.2) + math.min(upwardSpeed * frameTime, 0.9)
        local roofHit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, roofDistance, 0), _roofParams)
        if not roofHit then
            return false
        end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.Jump = false
        end
        local roofVel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local infJumpActive = root:FindFirstChild("InfJumpLinearVelocity") ~= nil
        if roofVel.Y > 0 and(infJumpActive or roofVel.Y > 60) then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(roofVel.X, 0, roofVel.Z)
        end
        _roofBlockUntil = tick() + 0.12
        return true
    end
    local function jumpPower()
        return math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.jumpPower) or 55, 20, 150)
    end
    local function jumpCapped(root)
        if not root or not _groundY then
            return false
        end
        return(root.Position.Y - _groundY) >=(tonumber(CFG.maxJumpHeight) or 55)
    end
    local function tryPulse(root, hum, manualRequest)
        if not(root and hum) or not isAliveRoot(root) then
            return false
        end
        local now = tick()
        if now < _roofBlockUntil then
            return false
        end
        if jumpCapped(root) then
            if root:FindFirstChild("InfJumpLinearVelocity") then
                stopNamed(root, "InfJump")
            end
            return false
        end
        if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            _jumpWasGrounded = true;
            _lastJumpTime = 0;
            _groundY = root.Position.Y
            return false
        end
        if _jumpWasGrounded then
            _jumpWasGrounded = false;
            return false
        end
        if now - _lastJumpTime < JUMP_COOLDOWN then
            return false
        end
        if not manualRequest and readRootVelocity(root).Y > 32 then
            return false
        end
        _lastJumpTime = now
        pulseVertical(root, "InfJump", jumpPower(), INF_JUMP_PULSE)
        return true
    end
    local function isGamepad(input)
        return input.UserInputType.Name:sub(1, 7) == "Gamepad"
    end
    local function startHoldInfJump()
        if _hic.loop then
            return
        end
        _hic.padDown = hubConnect(UserInputService.InputBegan,
        function(input)
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA and isGamepad(input) then
                _padJumpHeld = true
            end
        end)
        _hic.padUp = hubConnect(UserInputService.InputEnded,
        function(input)
            if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA and isGamepad(input) then
                _padJumpHeld = false
            end
        end)
        local lastManualJump = 0
        local function requestManualJump()
            if not infJumpEnabled or holdModeOn() then
                return
            end
            if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
                return
            end
            if _G._AmbitiousTPDownJumpLocked then
                return
            end
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - lastManualJump < 0.09 then
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not(root and hum) or hum.Health <= 0 or hum.Sit or hum.SeatPart then
                return
            end
            lastManualJump = now
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, jumpPower(), velocity.Z)
        end
        _hic.jumpReq = hubConnect(UserInputService.JumpRequest, requestManualJump)
        _hic.loop = hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not infJumpEnabled then
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character;
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
            if not root then
                return
            end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
            if not hum then
                return
            end
            if holdModeOn() then
                local held = UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) or _padJumpHeld or hum.Jump == true
                local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
                if held and velocity.Y < 35 then
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, math.max(jumpPower(), 55), velocity.Z)
                elseif velocity.Y < - 120 then
                    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, - 120, velocity.Z)
                end
                return
            end
        end))
    end
    local function stopHoldInfJump()
        for _, key in ipairs({
            "jumpReq",
            "manualKeys",
            "loop",
            "padDown",
            "padUp"
        }) do
            local connection = _hic[key]
            if connection then
                pcall(function()
                    connection:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            stopNamed(root, "InfJump")
        end
        _hic = {}
        _lastJumpTime = 0
        _jumpWasGrounded = true
        _holdStall = 0
        _roofBlockUntil = 0
        _padJumpHeld = false
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function()
        _groundY = nil;
        _jumpWasGrounded = true
        _lastJumpTime = 0;
        _holdStall = 0;
        _roofBlockUntil = 0
        _padJumpHeld = false
    end)
    local function setInfJumpEnabled(on)
        on =(on == true)
        if on then
            stopHoldInfJump()
            infJumpEnabled = true
            Controller.Enabled = true
            Enabled.InfiniteJump = true
            startHoldInfJump()
        else
            infJumpEnabled = false
            Controller.Enabled = false
            Enabled.InfiniteJump = false
            stopHoldInfJump()
        end
    end
    function Controller.SetEnabled(enabled)
        setInfJumpEnabled(enabled == true)
        return Controller.Enabled
    end
    function Controller.GetEnabled()
        return Controller.Enabled == true
    end
    function Controller.Toggle()
        Controller.SetEnabled(not Controller.Enabled)
        return Controller.Enabled
    end
    function Controller.ClearVelocity()
        local char = LP.Character
        stopNamed(char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), "InfJump")
    end
    function Controller.Destroy()
        setInfJumpEnabled(false)
        for _, c in ipairs(_conns) do
            pcall(function()
                c:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        _conns = {}
        if _G.VX7InfinityJump == Controller then
            _G.VX7InfinityJump = nil
        end
        if _G._CandyInfinityJump == Controller then
            _G._CandyInfinityJump = nil
        end
        if _G.HoldInfJump and _G.HoldInfJump.cfg == CFG then
            _G.HoldInfJump = nil
        end
    end
    _G.VX7InfinityJump = Controller
    _G._CandyInfinityJump = Controller
    _G.HoldInfJump = {
        cfg = CFG,
        start = startHoldInfJump,
        stop = stopHoldInfJump,
    }
    _G._VezySetJumpPower = function(value)
        CFG.jumpPower = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 55, 20, 150)
        _G._VezyInfiniteJumpPower = CFG.jumpPower
        if _G._VezyJumpPowerBox and _G._VezyJumpPowerBox.Parent then
            _G._VezyJumpPowerBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(CFG.jumpPower + 0.5))
        end
        return CFG.jumpPower
    end
    startInfiniteJump = function()
        setInfJumpEnabled(true)
    end
    stopInfiniteJump = function()
        setInfJumpEnabled(false)
    end
    _G.VezyEnableInfJump = startInfiniteJump
    _G.VezyDisableInfJump = stopInfiniteJump
    if _G._VezyJumpMode == "Single" then
        _G._VezyJumpMode = "Manual"
    end
    _G._VezyJumpMode =(_G._VezyJumpMode == "Manual" and "Manual") or "Hold"
    _G._AdaptInfJumpMode = string.upper(_G._VezyJumpMode)
    setInfJumpEnabled(Enabled.InfiniteJump == true)
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccNoPlayerCollision and _G._VioletteccNoPlayerCollision.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccNoPlayerCollision.Destroy)
    end
    local _wfConns = {}
    local function track(c)
        _wfConns[# _wfConns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local function clearCharacter(char)
        if not char then
            return
        end
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end
    local function disableOtherCollisions()
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                clearCharacter(plr.Character)
            end
        end
    end
    local function watchCharacter(char)
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 12 do
                if not char.Parent then
                    return
                end
                clearCharacter(char)
                task.wait(0.1)
            end
        end)
    end
    local function watchPlayer(plr)
        if plr == LP then
            return
        end
        if plr.Character then
            watchCharacter(plr.Character)
        end
        track(plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(watchCharacter))
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        watchPlayer(plr)
    end
    track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer))
    local _acc = 0
    track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        _acc = _acc + dt
        if _acc < 0.2 then
            return
        end
        _acc = 0
        pcall(disableOtherCollisions)
    end)))
    _G._VioletteccNoPlayerCollision = {
        Refresh = disableOtherCollisions,
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_wfConns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _wfConns = {}
            if _G._VioletteccNoPlayerCollision then
                _G._VioletteccNoPlayerCollision = nil
            end
        end,
    }
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccAutoSpeedRuntime and _G._VioletteccAutoSpeedRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAutoSpeedRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    _G._VynxAutoSpeedRange = tonumber(_G._VynxAutoSpeedRange) or 15
    local RT = {
        active = false,
        previous = nil,
        graceUntil = 0,
        conn = nil
    }
    local function paintCarryModes()
        pcall(Spd.Refresh)
        if _G._VioletteccSyncMobileSpeedBtns then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccSyncMobileSpeedBtns)
        end
    end
    local function isIgnoredCarryTool(name)
        local n = tostring(name or ""):lower()
        return n:find("bat") or n:find("slap") or n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone")
    end
    local function isCarryingBrainrot(char)
        if not char then
            return false
        end
        if LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true or LP:GetAttribute("AntiKick") == true or char:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
            return true
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "Carrying",
            "IsCarrying",
            "Grabbed",
            "Holding",
            "StealHold",
            "HasGrab"
        }) do
            local value = char:FindFirstChild(name, true)
            if value and((value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value) or(value:IsA("ObjectValue") and value.Value) or(value:IsA("StringValue") and value.Value ~= "")) then
                return true
            end
        end
        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            local n = child.Name:lower()
            if child:IsA("Tool") and not isIgnoredCarryTool(n) then
                return true
            end
            if child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) and(n:find("brainrot") or n:find("animal") or n:find("carry") or n:find("grab") or n:find("steal") or n:find("hold")) then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function enableAutoCarrySpeed()
        if RT.active then
            RT.graceUntil = tick() + 0.75;
            return
        end
        RT.previous = {
            family = Spd.family,
            carry = Spd.carry
        }
        RT.active = true
        RT.graceUntil = tick() + 0.75
        Spd.carry = true
        paintCarryModes()
    end
    local function disableAutoCarrySpeed()
        if not RT.active then
            return
        end
        local previous = RT.previous
        RT.active, RT.previous = false, nil
        if previous then
            Spd.family, Spd.carry = previous.family, previous.carry
        end
        paintCarryModes()
    end
    local softSteal = {
        spots = {},
        nextScan = 0,
        latched = false,
        held = false,
        armed = true
    }
    local function softStealScan()
        local spots = {}
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        if not plots then
            softSteal.spots = spots;
            return
        end
        for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
            local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
            local yourBase = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
            local mine = yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") and yourBase.Enabled == true
            if not mine then
                local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if podiums then
                    for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
                        local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
                        local spawnPart = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                        if spawnPart then
                            spots[# spots + 1] = spawnPart.Position
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        softSteal.spots = spots
    end
    local function softStealApply()
        if not RT.active then
            RT.previous = {
                family = Spd.family,
                carry = Spd.carry
            }
            RT.active = true
        end
        RT.graceUntil = tick() + 0.75
        Spd.carry = true
        paintCarryModes()
    end
    local function softStealInRange(char)
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            return false
        end
        local range = tonumber(_G._VynxAutoSpeedRange) or 15
        local target = _G._VioletteccStealTargetPos or _G._RaVeStealTargetPos
        if typeof(target) == "Vector3" and(root.Position - target).Magnitude <= range then
            return true
        end
        local now = tick()
        if now >= softSteal.nextScan then
            softSteal.nextScan = now + 0.5
            softStealScan()
        end
        for _, spot in ipairs(softSteal.spots) do
            if (root.Position - spot).Magnitude <= range then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function startAutoSpeed()
        if RT.conn then
            RT.conn:Disconnect()
        end
        RT.conn = hubConnect(RunService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not _G._VynxAutoSpeedOn then
                disableAutoCarrySpeed();
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not char or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                disableAutoCarrySpeed();
                return
            end
            if _G._VynxAutoSpeedMode == "On Near" then
                local inRange = softStealInRange(char)
                local carrying = isCarryingBrainrot(char)
                if not inRange then
                    softSteal.armed = true
                end
                if not inRange or Spd.carry ~= true then
                    softSteal.latched = false
                end
                if inRange and softSteal.armed and not softSteal.latched then
                    softSteal.latched = true
                    softSteal.held = false
                    softStealApply()
                end
                if RT.active then
                    if carrying then
                        softSteal.held = true
                        RT.graceUntil = tick() + 0.75
                    elseif softSteal.held then
                        softSteal.held = false
                        softSteal.latched = false
                        softSteal.armed = false
                        disableAutoCarrySpeed()
                    elseif not inRange and tick() > RT.graceUntil then
                        softSteal.latched = false
                        disableAutoCarrySpeed()
                    end
                end
                return
            end
            if isCarryingBrainrot(char) then
                enableAutoCarrySpeed()
            elseif RT.active then
                disableAutoCarrySpeed()
            end
        end))
    end
    local function stopAutoSpeed()
        if RT.conn then
            RT.conn:Disconnect();
            RT.conn = nil
        end
        softSteal.latched, softSteal.held, softSteal.armed = false, false, true
        disableAutoCarrySpeed()
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function()
        softSteal.latched, softSteal.held, softSteal.armed = false, false, true
    end)
    _G._VioletteccStartAutoSpeed = startAutoSpeed
    _G._VioletteccStopAutoSpeed = stopAutoSpeed
    _G._AdaptStartAutoCarry = startAutoSpeed
    _G._AdaptStopAutoCarry = stopAutoSpeed
    _G._CandyIsCarrying = isCarryingBrainrot
    _G.AutoCarrySpeed = {
        IsCarryingBrainrot = isCarryingBrainrot,
        Enable = enableAutoCarrySpeed,
        Disable = disableAutoCarrySpeed,
    }
    _G._VioletteccAutoSpeedRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            stopAutoSpeed()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccAutoSpeedRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    startAutoSpeed()
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccAntiRagdollRuntime and _G._VioletteccAntiRagdollRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAntiRagdollRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local AntiRagdoll = {
        Enabled = false,
        Connection = nil,
        ResetCooldown = 0,
    }
    local function arIsRagdolled()
        local char = LP.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then
            return false
        end
        local state = hum:GetState()
        return state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    end
    local function arStart()
        if AntiRagdoll.Connection then
            return
        end
        AntiRagdoll.Enabled = true
        AntiRagdoll.Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not Enabled.AntiRagdoll then
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            if _G.dropActive then
                return
            end
            local state, now = hum:GetState(), tick()
            if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
                if now - AntiRagdoll.ResetCooldown > 0.15 then
                    AntiRagdoll.ResetCooldown = now
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                        root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
                        root.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                            if obj:IsA("Motor6D") then
                                obj.Enabled = true
                            end
                            if obj:IsA("Constraint") then
                                obj.Enabled = true
                            end
                        end
                        workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = hum
                        local PM = LP.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
                        if PM then
                            local CM = require(PM:FindFirstChild("ControlModule"))
                            if CM then
                                CM:Enable()
                            end
                        end
                        hum.AutoRotate = true
                        hum.PlatformStand = false
                        hum.Sit = false
                    end)
                end
            end
        end))
    end
    local function arStop()
        AntiRagdoll.Enabled = false
        if AntiRagdoll.Connection then
            AntiRagdoll.Connection:Disconnect()
            AntiRagdoll.Connection = nil
        end
        AntiRagdoll.ResetCooldown = 0
    end
    local _rebindConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        if not Enabled.AntiRagdoll then
            return
        end
        if AntiRagdoll.Connection then
            AntiRagdoll.Connection:Disconnect()
            AntiRagdoll.Connection = nil
        end
        arStart()
    end)
    startAntiRagdoll = arStart
    stopAntiRagdoll = arStop
    _G._VioletteccStartAntiRagdoll = arStart
    _G._VioletteccStopAntiRagdoll = arStop
    _G._VioletteccAntiRagdollRuntime = {
        IsRagdolled = arIsRagdolled,
        Destroy = function()
            arStop()
            pcall(function()
                _rebindConn:Disconnect()
            end)
            _G._VioletteccAntiRagdollRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if Enabled.AntiRagdoll then
        arStart()
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccAutoStealRuntime and _G._VioletteccAutoStealRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAutoStealRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    _G._KawatanStealRadii = _G._KawatanStealRadii or {}
    local StealRadii = _G._KawatanStealRadii
    StealRadii.Normal = tonumber(_G._VynxStealRadiusNormal) or tonumber(Settings.StealRadius) or 62
    local function stealMode()
        return "Normal"
    end
    local function autoStealOn()
        return Enabled.AutoSteal == true
    end
    local function stealDuration()
        return tonumber(Settings.StealDuration) or STEAL_DURATION_FIXED
    end
    _G.K7NormalSteal = _G.K7NormalSteal or {}
    local NormalSteal = _G.K7NormalSteal
    NormalSteal.enabled = false
    NormalSteal.radius = StealRadii.Normal
    NormalSteal.duration = STEAL_DURATION_FIXED
    NormalSteal.delayRadius = tonumber(_G._VynxStealDelayRadius) or tonumber(NormalSteal.delayRadius) or 9 do
        local pause = tonumber(_G._VynxAutoGrabPause) or 75
        local dur = tonumber(STEAL_DURATION_FIXED) or 1.30
        NormalSteal.stopTime = tonumber(NormalSteal.stopTime) or(dur *(pause / 100))
    end
    NormalSteal.stopEnabled =(NormalSteal.stopEnabled ~= false)
    _G._VynxAutoStealVersion =(_G._VynxAutoStealVersion == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
    _G._VynxVioletteStealRadius = tonumber(_G._VynxVioletteStealRadius) or 55
    NormalSteal.data = NormalSteal.data or {}
    NormalSteal.isStealing = false
    NormalSteal.stealConn = nil
    local _normalPlotsCache = nil
    local _normalPlotsCacheTime = 0
    local function _normalGetPlotsRoot()
        local now = tick()
        if _normalPlotsCache and now - _normalPlotsCacheTime < 2 and _normalPlotsCache.Parent then
            return _normalPlotsCache
        end
        _normalPlotsCache = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        _normalPlotsCacheTime = now
        return _normalPlotsCache
    end
    local function _normalIsMyBase(plotName)
        local plotsRoot = _normalGetPlotsRoot()
        if not plotsRoot then
            return false
        end
        local plot = plotsRoot:FindFirstChild(plotName)
        if not plot then
            return false
        end
        local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        if sign then
            local yourBase = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
            if yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") then
                return yourBase.Enabled == true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function _normalFindNearestPrompt()
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local plotsRoot = _normalGetPlotsRoot()
        if not plotsRoot then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local A = _G.K7NormalSteal
        local radius = tonumber(A.radius) or StealRadii.Normal or 62
        local nearestPrompt, nearestDist, nearestName = nil, math.huge, nil
        local rpos = root.Position
        for _, plot in ipairs(plotsRoot:GetChildren()) do
            if _normalIsMyBase(plot.Name) then
                continue
            end
            local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
            if not podiums then
                continue
            end
            for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
                pcall(function()
                    local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
                    local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                    if spawn then
                        local sp = spawn.Position
                        local dx = sp.X - rpos.X
                        local dy = sp.Y - rpos.Y
                        local dz = sp.Z - rpos.Z
                        local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
                        if dist < nearestDist and dist <= radius then
                            local attach = spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                            if attach then
                                for _, child in ipairs(attach:GetChildren()) do
                                    if child:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and child.ActionText and child.ActionText:find("Steal") then
                                        nearestPrompt = child
                                        nearestDist = dist
                                        nearestName = podium.Name
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        return nearestPrompt, nearestName
    end
    local function _violettePromptDistance(prompt)
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and(char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
        if not root or not prompt then
            return math.huge
        end
        local part = prompt.Parent
        if part and part:IsA("Attachment") then
            part = part.Parent
        end
        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            return(part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
        end
        local ok, pos = pcall(function()
            return prompt.Parent and prompt.Parent.WorldPosition
        end)
        return(ok and pos) and(pos - root.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
    end
    local function _violetteFindNearestPrompt()
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and(char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
        local plotsRoot = _normalGetPlotsRoot()
        if not root or not plotsRoot then
            return nil, nil
        end
        local radius = tonumber(_G._VynxVioletteStealRadius) or 55
        local nearest, nearestDist, nearestName = nil, math.huge, nil
        for _, plot in ipairs(plotsRoot:GetChildren()) do
            if not _normalIsMyBase(plot.Name) then
                local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
                if podiums then
                    for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
                        local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
                        local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                        if spawn then
                            local dist =(spawn.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                            if dist <= radius and dist < nearestDist then
                                local found
                                local attachment = spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                                if attachment then
                                    for _, item in ipairs(attachment:GetChildren()) do
                                        if item:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and item.ActionText and item.ActionText:find("Steal") then
                                            found = item
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                if not found then
                                    for _, item in ipairs(spawn:GetDescendants()) do
                                        if item:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and item.ActionText and item.ActionText:find("Steal") then
                                            found = item
                                            break
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                if found then
                                    nearest, nearestDist, nearestName = found, dist, podium.Name
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearest, nearestName
    end
    local function _normalResetBar()
        pcall(function()
            if _G.StealBar then
                _G.StealBar.Reset()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function _normalSetProgress(progress)
        pcall(function()
            if _G.StealBar then
                _G.StealBar.SetState("STEALING")
                _G.StealBar.SetProgress(math.clamp(tonumber(progress) or 0, 0, 1))
            end
        end)
    end
    local function _normalExecuteSteal(prompt, podName)
        local A = _G.K7NormalSteal
        if A.isStealing or not prompt then
            return
        end
        if math.random(30) == 1 then
            for p in pairs(A.data) do
                if not p.Parent then
                    A.data[p] = nil
                end
            end
        end
        if not A.data[prompt] then
            A.data[prompt] = {
                hold = {},
                trigger = {},
                ready = true
            }
            pcall(function()
                if getconnections then
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
                        if c.Function then
                            table.insert(A.data[prompt].hold, c.Function)
                        end
                    end
                    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
                        if c.Function then
                            table.insert(A.data[prompt].trigger, c.Function)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local data = A.data[prompt]
        if not data.ready then
            return
        end
        data.ready = false
        A.isStealing = true
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, f in ipairs(data.hold) do
                task.spawn(f)
            end
            if _G._VynxAutoStealVersion == "V2" then
                local started = tick()
                local holdMin = 1.3
                local holdMax = 2.6
                local fireRange = 10
                local entryDelay = 0.1
                task.wait(holdMin)
                _normalSetProgress(math.clamp((tick() - started) / 0.2, 0, 1))
                local inRange = _violettePromptDistance(prompt) <= fireRange
                while true do
                    local elapsed = tick() - started
                    _normalSetProgress(math.clamp(elapsed / 0.2, 0, 1))
                    if elapsed > holdMax or not prompt.Parent then
                        break
                    end
                    if _violettePromptDistance(prompt) <= fireRange then
                        if not inRange then
                            task.wait(entryDelay)
                        end
                        for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do
                            task.spawn(fn)
                        end
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                task.wait(0.05)
                _normalResetBar()
                data.ready = true
                A.isStealing = false
                return
            end
            local startTime = tick()
            local duration = tonumber(A.duration) or stealDuration()
            local promptFired = false
            if A.stopEnabled then
                while A.isStealing and A.enabled and stealMode() == "Normal" do
                    local elapsed = tick() - startTime
                    if elapsed >=(tonumber(A.stopTime) or 0.96) then
                        break
                    end
                    _normalSetProgress(math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1))
                    if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then
                        break
                    end
                    local char = LP.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp and(hrp.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude >(tonumber(A.radius) or 62) then
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                local stopTime = tonumber(A.stopTime) or 0.96
                local stopProgress = math.clamp(stopTime / duration, 0, 1)
                _normalSetProgress(stopProgress)
                local phase2Timeout = math.max(2.99 - stopTime - math.max(duration - stopTime, 0), 0.05)
                local phase2Start = tick()
                while A.isStealing and A.enabled and stealMode() == "Normal" do
                    if tick() - phase2Start >= phase2Timeout then
                        _normalResetBar()
                        data.ready = true
                        A.isStealing = false
                        task.wait()
                        local newPrompt, newName = _normalFindNearestPrompt()
                        if newPrompt then
                            _normalExecuteSteal(newPrompt, newName)
                        end
                        return
                    end
                    if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then
                        A.isStealing = false
                        _normalResetBar()
                        data.ready = true
                        return
                    end
                    local char = LP.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp then
                        local dist =(hrp.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude
                        if dist <=(tonumber(_G._VynxStealDelayRadius) or tonumber(A.delayRadius) or 9) then
                            break
                        elseif dist >(tonumber(A.radius) or 62) then
                            A.isStealing = false
                            _normalResetBar()
                            data.ready = true
                            return
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                if A.isStealing and A.enabled and stealMode() == "Normal" then
                    local fillStart = tick()
                    local fillDuration = math.max(duration - stopTime, 0.05)
                    while true do
                        local fp = math.clamp((tick() - fillStart) / fillDuration, 0, 1)
                        local totalProgress = stopProgress + fp *(1 - stopProgress)
                        _normalSetProgress(totalProgress)
                        if fp >= 1 and not promptFired then
                            promptFired = true
                            pcall(function()
                                for _, f in ipairs(data.trigger) do
                                    task.spawn(f)
                                end
                                local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("StealAnimal")
                                if remote and podName then
                                    remote:FireServer(podName)
                                end
                                if prompt then
                                    prompt:Fire()
                                end
                            end)
                            break
                        end
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            else
                while A.isStealing and A.enabled and stealMode() == "Normal" do
                    local elapsed = tick() - startTime
                    _normalSetProgress(math.clamp(elapsed / duration, 0, 1))
                    if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then
                        break
                    end
                    local char = LP.Character
                    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if hrp and(hrp.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude >(tonumber(A.radius) or 62) then
                        break
                    end
                    if elapsed >= duration and not promptFired then
                        promptFired = true
                        pcall(function()
                            for _, f in ipairs(data.trigger) do
                                task.spawn(f)
                            end
                            local remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("StealAnimal")
                            if remote and podName then
                                remote:FireServer(podName)
                            end
                            if prompt then
                                prompt:Fire()
                            end
                        end)
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
            end
            _normalResetBar()
            data.ready = true
            A.isStealing = false
        end)
    end
    _G.K7NormalAutoStealStop = function()
        local A = _G.K7NormalSteal
        A.enabled = false
        A.isStealing = false
        if A.stealConn then
            A.stealConn:Disconnect();
            A.stealConn = nil
        end
        _normalResetBar()
    end
    _G.K7NormalAutoStealStart = function()
        local A = _G.K7NormalSteal
        A.radius =(_G._VynxAutoStealVersion == "V2") and(tonumber(_G._VynxVioletteStealRadius) or 55) or(tonumber(Settings.StealRadius) or StealRadii.Normal)
        A.duration =(_G._VynxAutoStealVersion == "V2") and 0.2 or stealDuration()
        A.enabled = true
        if A.stealConn then
            A.stealConn:Disconnect();
            A.stealConn = nil
        end
        A.stealConn = hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not A.enabled then
                return
            end
            if stealMode() ~= "Normal" then
                _G.K7NormalAutoStealStop();
                return
            end
            if _G._VynxAutoStealVersion == "V2" then
                A.radius = tonumber(_G._VynxVioletteStealRadius) or 55
                A.duration = 0.2
            else
                A.radius = tonumber(Settings.StealRadius) or A.radius
                A.duration = stealDuration()
            end
            if A.isStealing then
                return
            end
            local prompt, podName
            if _G._VynxAutoStealVersion == "V2" then
                prompt, podName = _violetteFindNearestPrompt()
            else
                prompt, podName = _normalFindNearestPrompt()
            end
            if prompt then
                _normalExecuteSteal(prompt, podName)
            end
        end))
    end
    _G.K7NormalAutoStealSync = function()
        if stealMode() == "Normal" and autoStealOn() then
            _G.K7NormalAutoStealStart()
        else
            _G.K7NormalAutoStealStop()
        end
    end
    _G.K7SemiSteal = _G.K7SemiSteal or {}
    local AS = _G.K7SemiSteal
    AS.enabled = false
    AS.holdMin = 1.3
    AS.holdMax = 2.6
    AS.entryDelay = 0.3
    AS.cooldown = 0.05
    AS.primeRange = 80
    AS.radius = StealRadii.Semi
    AS.plotSync = AS.plotSync or {
        caches = {},
        connections = {}
    }
    AS.animals = AS.animals or {}
    AS.promptCache = AS.promptCache or {}
    AS.internalCache = AS.internalCache or {}
    AS.state = AS.state or {
        active = false,
        startTime = 0,
        phase = "idle",
        label = "",
        lastResult = "",
        lastResultTime = 0
    }
    local function _semiBarSet(p, label)
        pcall(function()
            if _G.StealBar then
                _G.StealBar.SetState(label or "STEALING")
                _G.StealBar.SetProgress(math.clamp(tonumber(p) or 0, 0, 1))
            end
        end)
    end
    local function _semiBarReset()
        pcall(function()
            if _G.StealBar then
                _G.StealBar.Reset()
            end
        end)
    end
    local function _semiRoot()
        local c = LP.Character
        return c and(c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) or nil
    end
    local function _splitPath(path)
        if typeof(path) == "table" then
            return path
        end
        local out = {}
        for p in string.gmatch(tostring(path), "[^%.]+") do
            table.insert(out, tonumber(p) or p)
        end
        return out
    end
    local function _resolvePath(path, root)
        local cur, par, key = root, nil, nil
        for _, p in ipairs(_splitPath(path)) do
            par = cur;
            key = p;
            cur = cur and cur[p] or nil
        end
        return cur, par, key
    end
    local function _applyDiff(channelName, packet)
        local cache = AS.plotSync.caches[channelName]
        if typeof(cache) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        local path, action, a, b = packet[1], packet[2], packet[3], packet[4]
        local cur, par, key = _resolvePath(path, cache)
        if action == "Changed" then
            if par then
                par[key] = a
            end
        elseif action == "ArrayInsert" then
            if cur then
                table.insert(cur, b, a)
            end
        elseif action == "ArrayRemoved" then
            if cur then
                table.remove(cur, b)
            end
        elseif action == "DictionaryInsert" then
            if cur then
                cur[b] = a
            end
        elseif action == "DictionaryRemoved" then
            if cur then
                cur[b] = nil
            end
        end
    end
    local function _semiAttachChannel(remote, plots, requestData)
        if AS.plotSync.connections[remote] then
            return
        end
        local channelName = tostring(remote.Name)
        if not plots:FindFirstChild(channelName) then
            return
        end
        if requestData and AS.plotSync.caches[channelName] == nil then
            local ok, data = pcall(function()
                return requestData:InvokeServer(channelName)
            end)
            AS.plotSync.caches[channelName] =(ok and typeof(data) == "table") and data or {}
        elseif AS.plotSync.caches[channelName] == nil then
            AS.plotSync.caches[channelName] = {}
        end
        AS.plotSync.connections[remote] = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(queue)
            for _, packet in ipairs(queue) do
                _applyDiff(channelName, packet)
            end
        end)
    end
    local function _semiEnsureSync()
        if AS.syncReady then
            return true
        end
        local ok = pcall(function()
            AS.plots = workspace:WaitForChild("Plots", 10)
            local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local pkgs = rs:WaitForChild("Packages", 10)
            local datas = rs:WaitForChild("Datas", 10)
            if not(pkgs and datas and AS.plots) then
                return
            end
            AS.animalsData = require(datas:WaitForChild("Animals", 10))
            local sync = pkgs:WaitForChild("Synchronizer", 10)
            AS.channelFolder = sync:WaitForChild("Channel", 10)
            AS.routeRemote = sync:WaitForChild("CommunicationRoute", 10)
            AS.requestData = sync:FindFirstChild("RequestData")
            for _, child in ipairs(AS.channelFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    _semiAttachChannel(child, AS.plots, AS.requestData)
                end
            end
            AS.channelFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    _semiAttachChannel(child, AS.plots, AS.requestData)
                end
            end)
            AS.routeRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(actions)
                for _, action in ipairs(actions) do
                    local kind, cn = action[1], tostring(action[2])
                    if AS.plots and AS.plots:FindFirstChild(cn) then
                        if kind == "ListenerAdded" then
                            local r = AS.channelFolder and AS.channelFolder:FindFirstChild(cn)
                            if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                                _semiAttachChannel(r, AS.plots, AS.requestData)
                            end
                        elseif kind == "ListenerRemoved" then
                            for remote, conn in pairs(AS.plotSync.connections) do
                                if tostring(remote.Name) == cn then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        conn:Disconnect()
                                    end)
                                    AS.plotSync.connections[remote] = nil
                                    AS.plotSync.caches[cn] = nil
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            AS.syncReady = true
        end)
        return ok and AS.syncReady == true
    end
    local function _semiPlotOwner(plot)
        local sign = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
        local frame = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") and sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
        local label = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
        if not label or label.Text == "Empty Base" then
            return nil
        end
        return label.Text:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    end
    local function _semiIsMyBase(animalData)
        if not animalData or not animalData.plot or not AS.plots then
            return false
        end
        local plot = AS.plots:FindFirstChild(animalData.plot)
        if not plot then
            return false
        end
        local owner = _semiPlotOwner(plot)
        return owner == LP.DisplayName or owner == LP.Name
    end
    local function _semiPodiumFor(animalData)
        local plot = AS.plots and AS.plots:FindFirstChild(animalData.plot)
        local pds = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        return pds and pds:FindFirstChild(animalData.slot) or nil
    end
    local function _semiAnimalPos(animalData)
        local pod = _semiPodiumFor(animalData)
        return pod and pod:GetPivot().Position or nil
    end
    local function _semiDistToAnimal(animalData)
        local root = _semiRoot()
        local pos = _semiAnimalPos(animalData)
        return root and pos and(root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
    end
    local function _semiFindPrompt(animalData)
        if not animalData then
            return nil
        end
        local cached = AS.promptCache[animalData.uid]
        if cached and cached.Parent then
            return cached
        end
        local pod = _semiPodiumFor(animalData)
        local base = pod and pod:FindFirstChild("Base")
        local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
        local attach = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
        if not attach then
            return nil
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(attach:GetChildren()) do
            if p:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
                AS.promptCache[animalData.uid] = p;
                return p
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function _semiBuildCallbacks(prompt)
        if AS.internalCache[prompt] then
            return
        end
        local data = {
            holdCallbacks = {},
            triggerCallbacks = {},
            ready = true
        }
        local okH, holds = pcall(getconnections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
        if okH and type(holds) == "table" then
            for _, c in ipairs(holds) do
                if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                    table.insert(data.holdCallbacks, c.Function)
                end
            end
        end
        local okT, triggers = pcall(getconnections, prompt.Triggered)
        if okT and type(triggers) == "table" then
            for _, c in ipairs(triggers) do
                if type(c.Function) == "function" then
                    table.insert(data.triggerCallbacks, c.Function)
                end
            end
        end
        if # data.holdCallbacks > 0 or # data.triggerCallbacks > 0 then
            AS.internalCache[prompt] = data
        end
    end
    local function _semiExecute(prompt, animalData)
        if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not animalData then
            return false
        end
        if AS.state.active then
            return false
        end
        if tick() -(AS.state.lastResultTime or 0) <(AS.cooldown or 0.05) then
            return false
        end
        _semiBuildCallbacks(prompt)
        local data = AS.internalCache[prompt]
        if not data or not data.ready then
            return false
        end
        data.ready = false;
        AS.state.active = true
        AS.state.startTime = tick();
        AS.state.phase = "holding"
        AS.state.label = animalData.name or "Animal"
        task.spawn(function()
            local t0 = AS.state.startTime
            for _, fn in ipairs(data.holdCallbacks) do
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(fn)
                end)
            end
            while AS.enabled and stealMode() == "Semi" and tick() - t0 <(AS.holdMin or 1.3) do
                _semiBarSet((tick() - t0) /(AS.holdMax or 2.6), "STEALING")
                task.wait()
            end
            AS.state.phase = "waitingRange"
            local alreadyInRange = _semiDistToAnimal(animalData) <=(tonumber(AS.radius) or 10)
            local fired = false
            while AS.enabled and stealMode() == "Semi" and prompt.Parent do
                local elapsed = tick() - t0
                if elapsed >(AS.holdMax or 2.6) then
                    break
                end
                _semiBarSet(elapsed /(AS.holdMax or 2.6), "STEALING")
                if _semiDistToAnimal(animalData) <=(tonumber(AS.radius) or 10) then
                    if not alreadyInRange then
                        task.wait(AS.entryDelay or 0.3)
                    end
                    if AS.enabled and stealMode() == "Semi" then
                        for _, fn in ipairs(data.triggerCallbacks) do
                            task.spawn(function()
                                pcall(fn)
                            end)
                        end
                        fired = true
                    end
                    break
                end
                task.wait()
            end
            AS.state.lastResult = fired and("Stole " .. tostring(AS.state.label)) or("Missed: " .. tostring(AS.state.label))
            AS.state.active = false;
            AS.state.phase = "idle";
            AS.state.lastResultTime = tick()
            if fired then
                _semiBarSet(1, "STEALING")
            end
            task.wait(AS.cooldown or 0.05)
            data.ready = true
            _semiBarReset()
        end)
        return true
    end
    local function _semiScanAllPlots()
        if not _semiEnsureSync() then
            return 0
        end
        local newCache = {}
        for _, plot in ipairs(AS.plots:GetChildren()) do
            local cache = AS.plotSync.caches[plot.Name]
            local animalList = cache and cache.AnimalList
            if typeof(animalList) == "table" then
                for slot, animalData in pairs(animalList) do
                    if type(animalData) == "table" then
                        local animalName = animalData.Index
                        local info = AS.animalsData and AS.animalsData[animalName]
                        if info then
                            table.insert(newCache, {
                                name = info.DisplayName or animalName,
                                plot = plot.Name,
                                slot = tostring(slot),
                                uid = plot.Name .. "_" .. tostring(slot),
                            })
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        AS.animals = newCache
        return # newCache
    end
    local function _semiPickClosest()
        local root = _semiRoot()
        if not root then
            return nil
        end
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, data in ipairs(AS.animals) do
            if not _semiIsMyBase(data) then
                local pos = _semiAnimalPos(data)
                local dist = pos and(root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
                if dist <=(AS.primeRange or 80) and dist < bestDist then
                    best, bestDist = data, dist
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function _semiEnsureScanThread()
        if AS.scanThread then
            return
        end
        AS.scanThread = task.spawn(function()
            while _G.K7SemiSteal do
                if AS.enabled or stealMode() == "Semi" then
                    pcall(_semiScanAllPlots)
                end
                task.wait(5)
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.K7SemiAutoStealStop = function()
        AS.enabled = false
        if AS.conn then
            AS.conn:Disconnect();
            AS.conn = nil
        end
        AS.state.active = false;
        AS.state.phase = "idle"
        _semiBarReset()
    end

            _G.K7SemiAutoStealSync()
        end
    end

    end

        startAutoStealByMode()
    end
    stopAutoSteal = function()
        Enabled.AutoSteal = false
        Settings.AutoStealEnabled = false
        stopAllAutoSteal()
    end

                end)

        end,
    }
    if Enabled.AutoSteal then
        startAutoStealByMode()
    end

(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccAnimPackRuntime and _G._VioletteccAnimPackRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAnimPackRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    _G._VynxAnimPack = _G._VynxAnimPack or "Off"
    _G._AdaptAnimPack = _G._VynxAnimPack
    _G._AdaptUnwalk = _G._AdaptUnwalk or {
        enabled = false,
        savedAnimate = nil
    }
    _G._AdaptStartUnwalk = function()
        local c = LP.Character;
        if not c then
            return
        end
        local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            for _, t in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                pcall(function()
                    t:Stop()
                end)
            end
        end
        local anim = c:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if anim then
            _G._AdaptUnwalk.savedAnimate = anim:Clone();
            anim:Destroy()
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptStopUnwalk = function()
        _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled = false
        local c = LP.Character
        if c and _G._AdaptUnwalk.savedAnimate then
            _G._AdaptUnwalk.savedAnimate:Clone().Parent = c
            _G._AdaptUnwalk.savedAnimate = nil
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptTryHard = _G._AdaptTryHard or {
        enabled = false,
        conn = nil,
        originalAnims = nil
    }
    _G._AdaptApplyTryHard = function()
        local Anims = {
            idle1 = "rbxassetid://133806214992291",
            idle2 = "rbxassetid://94970088341563",
            walk = "rbxassetid://707897309",
            run = "rbxassetid://707861613",
            jump = "rbxassetid://116936326516985",
            fall = "rbxassetid://116936326516985",
            climb = "rbxassetid://116936326516985",
            swim = "rbxassetid://116936326516985",
            swimidle = "rbxassetid://116936326516985",
        }
        local function isPackAnim(id)
            if not id then
                return false
            end
            for _, v in pairs(Anims) do
                if v == id then
                    return true
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function _saveOriginalAnims(char)
            local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate");
            if not animate then
                return
            end
            local function g(obj)
                return obj and obj.AnimationId or nil
            end
            local ids = {
                idle1 = g(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation1),
                idle2 = g(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation2),
                walk = g(animate.walk and animate.walk.WalkAnim),
                run = g(animate.run and animate.run.RunAnim),
                jump = g(animate.jump and animate.jump.JumpAnim),
                fall = g(animate.fall and animate.fall.FallAnim),
                climb = g(animate.climb and animate.climb.ClimbAnim),
                swim = g(animate.swim and animate.swim.Swim),
                swimidle = g(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle.SwimIdle),
            }
            if not isPackAnim(ids.walk) then
                _G._AdaptTryHard.originalAnims = ids
            end
        end
        local function _applyAnimPack(char)
            local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate");
            if not animate then
                return
            end
            local function s(obj, id)
                if obj and obj.AnimationId ~= id then
                    obj.AnimationId = id
                end
            end
            s(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation1, Anims.idle1)
            s(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation2, Anims.idle2)
            s(animate.walk and animate.walk.WalkAnim, Anims.walk)
            s(animate.run and animate.run.RunAnim, Anims.run)
            s(animate.jump and animate.jump.JumpAnim, Anims.jump)
            s(animate.fall and animate.fall.FallAnim, Anims.fall)
            s(animate.climb and animate.climb.ClimbAnim, Anims.climb)
            s(animate.swim and animate.swim.Swim, Anims.swim)
            s(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle.SwimIdle, Anims.swimidle)
        end
        if _G._AdaptTryHard.conn then
            _G._AdaptTryHard.conn:Disconnect();
            _G._AdaptTryHard.conn = nil
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        if char then
            _saveOriginalAnims(char);
            _applyAnimPack(char)
            local hum2 = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum2 then
                for _, track in ipairs(hum2:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                    pcall(function()
                        track:Stop(0)
                    end)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    hum2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end)
            end
        end
        _G._AdaptTryHard.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local c = LP.Character;
            if c then
                _applyAnimPack(c)
            end
        end))
        _G._AdaptTryHardSave = _saveOriginalAnims
        _G._AdaptTryHardApplyPack = _applyAnimPack
        saveOriginalAnims = _saveOriginalAnims
        applyAnimPack = _applyAnimPack
    end
    _G._AdaptStopTryHard = function()
        _G._AdaptTryHard.enabled = false
        if _G._AdaptTryHard.conn then
            _G._AdaptTryHard.conn:Disconnect();
            _G._AdaptTryHard.conn = nil
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        local orig = _G._AdaptTryHard.originalAnims
        if animate and orig then
            local function s(obj, id)
                if obj and id then
                    obj.AnimationId = id
                end
            end
            s(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation1, orig.idle1)
            s(animate.idle and animate.idle.Animation2, orig.idle2)
            s(animate.walk and animate.walk.WalkAnim, orig.walk)
            s(animate.run and animate.run.RunAnim, orig.run)
            s(animate.jump and animate.jump.JumpAnim, orig.jump)
            s(animate.fall and animate.fall.FallAnim, orig.fall)
            s(animate.climb and animate.climb.ClimbAnim, orig.climb)
            s(animate.swim and animate.swim.Swim, orig.swim)
            s(animate.swimidle and animate.swimidle.SwimIdle, orig.swimidle)
        end
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            for _, t in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                pcall(function()
                    t:Stop(0)
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    _G._RaVeApplyAnimationPack = function(name)
        name = name or "Off"
        _G._AdaptAnimPack = name
        _G._VynxAnimPack = name
        local char = LP.Character
        local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if not animate then
            return
        end
        local function ref(folder, child)
            local f = animate:FindFirstChild(folder);
            return f and f:FindFirstChild(child)
        end
        local refs = {
            ref("idle",
            "Animation1"),
            ref("idle",
            "Animation2"),
            ref("walk",
            "WalkAnim"),
            ref("run",
            "RunAnim"),
            ref("jump",
            "JumpAnim"),
            ref("fall",
            "FallAnim"),
            ref("climb",
            "ClimbAnim")
        }
        if not _G._RaVeAnimationOriginals[char] then
            local original = {}
            for i, a in ipairs(refs) do
                original[i] = a and a.AnimationId or nil
            end
            _G._RaVeAnimationOriginals[char] = original
        end
        local values = _G._RaVeAnimationOriginals[char]
        local pack = _G._RaVeAnimationPacks[name]
        if pack then
            values = {
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[1][1],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[1][2],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[2],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[3],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[4],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[5],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[6]
            }
        end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            for _, track in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                pcall(function()
                    track:Stop(0)
                end)
            end
        end
        for i, a in ipairs(refs) do
            if a and values and values[i] then
                a.AnimationId = values[i]
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            animate.Disabled = true;
            task.wait();
            animate.Disabled = false
        end)
    end
    _G._RaVeApplySelectedAnimation = function(name)
        name = name or "Off"
        if _G._AdaptUnwalk and _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled and name ~= "Unwalk" then
            _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled = false
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopUnwalk)
        end
        if _G._AdaptTryHard and _G._AdaptTryHard.enabled and name ~= "Try Hard" then
            _G._AdaptTryHard.enabled = false
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopTryHard)
        end
        if name == "Unwalk" then
            _G._AdaptAnimPack = "Unwalk";
            _G._VynxAnimPack = "Unwalk"
            Enabled.Unwalk = true
            if _G._AdaptUnwalk then
                _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled = true
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(_G._AdaptStartUnwalk)
            end)
            return
        end
        Enabled.Unwalk = false
        if name == "Try Hard" then
            _G._AdaptAnimPack = "Try Hard";
            _G._VynxAnimPack = "Try Hard"
            if _G._AdaptTryHard then
                _G._AdaptTryHard.enabled = true
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(_G._AdaptApplyTryHard)
            end)
            return
        end
        pcall(_G._RaVeApplyAnimationPack, name)
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function(char)
        if _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled then
            task.wait(0.5);
            pcall(_G._AdaptStartUnwalk)
        end
        if _G._AdaptTryHard.enabled then
            task.wait(0.5)
            if _G._AdaptTryHardSave then
                pcall(_G._AdaptTryHardSave, char)
            end
            if _G._AdaptTryHardApplyPack then
                pcall(_G._AdaptTryHardApplyPack, char)
            end
        end
        local sel = _G._VynxAnimPack
        if sel and sel ~= "Off" and sel ~= "Unwalk" and sel ~= "Try Hard" then
            task.wait(0.2);
            pcall(_G._RaVeApplyAnimationPack, sel)
        end
    end)
    startUnwalk = function()
        Enabled.Unwalk = true
        _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled = true
        _G._VynxAnimPack = "Unwalk";
        _G._AdaptAnimPack = "Unwalk"
        if _G._VynxRefreshAnimPack then
            pcall(_G._VynxRefreshAnimPack)
        end
        pcall(_G._AdaptStartUnwalk)
    end
    stopUnwalk = function()
        Enabled.Unwalk = false
        pcall(_G._AdaptStopUnwalk)
        if _G._VynxAnimPack == "Unwalk" then
            _G._VynxAnimPack = "Off";
            _G._AdaptAnimPack = "Off"
            if _G._VynxRefreshAnimPack then
                pcall(_G._VynxRefreshAnimPack)
            end
        end
    end

            pcall(_G._RaVeApplySelectedAnimation, _G._VynxAnimPack)
        end)
    end
