        end
    end
    function V2.V11.reset()
        V2.V11.target = nil
        V2.V11.lastTargetPos = nil
        V2.V11.targetVelocity = Vector3.zero
        V2.V11.smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero
        V2.V11.velocityHistory = {}
        V2.V11.accelerationHistory = {}
        V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
        V2.V11.verticalVelocityHistory = {}
        V2.V11.previousDirection = nil
        V2.V11.lastDirectionChangeTime = 0
        V2.V11.airborneTime = 0
        V2.V11.underSince = nil
        V2.V11.lastActivationTime = 0
        V2.V11.lastRelock = 0
        V2.V11.lastPingRefresh = 0
    end
    function V2.V11.refreshPing()
        local now = tick()
        if now - V2.V11.lastPingRefresh < 0.5 then
            return
        end
        V2.V11.lastPingRefresh = now
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
        end)
        if ok and type(value) == "number" then
            V2.V11.realPingMs = math.floor(value)
        end
        V2.V11.currentPing = math.clamp(V2.V11.realPingMs / 1000, V2.V11.cfg.MIN_PING_COMPENSATION, V2.V11.cfg.MAX_PING_COMPENSATION)
    end
    function V2.V11.step(root, target, targetHum, dt)
        local C = V2.V11.cfg
        if V2.V11.target ~= target then
            V2.V11.reset()
            V2.V11.target = target
        end
        local now = tick()
        local targetPos = target.Position
        local frameDt = math.max(dt or(1 / 60), 1 / 240)
        if V2.V11.lastTargetPos then
            local rawVelocity =(targetPos - V2.V11.lastTargetPos) / frameDt
            local velocityDelta = rawVelocity - V2.V11.targetVelocity
            if velocityDelta.Magnitude > C.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE then
                rawVelocity = V2.V11.targetVelocity + velocityDelta.Unit * C.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE
            end
            local horizontal = Vector3.new(rawVelocity.X, 0, rawVelocity.Z)
            if horizontal.Magnitude > C.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY then
                horizontal = horizontal.Unit * C.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY
                rawVelocity = Vector3.new(horizontal.X, rawVelocity.Y, horizontal.Z)
            end
            V2.V11.push(V2.V11.accelerationHistory,(rawVelocity - V2.V11.targetVelocity) / frameDt, 4)
            V2.V11.push(V2.V11.velocityHistory, rawVelocity, 8)
            V2.V11.targetVelocity = rawVelocity
            V2.V11.smoothedVelocity = V2.V11.smoothedVelocity:Lerp(rawVelocity, C.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING)
        end
        V2.V11.lastTargetPos = targetPos
        local airborne = targetHum and targetHum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
        V2.V11.airborneTime = airborne and(V2.V11.airborneTime + frameDt) or 0
        if airborne and V2.V11.airborneTime >= C.MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME then
            V2.V11.push(V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory, V2.V11.targetVelocity, 6)
        elseif not airborne then
            V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
        end
        local predictionVelocity = V2.V11.smoothedVelocity
        if airborne and # V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory > 0 then
            local averageAir = V2.V11.average(V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory)
            predictionVelocity = Vector3.new(averageAir.X, V2.V11.targetVelocity.Y, averageAir.Z) * C.AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR
        end
        local quickTurn = false
        local horizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(V2.V11.targetVelocity.X, 0, V2.V11.targetVelocity.Z)
        if horizontalVelocity.Magnitude > 5 then
            local direction = horizontalVelocity.Unit
            if V2.V11.previousDirection and V2.V11.previousDirection:Dot(direction) < 0.5 then
                quickTurn =(now - V2.V11.lastDirectionChangeTime) < C.DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME
                V2.V11.lastDirectionChangeTime = now
            end
            V2.V11.previousDirection = direction
        end
        local serverDelay = V2.V11.currentPing + C.SERVER_TICKRATE
        if quickTurn then
            serverDelay = serverDelay * C.QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER
        end
        local averageAcceleration = V2.V11.average(V2.V11.accelerationHistory)
        local predicted = targetPos + predictionVelocity * serverDelay + averageAcceleration * C.ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT *(serverDelay * serverDelay * 0.5)
        local predictionTime = C.PREDICTION_TIME * 1.1
        if airborne then
            predicted = predicted + predictionVelocity * predictionTime + Vector3.new(0, - 0.5 * C.GRAVITY * predictionTime * predictionTime, 0)
        else
            predicted = predicted + predictionVelocity * predictionTime
        end
        local flatPrediction = Vector3.new(predictionVelocity.X, 0, predictionVelocity.Z)
        if flatPrediction.Magnitude > 1 then
            predicted = predicted + flatPrediction.Unit * C.PREDICT_AHEAD
        end
        local toTarget = predicted - root.Position
        exoFace(root, toTarget)
        if toTarget.Magnitude > C.MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
            local followSpeed = math.clamp(aimbotSpeed(), 1, 500)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = toTarget.Unit * followSpeed
        else
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y * 0.5, 0)
        end
    end
    local function startBatAimbot()
        _G._AdaptTPMirrorEnabled =(_G._VynxMirrorTPDown == true) or(desyncEnabled == true)
        if Conns.aimbot then
            Conns.aimbot:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbot = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotNew then
            Conns.aimbotNew:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotNew = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotV3 then
            Conns.aimbotV3:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotV3 = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotV11 then
            Conns.aimbotV11:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotV11 = nil
        end
        stopBatV2()
        exoReset()
        if usesV2Loop() then
            startBatV2()
        end
        _G._AdaptNormalAimbot = _G._AdaptNormalAimbot or {
            target = nil,
            swingCooldown = false
        }
        local aimbotState = _G._AdaptNormalAimbot
        aimbotState.target = nil
        aimbotState.swingCooldown = false
        aimbotState.equipped = false
        local hum0 = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum0 then
            hum0.AutoRotate = false
        end
        local root0 = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root0 then
            clearAimbotMoverOn(root0)
        end
        Conns.aimbot = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not aimbotOn() or usesBypassLoop() or usesV3Loop() or usesV2Loop() or usesV4Loop() or _G._VezyBatAimbotMode == "v3" then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                pcall(_G._AceClearAimbotMover);
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root or not hum then
                return
            end
            if not aimbotState.equipped then
                aimbotState.equipped = true
                if not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
                    local b = findBat()
                    if b then
                        pcall(function()
                            hum:EquipTool(b)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            local target = closestPlayerRoot()
            aimbotState.target = target
            if not target then
                local idleBat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or findBat()
                if _G._VioletteccAutoMedusa ~= false and isMedusaTool(idleBat) then
                    return
                end
                if _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and idleBat and idleBat.Parent == char then
                    pcall(function()
                        idleBat:Activate()
                    end)
                end
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            stepVioletteccNormalV2(root, hum, target)
            local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or findBat()
            if tryMedusa(bat, target) then
            elseif _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and bat and bat.Parent == char then
                pcall(function()
                    bat:Activate()
                end)
            end
        end))
        Conns.aimbotNew = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not aimbotOn() or not usesBypassLoop() or usesV3Loop() or usesV4Loop() or _G._VezyBatAimbotMode == "v3" then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                pcall(_G._AceClearAimbotMover);
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then
                return
            end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then
                return
            end
            local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or findBat()
            if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
                pcall(function()
                    hum:EquipTool(bat)
                end)
            elseif not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
                bat = findBat()
                if bat then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:EquipTool(bat)
                    end)
                end
            end
            local target, targetDist = closestPlayerRootAndDist()
            aimbotState.target = target
            if not target then
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                clearAimbotMoverOn(root)
                visBypassReset()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            local inRange = stepVisibleBypass(root, hum, target)
            if tryMedusa(bat, target) then
            elseif inRange and _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and bat and bat.Parent == char then
                local tnow = os.clock()
                if tnow >= VIS.nextSwingAt then
                    VIS.nextSwingAt = tnow + 0.08
                    pcall(function()
                        bat:Activate()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end))
        Conns.aimbotV3 = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not aimbotOn() or(not usesV3Loop() and not usesV4Loop()) then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                pcall(_G._AceClearAimbotMover);
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if not bat then
                bat = findBat()
                if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:EquipTool(bat)
                    end)
                end
            end
            local target, targetDist = closestPlayerRootAndDist()
            aimbotState.target = target
            local targetHum = target and target.Parent and target.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not target or not targetHum then
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                exoReset()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            stepExoticV3(root, target, targetHum, dt)
            if tryMedusa(bat, target) then
            elseif _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and bat and bat.Parent == char and targetDist <= EXO.cfg.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE and os.clock() - EXO.st.lastSwing >= 0.3 then
                EXO.st.lastSwing = os.clock()
                pcall(function()
                    bat:Activate()
                    local re = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                    if re then
                        re:FireServer()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end))
        Conns.aimbotV11 = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not aimbotOn() or _G._VezyBatAimbotMode ~= "v3" then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                pcall(_G._AceClearAimbotMover)
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or findBat()
            if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
                pcall(function()
                    hum:EquipTool(bat)
                end)
            end
            local target, targetDist = closestPlayerRootAndDist()
            local targetHum = target and target.Parent and target.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            aimbotState.target = target
            if not target or not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                V2.V11.reset()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            V2.V11.refreshPing()
            V2.V11.step(root, target, targetHum, dt)
            if tryMedusa(bat, target) then
            elseif _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and bat and bat.Parent == char and targetDist <= V2.V11.cfg.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE and tick() - V2.V11.lastActivationTime >= 0.3 then
                V2.V11.lastActivationTime = tick()
                pcall(function()
                    bat:Activate()
                    local remote = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                    if remote then
                        remote:FireServer()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end))
    end
    local function stopBatAimbot()
        _G._AdaptTPMirrorEnabled =(desyncEnabled == true)
        if Conns.aimbot then
            Conns.aimbot:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbot = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotNew then
            Conns.aimbotNew:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotNew = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotV3 then
            Conns.aimbotV3:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotV3 = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotV11 then
            Conns.aimbotV11:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotV11 = nil
        end
        stopBatV2()
        visBypassReset()
        exoReset()
        V2.V11.reset()
        if _G._AdaptNormalAimbot then
            _G._AdaptNormalAimbot.target = nil
            _G._AdaptNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false
            _G._AdaptNormalAimbot.equipped = false
        end
        local c = LP.Character;
        if not c then
            return
        end
        local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local h2 = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h2 then
            h2.AutoRotate = true
            h2.PlatformStand = false
            pcall(function()
                h2:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                h2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
            end)
        end
        if r then
            clearAimbotMoverOn(r)
            r.Anchored = false
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            if sethiddenproperty then
                pcall(sethiddenproperty, r, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
            end
            local cf = r.CFrame
            local look = cf.LookVector
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, - 1)
            else
                flatLook = flatLook.Unit
            end
            r.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position, cf.Position + flatLook)
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            for i = 1, 12 do
                task.wait(0.05)
                local c2 = LP.Character;
                if not c2 then
                    return
                end
                local r2 = c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h3 = c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if h3 then
                    h3.AutoRotate = true
                    h3.PlatformStand = false
                end
                if r2 then
                    r2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local hitCool = false
    local function tryHitBat()
        if hitCool then
            return
        end;
        hitCool = true
        pcall(function()
            local bat = findBat()
            if bat then
                bat:Activate()
                local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                if ev then
                    ev:FireServer()
                end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.08,
        function()
            hitCool = false
        end)
    end
    local MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD = 3
    local MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y = - 7.00
    local mirrorTPPreviousY = {}
    local mirrorTPLastTeleport = 0
    local function mirrorTPAimbotActive()
        return aimbotOn() or desyncEnabled == true
    end
    local function mirrorTPTeleportDown()
        local character = LP.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return
        end
        local now = tick()
        if now - mirrorTPLastTeleport < 0.08 then
            return
        end
        mirrorTPLastTeleport = now
        local _, yaw = root.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y, root.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
        root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        pcall(function()
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
    end
    local mirrorTPNextCheck = 0
    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local now = tick()
        if now < mirrorTPNextCheck then
            return
        end
        mirrorTPNextCheck = now + 0.10
        if _G._VynxMirrorTPDown ~= true or not mirrorTPAimbotActive() then
            table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
            return
        end
        local character = LP.Character
        local localRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not localRoot then
            return
        end
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LP and player.Character then
                local targetRoot = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if targetRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local dx = targetRoot.Position.X - localRoot.Position.X
                    local dz = targetRoot.Position.Z - localRoot.Position.Z
                    if (dx * dx + dz * dz) <= 64 then
                        local currentY = targetRoot.Position.Y
                        local previousY = mirrorTPPreviousY[player.UserId]
                        if previousY and previousY - currentY >= MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD then
                            pcall(mirrorTPTeleportDown)
                            table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
                        end
                        mirrorTPPreviousY[player.UserId] = currentY
                    else
                        mirrorTPPreviousY[player.UserId] = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end))
    _G.VezyStartBatAimbot = startBatAimbot
    _G.VezyStopBatAimbot = stopBatAimbot
    _G.VezyStartBatAimbotDispatch = startBatAimbot
    _G._AdaptStartBatAimbot = startBatAimbot
    _G._AdaptStopBatAimbot = stopBatAimbot
    _G._AdaptTryHitBat = tryHitBat
    _G._VioletteccFindBat = findBat
    _G._VioletteccBatAimbotRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            pcall(stopBatAimbot)
            _G._VioletteccBypassPingLoopStarted = false
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccBatAimbotRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if aimbotOn() then
        startBatAimbot()
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccDropRuntime and _G._VioletteccDropRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccDropRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local Drop = _G._AdaptDrop or {
        active = false
    }
    _G._AdaptDrop = Drop
    local function dropMode()
        return(_G._VynxDropType == "Stand Drop") and "STAND" or "JUMP"
    end
    local function combatLive()
        return autoBatToggled == true or _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true or desyncEnabled == true
    end
    local findBat = _G._VioletteccFindBat or
    function()
        local char = LP.Character;
        if not char then
            return nil
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") and(t.Name:lower():find("bat") or t.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
                return t
            end
        end
        local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if bp then
            for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and(t.Name:lower():find("bat") or t.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
                    return t
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function closestPlayerRoot()
        local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            return nil
        end
        local best, bd = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                local tr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hm = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if tr and hm and hm.Health > 0 then
                    local d =(tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bd then
                        bd = d;
                        best = tr
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local hitCool = false
    local function tryHitBat()
        if _G._AdaptTryHitBat then
            return _G._AdaptTryHitBat()
        end
        if hitCool then
            return
        end;
        hitCool = true
        pcall(function()
            local bat = findBat()
            if bat then
                bat:Activate()
                local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                if ev then
                    ev:FireServer()
                end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.08,
        function()
            hitCool = false
        end)
    end
    local JUMP_ASCEND_DURATION, JUMP_ASCEND_SPEED = 0.18, 155
    local function runDropJump()
        if Drop.active then
            return
        end
        Drop.active = true
        _G._RaVeDropToken =(_G._RaVeDropToken or 0) + 1
        local dropToken = _G._RaVeDropToken
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not char or not root then
            Drop.active = false;
            return
        end
        local rayParams = _G._RaVeDropRayParams
        if not rayParams then
            rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
            rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            pcall(function()
                rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true
            end)
            _G._RaVeDropRayParams = rayParams
        end
        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
            char
        }
        local initialFloor = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0), Vector3.new(0, - 2000, 0), rayParams)
        if not initialFloor then
            Drop.active = false;
            return
        end
        local savedRotation = root.CFrame.Rotation
        local savedX, savedZ = root.Position.X, root.Position.Z
        local startedAt = tick()
        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local r = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if dropToken ~= _G._RaVeDropToken or not r or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                conn:Disconnect()
                Drop.active = false
                return
            end
            if tick() - startedAt >= JUMP_ASCEND_DURATION then
                conn:Disconnect()
                rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                    char
                }
                local rayResult = workspace:Raycast(r.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0), Vector3.new(0, - 2000, 0), rayParams)
                local surface = rayResult or initialFloor
                if surface then
                    local offset = hum.HipHeight +(r.Size.Y * 0.5) + 0.20
                    r.CFrame = CFrame.new(savedX, surface.Position.Y + offset, savedZ) * savedRotation
                    r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
                Drop.active = false
                return
            end
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, JUMP_ASCEND_SPEED, 0)
        end))
    end
    local standConns = {}
    local function runDropStand()
        if Drop.active then
            return
        end
        Drop.active = true
        local colConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not Drop.active then
                return
            end
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                    for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            part.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
        table.insert(standConns, colConn)
        local thr = coroutine.create(function()
            while Drop.active do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                local c = LP.Character
                local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not root then
                    break
                end
                local vel = root.Velocity
                root.Velocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                if root and root.Parent then
                    root.Velocity = vel
                end
                RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                if root and root.Parent then
                    root.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(standConns, thr)
        coroutine.resume(thr)
        task.delay(0.1,
        function()
            Drop.active = false
            for _, c in ipairs(standConns) do
                if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
                    pcall(function()
                        c:Disconnect()
                    end)
                elseif type(c) == "thread" then
                    pcall(coroutine.close, c)
                end
            end
            standConns = {}
        end)
    end
    local function runDrop()
        local autoTPWasOn =(_G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled == true)
        local savedAutoTPHeight = tonumber(_G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger) or 20
        if autoTPWasOn then
            _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = false
        end
        local function restoreAutoTPState()
            _G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger = savedAutoTPHeight
            if _atpBox then
                _atpBox.Text = tostring(savedAutoTPHeight)
            end
            if autoTPWasOn then
                _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = true
            end
        end
        task.delay(0.75, restoreAutoTPState)
        if dropMode() == "STAND" then
            runDropStand()
        else
            runDropJump()
        end
        local target = closestPlayerRoot()
        if target and combatLive() then
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.06)
                local c = LP.Character;
                if not c then
                    return
                end
                local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                if not r then
                    return
                end
                r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                r.CFrame = CFrame.new(target.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0))
                r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, - 200, 0)
                r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                tryHitBat()
                task.wait(0.08)
                tryHitBat()
            end)
        end
    end
    runDropBrainrot = runDrop
    _G._AdaptRunDrop = runDrop
    _G._VynxRunDrop = runDrop
    _G._AdaptSetDropMode = function(m)
        _G._VynxDropType =(m == "STAND" or m == "Stand Drop") and "Stand Drop" or "Jump Drop"
        if _G._VynxRefreshDropType then
            pcall(_G._VynxRefreshDropType)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccDropRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            Drop.active = false
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccDropRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime and _G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local FALLBACK_Y = - 7.00
    local MAX_DISTANCE = 4000
    local MAX_STEPS = 12
    local EXCLUDE_FILTER =(function()
        local ok, v = pcall(function()
            return Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        end)
        if ok and v then
            return v
        end
        local ok2, v2 = pcall(function()
            return Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
        end)
        if ok2 then
            return v2
        end
        return nil
    end)()
    local function standOffset(hum, hrp)
        local half = 1
        pcall(function()
            half = hrp.Size.Y * 0.5
        end)
        if half <= 0 then
            half = 1
        end
        local off = half * 3
        pcall(function()
            if hum and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
                off = half * 3
            elseif hum then
                off = half +(hum.HipHeight or(half * 2))
            end
        end)
        if off ~= off or off < 1 or off > 12 then
            off = half * 3
        end
        return off + 0.15
    end
    local function rayDown(fromY, x, z, filter)
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
        if EXCLUDE_FILTER then
            params.FilterType = EXCLUDE_FILTER
        end
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        pcall(function()
            params.RespectCanCollide = true
        end)
        local result
        pcall(function()
            result = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, fromY, z), Vector3.new(0, - MAX_DISTANCE, 0), params)
        end)
        return result
    end
    local function getGroundTPY(char, hrp, hum)
        char = char or LP.Character
        if not char then
            return nil
        end
        hrp = hrp or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then
            return nil
        end
        hum = hum or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local filter = {
            char
        }
        pcall(function()
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                    table.insert(filter, plr.Character)
                end
            end
        end)
        local origin = hrp.Position
        local halfY = 1
        pcall(function()
            halfY = hrp.Size.Y * 0.5
        end)
        local startY = origin.Y - halfY - 0.1
        local groundY
        for _ = 1, MAX_STEPS do
            local result = rayDown(startY, origin.X, origin.Z, filter)
            if not result then
                break
            end
            local part = result.Instance
            local skip = false
            if part then
                pcall(function()
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide == false then
                        skip = true
                    end
                    local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                    if model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                        skip = true
                    end
                end)
            else
                skip = true
            end
            if skip then
                if part then
                    table.insert(filter, part)
                end
                startY = result.Position.Y - 0.05
            else
                groundY = result.Position.Y
                break
            end
        end
        if not groundY then
            return nil
        end
        return groundY + standOffset(hum, hrp), groundY,(origin.Y - groundY)
    end
    local function resolveTPDownY(char, hrp, hum)
        local ok, y = pcall(getGroundTPY, char, hrp, hum)
        if ok and type(y) == "number" then
            return y, true
        end
        return FALLBACK_Y, false
    end
    local function runTPDown()
        pcall(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local targetY = resolveTPDownY(char, hrp, hum)
            local _, yaw = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, targetY, hrp.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
    end
    local function autoTPHeight()
        return tonumber(_G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger) or 20
    end
    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled ~= true then
            return
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then
            return
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return
        end
        if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            return
        end
        if hrp.Position.Y < autoTPHeight() then
            return
        end
        local targetY = resolveTPDownY(char, hrp, hum)
        if (hrp.Position.Y - targetY) < 0.75 then
            return
        end
        runTPDown()
    end))
    _G._VynxRunTPDown = runTPDown
    _G._AdaptRunTPDown = runTPDown
    _G._VynxSetTPDownMode = function(m)
        _G._VynxTPDownMode =(m == "half") and "half" or "full"
        return _G._VynxTPDownMode
    end
    _G._AdaptSetTpMode = _G._VynxSetTPDownMode
    _G._AdaptAutoTP = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_,
        k)
            if k == "enabled" then
                return _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled == true
            end
            if k == "height" then
                return autoTPHeight()
            end
            return nil
        end,
        __newindex = function(_,
        k,
        v)
            if k == "enabled" then
                _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled =(v == true)
            elseif k == "height" then
                _G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger = tonumber(v) or 20
            end
        end,
    })
    _G._AdaptStartAutoTP = function()
        _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = true
    end
    _G._AdaptStopAutoTP = function()
        _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = false
    end
    _G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    _G._AceInstaResetState = _G._AceInstaResetState or {}
    local aceInstaResetState = _G._AceInstaResetState
    for _, connection in ipairs(aceInstaResetState.connections or {}) do
        pcall(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
        end)
    end
    if aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection then
        pcall(function()
            aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection = nil
    end
    aceInstaResetState.connections = {}
    aceInstaResetState.busy = false
    aceInstaResetState.busyAt = 0
    aceInstaResetState.queued = false
    aceInstaResetState.queuedUntil = 0
    aceInstaResetState.token = 0
    aceInstaResetState.cameraHeld = false
    aceInstaResetState.cameraHeldAt = 0
    aceInstaResetState.wantDie = nil
    aceInstaResetState.wantFling = nil
    aceInstaResetState.suspendAt = nil
    aceInstaResetState.speed = tonumber(aceInstaResetState.speed) or 1000000
    local ACE_RESET_HOLD = 1.5
    local ACE_RESET_FALLBACK = 1.2
    local ACE_RESET_WAIT = 8
    local aceResetStepOk, aceResetStepSignal = pcall(function()
        return RunService.PreSimulation
    end)
    local aceResetStep =(aceResetStepOk and aceResetStepSignal) or RunService.Heartbeat
    local function aceResetTrack(connection)
        table.insert(aceInstaResetState.connections, connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function aceResetFlingApi()
        return _G._AceAntiFling or _G._CandyAntiFling
    end
    local function aceResetSyncGuardVisuals()
        if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.AntiDie then
            pcall(VisualSetters.AntiDie, _G._VynxAntiDie == true)
        end
        local AG = _G._AceGuards or _G._CandyGuards
        if not AG then
            return
        end
        if AG.tglDie and AG.tglDie.SetVisual and type(AG.DieIsOn) == "function" then
            pcall(AG.tglDie.SetVisual, AG.DieIsOn())
        end
        if AG.tglFling and AG.tglFling.SetVisual and type(AG.FlingIsOn) == "function" then
            pcall(AG.tglFling.SetVisual, AG.FlingIsOn())
        end
    end
    local function aceResetSuspendGuards()
        if _G._VynxAntiDie == true then
            aceInstaResetState.wantDie = true
            _G._VynxAntiDie = false
        end
        local antiDie = _G._CandyAntiDie
        if antiDie and antiDie.enabled then
            aceInstaResetState.wantDie = true
            if type(_G.stopAntiDie) == "function" then
                pcall(_G.stopAntiDie)
            else
                antiDie.enabled = false
            end
        end
        local antiFling = aceResetFlingApi()
        if antiFling and type(antiFling.IsEnabled) == "function" and antiFling.IsEnabled() then
            aceInstaResetState.wantFling = true
            pcall(antiFling.SetEnabled, false)
        end
        if _G._AdaptAntiDie and _G._AdaptAntiDie.enabled and type(_G._AdaptStopAntiDie) == "function" then
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopAntiDie)
        end
        if _G._CandyAntiVoid and type(_G._CandyAntiVoid.Suspend) == "function" then
            pcall(_G._CandyAntiVoid.Suspend, 6)
        end
        aceInstaResetState.suspendAt = os.clock()
        aceResetSyncGuardVisuals()
        return {
            antiDie = aceInstaResetState.wantDie == true,
            antiFling = aceInstaResetState.wantFling == true,
        }
    end
    local function aceResetRestoreGuards(restore)
        local wantDie = aceInstaResetState.wantDie == true or(restore and restore.antiDie == true) or false
        local wantFling = aceInstaResetState.wantFling == true or(restore and restore.antiFling == true) or false
        aceInstaResetState.suspendAt = nil
        local flingApi = aceResetFlingApi()
        if wantFling and flingApi and type(flingApi.SetEnabled) == "function" then
            pcall(flingApi.SetEnabled, true)
        end
        if wantDie then
            _G._VynxAntiDie = true
            if type(_G.startAntiDie) == "function" then
                pcall(_G.startAntiDie)
            elseif _G._CandyAntiDie then
                _G._CandyAntiDie.enabled = true
            end
        end
        aceResetSyncGuardVisuals()
    end
    local function aceResetHoldCamera(oldCharacter)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        if not camera then
            return
        end
        if aceInstaResetState.cameraHeld and(os.clock() -(aceInstaResetState.cameraHeldAt or 0)) < 5 then
            return
        end
        aceInstaResetState.cameraHeld = true
        aceInstaResetState.cameraHeldAt = os.clock()
        local heldCFrame, heldFocus = camera.CFrame, camera.Focus
        local function aceResetReleaseCamera(newCharacter)
            if aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection then
                pcall(function()
                    aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection:Disconnect()
                end)
                aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection = nil
            end
            local active = workspace.CurrentCamera or camera
            if active then
                pcall(function()
                    active.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                    local humanoid = newCharacter and newCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if humanoid then
                        active.CameraSubject = humanoid
                    end
                end)
            end
            aceInstaResetState.cameraHeld = false
        end
        pcall(function()
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            camera.CFrame = heldCFrame
            camera.Focus = heldFocus
        end)
        aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if workspace.CurrentCamera ~= camera then
                return
            end
            camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
            camera.CFrame = heldCFrame
            camera.Focus = heldFocus
        end))
        task.spawn(function()
            local elapsed = 0
            while LP.Character == oldCharacter and elapsed < 3 do
                elapsed = elapsed + task.wait()
            end
            local replacement = LP.Character
            if replacement == oldCharacter then
                replacement = nil
            end
            aceResetReleaseCamera(replacement)
            if not replacement then
                return
            end
            local humanoid = replacement:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or replacement:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
            local active = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if active then
                pcall(function()
                    active.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                    if humanoid then
                        active.CameraSubject = humanoid
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
    end
    local function aceResetFling(character)
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not(root and root:IsA("BasePart")) then
            return false
        end
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            pcall(function()
                humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
                humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
                humanoid.PlatformStand = true
                humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
            end)
        end
        local velocity = Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(aceInstaResetState.speed, 1000, 10000000), 0)
        local function aceResetPulse()
            if not root.Parent then
                return false
            end
            return(pcall(function()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = velocity
            end))
        end
        if not aceResetPulse() then
            return false
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local elapsed = 0
            while elapsed < ACE_RESET_HOLD do
                elapsed = elapsed + aceResetStep:Wait()
                if not root.Parent then
                    return
                end
                if LP.Character ~= character then
                    return
                end
                aceResetPulse()
            end
        end)
        return true
    end
    local function aceResetHardKill(character)
        local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            hum.PlatformStand = false
            hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
            hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, true)
            hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
            hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
            if hum.MaxHealth == math.huge or hum.MaxHealth <= 0 then
                hum.MaxHealth = 100
            end
            hum.Health = 0
        end)
        pcall(function()
            character:BreakJoints()
        end)
    end
    local aceInstaReset
    local function aceResetQueue()
        aceInstaResetState.queued = true
        aceInstaResetState.queuedUntil = os.clock() + 12
    end
    aceInstaReset = function()
        local character = LP.Character
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not(character and humanoid and root and root:IsA("BasePart")) then
            aceResetQueue();
            return
        end
        if aceInstaResetState.busy and(os.clock() -(aceInstaResetState.busyAt or 0)) < 5 then
            return
        end
        aceInstaResetState.busy = true
        aceInstaResetState.busyAt = os.clock()
        aceInstaResetState.token = aceInstaResetState.token + 1
        local token = aceInstaResetState.token
        local restore = aceResetSuspendGuards()
        task.spawn(function()
            aceResetHoldCamera(character)
            if not aceResetFling(character) then
                aceResetHardKill(character)
            end
            local elapsed = 0
            while LP.Character == character and elapsed < ACE_RESET_FALLBACK do
                elapsed = elapsed + task.wait()
            end
            if LP.Character == character then
                local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    aceResetHardKill(character)
                end
            end
            local waited = 0
            while LP.Character == character and waited < ACE_RESET_WAIT do
                waited = waited + task.wait()
            end
            if aceInstaResetState.token ~= token then
                return
            end
            aceInstaResetState.busy = false
            aceResetRestoreGuards(restore)
        end)
    end
    aceResetTrack(aceResetStep:Connect(function()
        local st = aceInstaResetState
        if not(st.wantDie or st.wantFling) then
            return
        end
        if st.busy and(os.clock() -(st.busyAt or 0)) < 10 then
            return
        end
        if (os.clock() -(st.suspendAt or 0)) < 12 then
            return
        end
        st.busy = false
        aceResetRestoreGuards(nil)
    end))
    aceResetTrack(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        if not aceInstaResetState.queued then
            return
        end
        if os.clock() >(aceInstaResetState.queuedUntil or 0) then
            aceInstaResetState.queued = false;
            return
        end
        aceInstaResetState.queued = false
        task.spawn(function()
            local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
            local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
            task.wait(0.15)
            if humanoid and root and humanoid.Health > 0 and LP.Character == character then
                aceInstaReset()
            end
        end)
    end))
    _G._AceInstaReset = aceInstaReset
    _G._CandyInstaReset = aceInstaReset
    _G.VynxDoInstaReset = aceInstaReset
    _G._AceInstaResetTune = function(speed)
        local parsed = tonumber(speed)
        if parsed then
            aceInstaResetState.speed = math.clamp(math.abs(parsed), 1000, 10000000)
        end
        return aceInstaResetState.speed
    end
    _G._CandyInstaResetTune = _G._AceInstaResetTune
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccCountersRuntime and _G._VioletteccCountersRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccCountersRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local batApi = {
        Enabled = false,
        Connection = nil
    }
    if _G.VX7BatCounter and type(_G.VX7BatCounter.Stop) == "function" then
        pcall(_G.VX7BatCounter.Stop)
    end
    _G._VezyBatCounterOn = false
    local batDebounce = false
    local batLastTrigger = 0
    local BAT_TRIGGER_COOLDOWN = 0.1
    local BAT_NAMES = {
        "Bat",
        "Slap",
        "Iron Slap",
        "Gold Slap",
        "Diamond Slap",
        "Emerald Slap",
        "Ruby Slap",
        "Dark Matter Slap",
        "Flame Slap",
        "Nuclear Slap",
        "Galaxy Slap",
        "Glitched Slap",
    }
    local function batFind()
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then
            return nil
        end
        local backpack = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        for _, name in ipairs(BAT_NAMES) do
            local tool = char:FindFirstChild(name) or(backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name))
            if tool then
                return tool
            end
        end
        for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name:lower():find("bat") then
                return tool
            end
        end
        if backpack then
            for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") and tool.Name:lower():find("bat") then
                    return tool
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function batNearest(fromPosition)
        local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LP and player.Character then
                local root = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local distance =(root.Position - fromPosition).Magnitude
                    if distance < bestDistance then
                        bestDistance = distance
                        best = player
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function batTrigger()
        if not batApi.Enabled or batDebounce then
            return
        end
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - batLastTrigger < BAT_TRIGGER_COOLDOWN then
            return
        end
        batDebounce = true
        batLastTrigger = now
        task.spawn(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not char or not root or not hum then
                batDebounce = false;
                return
            end
            local victim = batNearest(root.Position)
            if not victim then
                batDebounce = false;
                return
            end
            local tool = batFind()
            if tool then
                if tool.Parent ~= char then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:EquipTool(tool)
                    end)
                end
                task.wait(0.02)
            end
            char = LP.Character
            root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local victimChar = victim.Character
            local victimRoot = victimChar and victimChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not char or not root or not hum or not victimRoot then
                batDebounce = false;
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            local victimPosition = victimRoot.Position
            local lookAt = Vector3.new(victimPosition.X, root.Position.Y, victimPosition.Z)
            if (lookAt - root.Position).Magnitude > 0.001 then
                pcall(function()
                    root.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, lookAt)
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.03)
            local swing = batFind()
            if swing and swing.Parent == char then
                pcall(function()
                    swing:Activate()
                    local remote = swing:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                    if remote then
                        remote:FireServer()
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.wait(0.2)
            if root and root.Parent then
                root.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
            if hum and hum.Parent and not(autoBatToggled == true or _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true) then
                hum.AutoRotate = true
            end
            batDebounce = false
        end)
    end
    function batApi.Start()
        batApi.Enabled = true
        if batApi.Connection then
            return
        end
        local wasRagdolled = false
        batApi.Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not batApi.Enabled then
                wasRagdolled = false;
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then
                wasRagdolled = false;
                return
            end
            local ragdolled = hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
            if ragdolled and not wasRagdolled and not batDebounce then
                batTrigger()
            end
            wasRagdolled = ragdolled
        end))
    end
    function batApi.Stop()
        batApi.Enabled = false
        batDebounce = false
        if batApi.Connection then
            batApi.Connection:Disconnect()
            batApi.Connection = nil
        end
    end
    function batApi.SetEnabled(on)
        if on then
            batApi.Start()
        else
            batApi.Stop()
        end
    end
    _G.VezyStartBatCounter = function()
        _G._VezyBatCounterOn = true
        if BC then
            BC.enabled = true
        end
        batApi.Start()
    end
    _G.VezyStopBatCounter = function()
        _G._VezyBatCounterOn = false
        if BC then
            BC.enabled = false
        end

    local MEDUSA_COOLDOWN, medusaLastUsed = 25, 0
    local medusaDebounce = false
    local medusaAnchorConns = {}
    local function findMedusa()
        local char = LP.Character;
        if not char then
            return nil
        end
        for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                local tn = tool.Name:lower()
                if tn:find("medusa") or tn:find("head") or tn:find("stone") then
                    return tool
                end
            end
        end
        local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if bp then
            for _, tool in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                    local tn = tool.Name:lower()
                    if tn:find("medusa") or tn:find("head") or tn:find("stone") then
                        return tool
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function useMedusaCounter()
        if medusaDebounce then
            return
        end
        if tick() - medusaLastUsed < MEDUSA_COOLDOWN then
            return
        end
        local char = LP.Character;
        if not char then
            return
        end
        medusaDebounce = true
        local med = findMedusa()
        if not med then
            medusaDebounce = false;
            return
        end
        if med.Parent ~= char then
            local hum2 = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum2 then
                pcall(function()
                    hum2:EquipTool(med)
                end)
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            med:Activate()
        end)
        medusaLastUsed = tick()
        medusaDebounce = false
    end
    local function _stopMedusaCounter()
        for _, c in pairs(medusaAnchorConns) do
            pcall(function()
                c:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        medusaAnchorConns = {}
    end
    local function _setupMedusaCounter(char)
        _stopMedusaCounter()
        char = char or LP.Character
        if not char then
            return
        end
        local function onAnchorChanged(part)
            return part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
                if medusaCounterEnabled and part.Anchored and part.Transparency == 1 then
                    useMedusaCounter()
                end
            end)
        end
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                table.insert(medusaAnchorConns, onAnchorChanged(part))
            end
        end
        table.insert(medusaAnchorConns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                table.insert(medusaAnchorConns, onAnchorChanged(part))
            end
        end))
    end
    setupMedusaCounter = _setupMedusaCounter
    stopMedusaCounter = _stopMedusaCounter
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function(char)
        task.wait(0.3)
        if medusaCounterEnabled then
            _setupMedusaCounter(char)
        end
    end)
    _G._AdaptStartMedusaCounter = function()
        medusaCounterEnabled = true
        _setupMedusaCounter(LP.Character)
    end
    _G._AdaptStopMedusaCounter = function()
        medusaCounterEnabled = false
        _stopMedusaCounter()
    end
    _G._AdaptMedusaCounterOn = function()
        return medusaCounterEnabled
    end
    _G._AdaptStartBatCounter = _G.VezyStartBatCounter
    _G._AdaptStopBatCounter = _G.VezyStopBatCounter
    _G._VioletteccCountersRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            batApi.Stop()

                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccCountersRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if medusaCounterEnabled then
        _setupMedusaCounter(LP.Character)
    end
    if _G._VezyBatCounterOn or(BC and BC.enabled) then
        _G.VezyStartBatCounter()
    end
end)();

            local live = _G._RaVeLiveSpeed
            if type(live) ~= "table" then
                return false
            end
            local stamp, speed = tonumber(live.t), tonumber(live.v)

        local function isHubMover(child)
            local name = child.Name
            if not(name:match("^Ace") or name:match("^Candy") or name:match("^RaVe") or name:match("^VlonE") or name:match("^Vilon") or name:match("^Kawatan") or name:match("^InfJump")) then
                return false
            end
            if child:IsA("LinearVelocity") then
                if child.Enabled == false then
                    return false
                end
                local ok, magnitude = pcall(function()
                    local mode = child.VelocityConstraintMode
                    if mode == Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Vector then
                        return child.VectorVelocity.Magnitude
                    elseif mode == Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Line then
                        return math.abs(child.LineVelocity)
                    end
                    return child.PlaneVelocity.Magnitude
                end)
                return ok and(tonumber(magnitude) or 0) > 1
            end
            return child:IsA("BodyVelocity") or child:IsA("BodyPosition") or child:IsA("BodyGyro") or child:IsA("AlignPosition") or child:IsA("AlignOrientation") or child:IsA("AngularVelocity") or child:IsA("VectorForce")
        end
        local function hubMoverActive(root)

            __mode = "k"

        local function partsOf(char)

            list = {}

        AntiDie = {
            enabled = false,
            loop = nil,
            healthConn = nil,
            charConn = nil,
            lastHealTime = 0,
            invincibleUntil = 0,
            config = {
                healthThreshold = 50,
                invincibilityFrames = 0.75,
                fallDamageProtection = false,
                ragdollProtection = true,
                autoRevive = true
            },
        }
        local function _adSuperHeal(hum)
            if not hum or not hum.Parent then
                return
            end
            local maxHealth = hum.MaxHealth or 100
            if maxHealth <= 0 or maxHealth == math.huge then
                maxHealth = 100
            end
            pcall(function()
                hum.Health = maxHealth
                if hum.MaxHealth < maxHealth then
                    hum.MaxHealth = maxHealth
                end
            end)
            AntiDie.invincibleUntil = tick() + AntiDie.config.invincibilityFrames
            AntiDie.lastHealTime = tick()
            pcall(function()
                local char = hum.Parent
                if not char then
                    return
                end
                for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("NumberValue") then
                        local name = child.Name:lower()
                        if name:find("health") or name:find("hp") or name:find("life") then
                            child.Value = maxHealth
                        end
                    end
                    if child:IsA("BoolValue") and child.Name:lower():find("dead") then
                        child.Value = false
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local function _adPreventDamage(root, hum)
            if not hum then
                return
            end
            if hum.Health <(hum.MaxHealth or 100) then
                _adSuperHeal(hum)
            end
            if tick() < AntiDie.invincibleUntil then
                if hum.Health <(hum.MaxHealth or 100) then
                    hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth or 100
                end
            end
            if AntiDie.config.ragdollProtection then
                local state = hum:GetState()
                if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                    end)
                    _adSuperHeal(hum)
                    if root then
                        pcall(function()
                            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            if hum.Health <= 0 then
                _adSuperHeal(hum)
                pcall(function()
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end)
                if root then
                    pcall(function()
                        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        local function _adAutoRevive()
            if not AntiDie.config.autoRevive then
                return

            if not char then
                return
            end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hum then
                return

                _adSuperHeal(hum)

                    hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
                end)
                if root then
                    pcall(function()
                        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        startAntiDie = function()

                    hum.MaxHealth = 100

    do
        local SafeMode = {

        local CARRY_MARKERS = {

        local safeTimerLabel = nil
        local function safeResolveTimerLabel()
            if safeTimerLabel and safeTimerLabel.Parent then

            safeTimerLabel = nil
            local top = SafeGui:FindFirstChild("DuelsMachineTopFrame", true)

        function SafeMode:IsHoldingBrainrotFast()
            for marker in pairs(CARRY_MARKERS) do
