        function SafeMode:IsRoundCountdownActive()
            local state = self._state
            local function inactive()
                state.timerInactiveSince = state.timerInactiveSince or os.clock()
                if os.clock() - state.timerInactiveSince >= 0.75 then
                    state.timerPhase = "inactive"
                    state.timerStartUsed = false
                    state.timerRoundSeen = false
                    state.timerSawInactive = true
                end
                return false
            end
            local label = safeResolveTimerLabel()
            if not label then
                return inactive()
            end
            local node = label
            while node and node ~= SafeGui do
                if node:IsA("GuiObject") and not node.Visible then
                    return inactive()
                end
                if node:IsA("ScreenGui") and not node.Enabled then
                    return inactive()
                end
                node = node.Parent
            end
            local text = tostring(label.Text or ""):upper():gsub("<.->", ""):gsub("%s+", "")
            state.timerInactiveSince = nil
            if text == "READY" or text == "STARTING" or text == "GETREADY" then
                state.timerPhase, state.timerStartUsed, state.timerRoundSeen = "starting", true, false
                return true
            end
            if text == "GO" or text == "FIGHT" then
                state.timerPhase, state.timerStartUsed, state.timerRoundSeen = "round", true, true
                return false
            end
            local minutes, seconds = text:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")
            if minutes and seconds then
                local total = tonumber(minutes) * 60 + tonumber(seconds)
                if total <= 0 then
                    state.timerPhase, state.timerStartUsed, state.timerRoundSeen, state.timerSawInactive = "inactive", false, false, true
                else
                    state.timerPhase, state.timerStartUsed, state.timerRoundSeen = "round", true, true
                end
                return false
            end
            local number = tonumber(text)
            if not number then
                return false
            end
            if number > 10 then
                state.timerPhase, state.timerStartUsed, state.timerRoundSeen = "round", true, true
                return false
            end
            if number <= 0 then
                if state.timerRoundSeen then
                    state.timerPhase, state.timerStartUsed, state.timerRoundSeen, state.timerSawInactive = "inactive", false, false, true
                end
                return false
            end
            if state.timerRoundSeen or(state.timerStartUsed and state.timerPhase ~= "starting") then
                return false
            end
            if state.timerPhase == "starting" then
                return true
            end
            if not state.timerStartUsed and state.timerSawInactive then
                state.timerPhase, state.timerStartUsed, state.timerSawInactive = "starting", true, false
                return true
            end
            return false
        end
        function SafeMode:GetBlockReason()
            if not self.Enabled then
                return nil
            end
            if self._state.countdown then
                return "ROUND COUNTDOWN"
            end
            if self._state.holding then
                return "BRAINROT HELD"
            end
            return nil
        end
        function SafeMode:BindAction(name, getter, setter, conflicts)
            self.Actions[name] = {
                get = getter,
                set = setter,
                conflicts = conflicts or {}
            }
        end
        function SafeMode:_disable(action)
            local entry = self.Actions[action]
            if entry then
                pcall(entry.set, false)
            end
        end
        function SafeMode:Request(action, wantsOn)
            local entry = self.Actions[action]
            if not entry then
                return false, "UNBOUND ACTION"
            end
            if wantsOn ~= true then
                self:_disable(action);
                return true
            end
            local reason = self:GetBlockReason()
            if reason then
                self:_disable(action);
                return false, reason
            end
            for _, other in ipairs(entry.conflicts) do
                self:_disable(other)
            end
            entry.set(true)
            return true
        end
        function SafeMode:Toggle(action)
            local entry = self.Actions[action]
            return entry and self:Request(action, not entry.get()) or false
        end
        function SafeMode:Evaluate()
            local state = self._state
            local countdown = self:IsRoundCountdownActive()
            local holding = self:IsHoldingBrainrot()
            state.countdown, state.holding = countdown, holding
            self.Enabled =(_G._VynxSafeMode == true)
            if not self.Enabled then
                return
            end
            local reason = self:GetBlockReason()
            if not reason then
                return
            end
            for action, entry in pairs(self.Actions) do
                if entry.get() then
                    self:_disable(action)
                end
            end
        end
        function SafeMode:SetEnabled(enabled)
            _G._VynxSafeMode = enabled == true
            self.Enabled = _G._VynxSafeMode
            if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.SafeMode then
                pcall(VisualSetters.SafeMode, self.Enabled)
            end
            if self.Enabled then
                self._state.countdown, self._state.holding = false, false
                self:Evaluate()
            end
        end
        function SafeMode:_watchCarryState()
            local function evaluateSoon()
                task.defer(function()
                    if SafeMode._running and _G._VynxSafeMode == true then
                        pcall(function()
                            SafeMode:Evaluate()
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end
            for marker in pairs(CARRY_MARKERS) do
                self._connections["player_" .. marker] = LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal(marker):Connect(evaluateSoon)
            end
            local function watchCharacter(character)
                for key, connection in pairs(self._connections) do
                    if key:sub(1, 5) == "char_" then
                        safeDisconnect(connection)
                        self._connections[key] = nil
                    end
                end
                if not character then
                    return
                end
                for marker in pairs(CARRY_MARKERS) do
                    self._connections["char_attr_" .. marker] = character:GetAttributeChangedSignal(marker):Connect(evaluateSoon)
                end
                self._connections.char_added = character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(item)
                    if item:IsA("Tool") or CARRY_MARKERS[item.Name] then
                        evaluateSoon()
                    end
                end)
                self._connections.char_removed = character.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(item)
                    if item:IsA("Tool") or CARRY_MARKERS[item.Name] then
                        evaluateSoon()
                    end
                end)
            end
            self._connections.character = hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
            function(character)
                watchCharacter(character)
                evaluateSoon()
            end)
            watchCharacter(LP.Character)
        end
        function SafeMode:Start()
            if self._running then
                return self
            end
            self._running = true
            self:_watchCarryState()
            self._connections.monitor = hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                if _G._VynxSafeMode ~= true or os.clock() - SafeMode._lastCheck < 0.1 then
                    return
                end
                SafeMode._lastCheck = os.clock()
                pcall(function()
                    SafeMode:Evaluate()
                end)
            end))
            self.Enabled =(_G._VynxSafeMode == true)
            if self.Enabled then
                self:Evaluate()
            end
            return self
        end
        SafeMode:BindAction("Bat Aimbot",
        function()
            return autoBatToggled == true or _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true
        end,
        function(on)
            autoBatToggled = on and true or false
            _G._VezyBatAimbotOn = autoBatToggled
            if on then
                if _G.VezyStartBatAimbotDispatch then
                    pcall(_G.VezyStartBatAimbotDispatch)
                end
            else
                if _G.VezyStopBatAimbot then
                    pcall(_G.VezyStopBatAimbot)
                end
            end
            if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.AutoBat then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AutoBat, autoBatToggled)
            end
        end)
        SafeMode:BindAction("Auto Swing",
        function()
            return autoSwingEnabled == true or _G._VezyAutoSwingEnabled == true
        end,
        function(on)
            autoSwingEnabled = on and true or false
            _G._VezyAutoSwingEnabled = autoSwingEnabled
            if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.AutoSwing then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AutoSwing, autoSwingEnabled)
            end
        end)
        local safeGateAt, safeGateValue = 0, false
        local function safeGateBlocked()
            if _G._VynxSafeMode ~= true then
                return false
            end
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - safeGateAt < 0.015 then
                return safeGateValue
            end
            safeGateAt = now
            local state = SafeMode._state
            local countdown, holding = false, false
            pcall(function()
                countdown = SafeMode:IsRoundCountdownActive()
            end)
            pcall(function()
                holding = SafeMode:IsHoldingBrainrotFast() or state.holding == true
            end)
            state.countdown, state.holding = countdown, holding
            safeGateValue = countdown or holding
            return safeGateValue
        end
        local function safeForceStop()
            for _, name in ipairs(safeGuarded) do
                local entry = SafeMode.Actions[name]
                if entry and entry.get() then
                    SafeMode:_disable(name)
                end
            end
        end
        SafeMode.IsLocked = safeGateBlocked
        SafeMode.GateBlocked = safeGateBlocked
        SafeMode.ForceStop = safeForceStop
        _G._CandySafeIsLocked = safeGateBlocked
        _G._CandySafeGateBlocked = safeGateBlocked
        _G._CandySafeForceStop = safeForceStop
        _G._RaVeSafeMode = {
            IsLocked = safeGateBlocked,
            SetEnabled = function(on)
                SafeMode:SetEnabled(on)
            end,
            HoldingBrainrot = function()
                return SafeMode:IsHoldingBrainrot()
            end,
            ForceStop = safeForceStop,
            GetBlockReason = function()
                return SafeMode:GetBlockReason()
            end,
        }
        SafeMode:Start()
    end
    do
        local KW = {
            enabled = _G._VynxKickWarning == true,
            active = false,
            wasLow = false,
            generation = 0,
            gui = nil,
            connection = nil,
        }
        _G._VioletteccKickWarningState = KW
        local function destroyWarning()
            KW.generation = KW.generation + 1
            KW.active = false
            if KW.gui then
                pcall(function()
                    KW.gui:Destroy()
                end);
                KW.gui = nil
            end
        end
        local function showWarning()
            if KW.active or not KW.enabled then
                return
            end
            KW.active = true
            KW.generation = KW.generation + 1
            local myGeneration = KW.generation
            local DURATION = 2.35
            local FRAME_W, FRAME_H = 420, 52
            local parent =(gui and gui.Parent) or LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
            if not parent then
                KW.active = false;
                return
            end
            local warningGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            warningGui.Name = "VioletteKickWarning"
            warningGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            warningGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
            warningGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
            warningGui.DisplayOrder = 99999
            warningGui.Parent = parent
            KW.gui = warningGui
            local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
            frame.Name = "WarningFrame"
            frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, FRAME_W, 0, FRAME_H)
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, - FRAME_W / 2, 0, - 60)
            frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
            frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
            frame.ClipsDescendants = true
            frame.Parent = warningGui
            Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            local edge = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
            edge.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            edge.Thickness = 1.5
            edge.Transparency = 0.28
            local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
            fill.Name = "FillFrame"
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            fill.BackgroundTransparency = 0.48
            fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
            fill.ZIndex = 2
            fill.Parent = frame
            Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            local fillGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", fill)
            fillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
            fillGrad.Rotation = 0
            local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            icon.Name = "WarningIcon"
            icon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 1, 0)
            icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
            icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            icon.Text = "!"
            icon.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            icon.TextSize = 28
            icon.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            icon.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            icon.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.45
            icon.ZIndex = 3
            icon.Parent = frame
            local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            text.Name = "WarningText"
            text.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 58, 1, 0)
            text.Position = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 0)
            text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            text.Text = "DONT COLLECT"
            text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            text.TextSize = 16
            text.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            text.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            text.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
            text.ZIndex = 3
            text.Parent = frame
            TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5,
                - FRAME_W / 2,
                0,
                18)
            }):Play()
            task.spawn(function()
                local started = tick()
                while KW.active and KW.generation == myGeneration and warningGui.Parent do
                    local char = LP.Character
                    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if not hum or hum.WalkSpeed >= 25 then
                        break
                    end
                    local progress = math.clamp((tick() - started) / DURATION, 0, 1)
                    fill.Size = UDim2.new(progress, 0, 1, 0)
                    if progress >= 1 then
                        break
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                if KW.generation ~= myGeneration or not warningGui.Parent then
                    return
                end
                TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5,
                    - FRAME_W / 2,
                    0,
                    - 60),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1
                }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(edge, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                    Transparency = 1
                }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(text, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                    TextTransparency = 1
                }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(icon, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                    TextTransparency = 1
                }):Play()
                task.wait(0.35)
                if KW.generation == myGeneration then
                    pcall(function()
                        warningGui:Destroy()
                    end)
                    KW.gui = nil
                    KW.active = false
                end
            end)
        end
        _G._VioletteccKickWarningSet = function(on)
            KW.enabled = on == true
            _G._VynxKickWarning = KW.enabled
            if not KW.enabled then
                destroyWarning()
            else
                local char = LP.Character
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                KW.wasLow = hum and hum.WalkSpeed < 25 or false
            end
        end
        _G._VioletteccDestroyKickWarning = destroyWarning
        KW.connection = hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if KW.enabled ~=(_G._VynxKickWarning == true) then
                _G._VioletteccKickWarningSet(_G._VynxKickWarning == true)
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then
                return
            end
            if _G._RaVeSafeMode and _G._RaVeSafeMode.IsLocked then
                local ok, locked = pcall(_G._RaVeSafeMode.IsLocked)
                if ok and locked then
                    if KW.active then
                        destroyWarning()
                    end
                    KW.wasLow = false
                    return
                end
            end
            local low = hum.WalkSpeed < 25
            if not KW.enabled then
                KW.wasLow = low
                return
            end
            if low ~= KW.wasLow then
                KW.wasLow = low
                if low then
                    showWarning()
                end
            end
        end))
        _G._VioletteccKickWarningRuntime = {
            Destroy = function()
                destroyWarning()
                if KW.connection then
                    pcall(function()
                        KW.connection:Disconnect()
                    end);
                    KW.connection = nil
                end
                _G._VioletteccKickWarningRuntime = nil
            end,
        }
        _G._VioletteccKickWarningSet(KW.enabled)
    end
    do
        local AG = _G._AceGuards or {}
        _G._AceGuards = AG
        _G._CandyGuards = AG
        AG.autoDie = false
        AG.autoFling = false
        AG.prevAim = false
        AG.last = 0
        local function guardFlingApi()
            return _G._AceAntiFling or _G._CandyAntiFling
        end
        local function guardBusy()
            local st = _G._AceInstaResetState
            return(st and st.busy and(os.clock() -(st.busyAt or 0)) < 10) or false
        end
        function AG.DieIsOn()
            local antiDie = _G._CandyAntiDie
            return(antiDie and antiDie.enabled == true and antiDie.loop ~= nil) or false
        end
        function AG.SetDie(on)
            on = on and true or false
            local antiDie = _G._CandyAntiDie
            local st = _G._AceInstaResetState
            if st then
                st.wantDie = nil
            end
            if on then
                if antiDie and antiDie.enabled and not antiDie.loop then
                    antiDie.enabled = false
                end
                if type(_G.startAntiDie) == "function" then
                    pcall(_G.startAntiDie)
                elseif antiDie then
                    antiDie.enabled = true
                end
            else
                if type(_G.stopAntiDie) == "function" then
                    pcall(_G.stopAntiDie)
                elseif antiDie then
                    antiDie.enabled = false
                end
            end
            if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.AntiDie then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AntiDie, AG.DieIsOn())
            end
        end
        function AG.FlingIsOn()
            local api = guardFlingApi()
            return(api and type(api.IsEnabled) == "function" and api.IsEnabled() == true) or false
        end
        function AG.SetFling(on)
            on = on and true or false
            local api = guardFlingApi()
            if api and type(api.SetEnabled) == "function" then
                pcall(api.SetEnabled, on)
            end
            if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.AntiFling then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AntiFling, on)
            end
        end
        function AG.AimOn()
            return aimActive()
        end
        function AG.Sync()
            if guardBusy() then
                return
            end
            local aim = AG.AimOn()
            if aim then
                if not AG.DieIsOn() then
                    AG.autoDie = true;
                    AG.SetDie(true)
                end
                if not AG.FlingIsOn() then
                    AG.autoFling = true;
                    AG.SetFling(true)
                end
            elseif AG.prevAim then
                if AG.autoDie then
                    AG.autoDie = false;
                    AG.SetDie(false)
                end
                if AG.autoFling then
                    AG.autoFling = false;
                    AG.SetFling(false)
                end
            end
            AG.prevAim = aim
            if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.AntiDie then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AntiDie, AG.DieIsOn())
            end
            if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.AntiFling then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AntiFling, AG.FlingIsOn())
            end
        end
        if AG.watch then
            pcall(function()
                AG.watch:Disconnect()
            end);
            AG.watch = nil
        end
        AG.watch = hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local now = os.clock()
            if now - AG.last < 0.15 then
                return
            end
            AG.last = now
            AG.Sync()
        end))
        AG.Sync()
    end
    _G._VioletteccGuardsRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            pcall(function()
                if _G._AceAntiFling then
                    _G._AceAntiFling.Destroy()
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if _G.stopAntiDie then
                    _G.stopAntiDie()
                end
            end)
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccGuardsRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if _G._VynxAntiDie == true then
        startAntiDie()
    end
end)();

    _G._AdaptSkyMode = _G._VezyCustomSkyMode or _G._AdaptSkyMode or "Off"
    _G._AdaptClearSky = function()
        for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if v:GetAttribute("_AdaptSky") then
                pcall(function()
                    v:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
        local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
        if terrain then
            for _, v in ipairs(terrain:GetChildren()) do
                if v:GetAttribute("_AdaptSky") then
                    pcall(function()
                        v:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptStartSky = function(mode)
        _G._AdaptClearSky()
        local L = Lighting
        mode = mode or _G._AdaptSkyMode or "Off"
        local preset = _G._AdaptSkyPresets[mode]
        local c3 = function(t)
            return Color3.fromRGB(t[1], t[2], t[3])
        end
        if not preset or preset.kind == "off" then
            pcall(function()
                L.FogEnd = 100000;
                L.FogStart = 0;
                L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                L.Brightness = 2;
                L.ClockTime = 14;
                L.GlobalShadows = true
                L.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
                L.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            end)
            _G._AdaptSkyMode = "Off";
            _G._VezyCustomSkyMode = "Off"
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            L.FogEnd = 100000;
            L.FogStart = 0;
            L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            L.ColorShift_Top = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
            L.ColorShift_Bottom = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            L.GlobalShadows = true;
            L.ClockTime = preset.clock or 14;
            L.Brightness = preset.brightness or 2
            if preset.outAmb then
                L.OutdoorAmbient = c3(preset.outAmb)
            end
            if preset.ambient then
                L.Ambient = c3(preset.ambient)
            end
        end)
        if preset.sky then
            pcall(function()
                local sky = Instance.new("Sky");
                sky:SetAttribute("_AdaptSky", true)
                if preset.sky.stars then
                    sky.StarCount = preset.sky.stars
                end
                if preset.sky.moon then
                    sky.MoonAngularSize = preset.sky.moon
                end
                if preset.sky.sun then
                    sky.SunAngularSize = preset.sky.sun
                end
                if preset.sky.moonTex then
                    sky.MoonTextureId = "rbxasset://sky/moon.jpg"
                end
                sky.Parent = L
            end)
        end
        if preset.atm then
            pcall(function()
                local atm = Instance.new("Atmosphere");
                atm:SetAttribute("_AdaptSky", true)
                atm.Density = preset.atm.dens or 0.3
                atm.Color = c3(preset.atm.color);
                atm.Decay = c3(preset.atm.decay)
                atm.Glare = preset.atm.glare or 1;
                atm.Haze = preset.atm.haze or 1
                atm.Parent = L
            end)
        end
        local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
        if preset.clouds and terrain then
            pcall(function()
                local clouds = Instance.new("Clouds");
                clouds:SetAttribute("_AdaptSky", true)
                clouds.Cover = preset.clouds.cover or 0.5
                clouds.Density = preset.clouds.dens or 0.5
                clouds.Color = c3(preset.clouds.color);
                clouds.Parent = terrain
            end)
        end
        _G._AdaptSkyMode = mode
        _G._VezyCustomSkyMode = mode
    end
    _G._AdaptStopSky = function()
        _G._AdaptClearSky()
        pcall(function()
            Lighting.ClockTime = 14;
            Lighting.Brightness = 2
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        end)
        _G._AdaptSkyMode = "Off"
        _G._VezyCustomSkyMode = "Off"
    end
    _G._AdaptSkyApply = _G._AdaptStartSky
    _G._AdaptSkyClear = _G._AdaptStopSky
    _G.VezyApplyCustomSky = function(mode)
        _G._VezyCustomSkyMode = mode or "Off"
        _G._AdaptStartSky(_G._VezyCustomSkyMode)
        if _G._VezyRefreshSkyTheme then
            pcall(_G._VezyRefreshSkyTheme)
        end
    end
    if _G._VezyCustomSkyMode and _G._VezyCustomSkyMode ~= "Off" then
        pcall(_G._AdaptStartSky, _G._VezyCustomSkyMode)
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccVisualRuntime and _G._VioletteccVisualRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccVisualRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local Util = _G._AdaptUtil or {
        antilag = false,
        potato = false,
        shiny = false,
        stretch = false,
        fov = false
    }
    _G._AdaptUtil = Util do
        if _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn then
            pcall(function()
                _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn = nil
        _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken = {}
        if type(_G._AdaptAntiLagHiddenObstacleVolumes) == "table" then
            for part in pairs(_G._AdaptAntiLagHiddenObstacleVolumes) do
                pcall(function()
                    if part and part.Parent then
                        part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        local defaults, terrainDefaults = {}, {}
        -- Remember only properties Anti Lag actually changes so every change
        -- can be restored exactly when the toggle is turned off.
        local objectDefaults = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
        local active, descConn = false, nil
        local queue, queueHead, queueTail, queueRunning = {}, 1, 0, false
        local hiddenObstacleVolumes = {}
        _G._AdaptAntiLagHiddenObstacleVolumes = hiddenObstacleVolumes
        local function isBaseObstacleVolume(obj)
            if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                return false
            end
            local events = workspace:FindFirstChild("Events")
            if not events or not obj:IsDescendantOf(events) then
                return false
            end
            local parent = obj.Parent
            while parent and parent ~= events do
                if parent.Name == "ObstacleVolumes" then
                    return true
                end
                parent = parent.Parent
            end
            return false
        end
        local function rememberObjectProperty(obj, property)
            local saved = objectDefaults[obj]
            if not saved then
                saved = {}
                objectDefaults[obj] = saved
            end
            if saved[property] == nil then
                saved[property] = obj[property]
            end
        end

        local function apply(obj)
            if not active or not obj then
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                -- Never strip effects from the local character. This avoids
                -- hiding first-person/player visuals while reducing world FX.
                local character = LP.Character
                if character and obj:IsDescendantOf(character) then
                    return
                end

                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    rememberObjectProperty(obj, "CastShadow")
                    if obj.CastShadow then
                        obj.CastShadow = false
                    end
                elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail")
                    or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Fire")
                    or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") then
                    rememberObjectProperty(obj, "Enabled")
                    if obj.Enabled then
                        obj.Enabled = false
                    end
                end
                -- Deliberately leave Decals, Textures, lights, post effects,
                -- materials, and Animators alone; removing them can make the
                -- scene/player appear black or invisible.
            end)
        end
        local function queueObject(obj)
            if not active or not obj then
                return
            end
            queueTail = queueTail + 1
            queue[queueTail] = obj
            if queueRunning then
                return
            end
            queueRunning = true
            local token = _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken
            task.spawn(function()
                while active and token == _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken and queueHead <= queueTail do
                    local remaining = queueTail - queueHead + 1
                    for _ = 1, math.min(80, remaining) do
                        local nextObject = queue[queueHead]
                        queue[queueHead] = nil
                        queueHead = queueHead + 1
                        if nextObject then
                            apply(nextObject)
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                if token == _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken then
                    if queueHead > queueTail then
                        queue, queueHead, queueTail = {}, 1, 0
                    end
                    queueRunning = false
                end
            end)
        end
        _G._AdaptStartAntiLag = function()
            if active then
                return
            end
            active = true
            queue, queueHead, queueTail = {}, 1, 0
            queueRunning = false
            _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken = {}
            local scanToken = _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken

            if defaults.GlobalShadows == nil then
                defaults.GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
            end

            -- Keep the game's normal lighting, fog, ambient, post effects,
            -- and environment brightness. Only disable the expensive shadows.
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            end)

            pcall(function()
                local terrain = workspace.Terrain
                if terrainDefaults.Decoration == nil then
                    terrainDefaults.Decoration = terrain.Decoration
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSize == nil then
                    terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSize = terrain.WaterWaveSize
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSpeed == nil then
                    terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSpeed = terrain.WaterWaveSpeed
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterReflectance == nil then
                    terrainDefaults.WaterReflectance = terrain.WaterReflectance
                end
                terrain.Decoration = false
                terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
                terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
                terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
                -- Do not force WaterTransparency to 1; that can hide the
                -- surface/world under the camera in some places.
            end)

            -- Scan in small batches so enabling Anti Lag does not freeze the UI.
            task.spawn(function()
                local descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
                for index, obj in ipairs(descendants) do
                    if not active or scanToken ~= _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken then
                        return
                    end
                    apply(obj)
                    if index % 200 == 0 then
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            end)

            if descConn then
                descConn:Disconnect()
            end
            descConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if active then
                    queueObject(obj)
                end
            end)
            _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn = descConn
        end
        _G._AdaptStopAntiLag = function()
            active = false
            _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken = {}
            queue, queueHead, queueTail = {}, 1, 0
            queueRunning = false

            if descConn then
                descConn:Disconnect()
                descConn = nil
            end
            _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn = nil

            -- Restore all changed world objects (their exact prior values).
            for obj, saved in pairs(objectDefaults) do
                pcall(function()
                    if obj and obj.Parent then
                        for property, value in pairs(saved) do
                            obj[property] = value
                        end
                    end
                end)
                objectDefaults[obj] = nil
            end

            -- Retain compatibility with any obstacle-volume records left by
            -- an earlier version of this script.
            for part, originalTransparency in pairs(hiddenObstacleVolumes) do
                pcall(function()
                    if part and part.Parent then
                        part.LocalTransparencyModifier = originalTransparency
                    end
                end)
            end
            table.clear(hiddenObstacleVolumes)

            pcall(function()
                if defaults.GlobalShadows ~= nil then
                    Lighting.GlobalShadows = defaults.GlobalShadows
                end
                local terrain = workspace.Terrain
                if terrainDefaults.Decoration ~= nil then
                    terrain.Decoration = terrainDefaults.Decoration
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSize ~= nil then
                    terrain.WaterWaveSize = terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSize
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSpeed ~= nil then
                    terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSpeed
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterReflectance ~= nil then
                    terrain.WaterReflectance = terrainDefaults.WaterReflectance
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    do
        _G._AdaptStartVisualStrip = function()
            if _G._AdaptVisualStripOn then
                return
            end
            _G._AdaptVisualStripOn = true
            _G._AdaptVisualStripConnections = _G._AdaptVisualStripConnections or {}
            for _, conn in ipairs(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _G._AdaptVisualStripConnections = {}
            local function isBrainrotVisual(obj)
                local heldTool = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
                if heldTool and LP.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(LP.Character) and LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
                    return true
                end
                for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if player.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                local current = obj
                local inAnimalPodiums, animatedModel = false, false
                for _ = 1, 10 do
                    if not current then
                        break
                    end
                    local name = string.lower(current.Name or "")
                    if string.find(name, "brainrot", 1, true) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if name == "animalpodiums" then
                        inAnimalPodiums = true
                    end
                    if current:IsA("Model") and(current:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController") or current:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")) then
                        animatedModel = true
                    end
                    current = current.Parent
                end
                return inAnimalPodiums and animatedModel
            end
            local function strip(obj)
                if not _G._AdaptVisualStripOn then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    local brainrotVisual = isBrainrotVisual(obj)
                    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if not brainrotVisual then
                            obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            obj.MaterialVariant = ""
                        end
                        obj.Reflectance = 0
                        obj.CastShadow = false
                        local partName = string.lower(obj.Name or "")
                        if obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light", true) or string.find(partName, "light", 1, true) or string.find(partName, "lamp", 1, true) then
                            obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        end
                        if obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
                            obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or obj:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
                        obj:Destroy()
                    elseif obj:IsA("FaceControls") then
                        obj:Destroy()
                    elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") or obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                        if not brainrotVisual then
                            obj:Destroy()
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                        if not brainrotVisual then
                            obj.TextureId = ""
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("Animator") then
                        local model = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        if not(model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)) then
                            for _, track in ipairs(obj:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                                pcall(function()
                                    track:Stop(0);
                                    track:AdjustSpeed(0)
                                end)
                            end
                            table.insert(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections, obj.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
                                if _G._AdaptVisualStripOn then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        track:Stop(0);
                                        track:AdjustSpeed(0)
                                    end)
                                end
                            end))
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") or obj:IsA("Highlight") then
                        if obj.Name ~= "AdaptESP_HL" then
                            obj:Destroy()
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("Light") then
                        local sourcePart = obj:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if sourcePart then
                            sourcePart.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        end
                        obj:Destroy()
                    elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                        obj.Image = ""
                    elseif obj:IsA("Sky") or obj:IsA("Atmosphere") or obj:IsA("Clouds") or obj:IsA("PostEffect") then
                        if not obj:GetAttribute("_AdaptSky") then
                            obj:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
                Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
                Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
                Lighting.FogStart = 1e9
                Lighting.FogEnd = 1e9
                local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                if terrain then
                    terrain.Decoration = false
                    terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
                    terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
                    terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
                    terrain.WaterTransparency = 1
                end
                for _, effect in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
                    strip(effect)
                end
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                for index, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if not _G._AdaptVisualStripOn then
                        return
                    end
                    strip(obj)
                    if index % 200 == 0 then
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            end)
            table.insert(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections, workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                task.defer(strip, obj)
            end))
            table.insert(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections, Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                task.defer(strip, obj)
            end))
        end
        _G._AdaptStopVisualStrip = function()
            _G._AdaptVisualStripOn = false
            for _, conn in ipairs(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections or {}) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _G._AdaptVisualStripConnections = {}
        end
    end
    local _stretchConn, _fovConn
    local function startStretch()
        Util.stretch = true
        if _stretchConn then
            _stretchConn:Disconnect();
            _stretchConn = nil
        end
        _G._VynxStretchValue = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VynxStretchValue) or 0.70, 0.3, 1.0)
        _stretchConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not Util.stretch then
                return
            end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then
                return
            end
            local value = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VynxStretchValue) or 0.70, 0.3, 1.0)
            pcall(function()
                local wantFov = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VezyStretchFOV) or 120, 70, 120)
                if cam.FieldOfView ~= wantFov then
                    cam.FieldOfView = wantFov
                end
                cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, value, 0, 0, 0, 1)
            end)
        end))
    end
    local function stopStretch()
        Util.stretch = false
        if _stretchConn then
            _stretchConn:Disconnect();
            _stretchConn = nil
        end
        pcall(function()
            workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70
        end)
    end
    local function startFov()
        Util.fov = true
        if _fovConn then
            _fovConn:Disconnect();
            _fovConn = nil
        end
        _fovConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not Util.fov then
                return
            end
            local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local want = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VezyCustomFOV) or 120, 70, 120)
            if c and c.FieldOfView ~= want then
                pcall(function()
                    c.FieldOfView = want
                end)
            end
        end))
    end
    local function stopFov()
        Util.fov = false
        if _fovConn then
            _fovConn:Disconnect();
            _fovConn = nil
        end
        pcall(function()
            workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70
        end)
    end
    _G.VezyEnableFOV = startFov
    _G.VezyDisableFOV = stopFov
    _G._VynxEnableStretchRez = startStretch
    _G._VynxDisableStretchRez = stopStretch

        end)

        setNoCamCollision(true)

    local function setHeadless(character, enabled)
        local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then
            return
        end
        local transparency = enabled and 1 or 0
        head.Transparency = transparency
        head.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency
        for _, object in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
            if object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") or object:IsA("BasePart") then
                object.Transparency = transparency
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency
                end
            end
        end
    end

    _G._RaVeClearKorblox = function()
        local character = LP.Character
        if not character then
            return
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "Korblox_LeftLeg",
            "Korblox_RightLeg",
            "RaVeKorblox_Left",
            "RaVeKorblox_Right",
        }) do
            local old = character:FindFirstChild(name)
            if old then
                pcall(function()
                    old:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "LeftUpperLeg",
            "LeftLowerLeg",
            "LeftFoot",
            "RightUpperLeg",
            "RightLowerLeg",
            "RightFoot",
        }) do
            local limb = character:FindFirstChild(name)
            if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
                limb.Transparency = 0
                limb.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
            end
        end
    end
    _G._RaVeAttachKorblox = function(itemName)
        local config = _G._RaVeKorbloxAssets[itemName]
        local character = LP.Character
        if not config or not character then
            return false, "No character"
        end
        local targetPart = character:FindFirstChild(config.targetBodyPart)
        if not targetPart then
            return false, "Target part missing"
        end
        local oldAsset = character:FindFirstChild("Korblox_" .. itemName:gsub("%s+", ""))
        if oldAsset then
            oldAsset:Destroy()
        end
        for _, partName in ipairs(config.partsToHide) do
            local limb = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
            if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
                limb.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
        local success, objects = pcall(function()
            return game:GetObjects(config.id)
        end)
        if not success or not objects or # objects == 0 then
            return false, "Asset fetch failed"
        end
        local assetModel = objects[1]
        assetModel.Name = "Korblox_" .. itemName:gsub("%s+", "")
        local mainMesh = assetModel:IsA("BasePart") and assetModel or assetModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if not mainMesh then
            pcall(function()
                assetModel:Destroy()
            end)
            return false, "No MeshPart in asset"
        end
        mainMesh.Size = mainMesh.Size * config.scale
        mainMesh.CanCollide = false
        mainMesh.CanTouch = false
        mainMesh.CanQuery = false
        mainMesh.Massless = true
        mainMesh.CFrame = targetPart.CFrame * config.offset
        local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld.Part0 = targetPart
        weld.Part1 = mainMesh
        weld.Parent = mainMesh
        assetModel.Parent = character
        if config.audio then
            local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
            sound.SoundId = config.audio
            sound.Volume = 0.5
            sound.Parent = mainMesh
            sound:Play()
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 3)
        end
        return true, nil
    end
    _G._RaVeApplyKorblox = function(mode)
        if mode == "Left Leg" then
            mode = "Left"
        elseif mode == "Right Leg" then
            mode = "Right"
        end
        mode =(mode == "Left" or mode == "Right" or mode == "Both") and mode or "Off"
        _G._RaVeClearKorblox()
        _G._RaVeKorbloxMode = mode
        if mode == "Left" or mode == "Both" then
            pcall(_G._RaVeAttachKorblox, "Left Leg")
        end
        if mode == "Right" or mode == "Both" then
            pcall(_G._RaVeAttachKorblox, "Right Leg")
        end
    end
    local startShiny, stopShiny do
        _G.AceShinyGraphics = _G.AceShinyGraphics or {
            shinyEnabled = false,
            runtimeOn = false,
            shinyConns = {},
            shinyOriginals = {}
        }
        local SH = _G.AceShinyGraphics
        for _, conn in ipairs(SH.shinyConns or {}) do
            pcall(function()
                conn:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        SH.shinyConns = {}
        SH.shinyOriginals = SH.shinyOriginals or {}
        SH.runtimeOn = false
        SH.shinyEnabled = false
        local function shinePart(obj)
            pcall(function()
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    SH.shinyOriginals[obj] = SH.shinyOriginals[obj] or {
                        Material = obj.Material,
                        Reflectance = obj.Reflectance,
                        CastShadow = obj.CastShadow
                    }
                    obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    obj.Reflectance = 0.75
                    obj.CastShadow = false
                end
            end)
        end
        local function effect(class, name)
            local inst = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
            if inst and not inst:IsA(class) then
                pcall(function()
                    inst:Destroy()
                end)
                inst = nil
            end
            if not inst then
                inst = Instance.new(class)
                inst.Name = name
                inst.Parent = Lighting
            end
            return inst
        end
        local function applyEffects()
            local bloom = effect("BloomEffect", "AceShinyBloom")
            bloom.Intensity, bloom.Size, bloom.Threshold, bloom.Enabled = 1.6, 52, 0.75, true
            local rays = effect("SunRaysEffect", "AceShinySunRays")
            rays.Intensity, rays.Spread, rays.Enabled = 0.55, 1, true
            local cc = effect("ColorCorrectionEffect", "AceShinyColorCorrection")
            cc.Saturation, cc.Contrast, cc.Brightness, cc.Enabled = 0.9, 0.22, 0.07, true
        end
        startShiny = function()
            Util.shiny = true
            SH.shinyEnabled = true
            if SH.runtimeOn then
                pcall(applyEffects);
                return
            end
            SH.runtimeOn = true
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                shinePart(obj)
            end
            for _, conn in ipairs(SH.shinyConns) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            SH.shinyConns = {}
            table.insert(SH.shinyConns, workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if SH.shinyEnabled then
                    shinePart(obj)
                end
            end))
            pcall(applyEffects)
        end
        stopShiny = function()
            Util.shiny = false
            SH.shinyEnabled = false
            SH.runtimeOn = false
            for _, conn in ipairs(SH.shinyConns) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            SH.shinyConns = {}
            for obj, saved in pairs(SH.shinyOriginals) do
                pcall(function()
                    obj.Material = saved.Material
                    obj.Reflectance = saved.Reflectance
                    obj.CastShadow = saved.CastShadow
                end)
            end
            SH.shinyOriginals = {}
            for _, name in ipairs({
                "AceShinyBloom",
                "AceShinySunRays",
                "AceShinyColorCorrection"
            }) do
                local inst = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
                if inst then
                    pcall(function()
                        inst:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end

            local state = _G._RaVeDarkMode
            if on == true then
                if not state.saved then
                    state.saved = {
                        brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
                        clock = Lighting.ClockTime,
                        outdoor = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
                        exposure = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
                    }
                end
                state.enabled = true
                pcall(function()
                    local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("RaVeDarkModeSky")
                    if not sky or not sky:IsA("Sky") then
                        if sky then
                            sky:Destroy()
                        end
                        sky = Instance.new("Sky")
                        sky.Name = "RaVeDarkModeSky"
                    end
                    sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://159454299"
                    sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://159454296"
                    sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://159454293"
                    sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://159454286"
                    sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://159454289"
                    sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://159454291"
                    sky.Parent = Lighting
                    Lighting.Brightness = 0
                    Lighting.ClockTime = 0
                    Lighting.ExposureCompensation = -(_G._RaVeDarkLevel or 2)
                    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                end)
                return
            end
            state.enabled = false
            pcall(function()
                local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("RaVeDarkModeSky")
                if sky then
                    sky:Destroy()
                end
                local saved = state.saved
                if saved then
                    Lighting.Brightness = saved.brightness
                    Lighting.ClockTime = saved.clock
                    Lighting.ExposureCompensation = saved.exposure
                    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = saved.outdoor
                end
            end)
