        end
    end
    do
        _G._AdaptESPColor = _G._VioletteccAccent or ACC
        _G._AdaptESPEnabled = _G._VynxAuraESP == true
        _G._AdaptESPShowBox = _G._VynxBoxedESP == true
        if type(_G._AdaptESPBoxFill) ~= "number" then
            _G._AdaptESPBoxFill = 0.72
        end
        _G._AdaptESPShowTracer = _G._VynxShowTracker == true
        local espData = {}
        local espSG = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        espSG.Name = "AdaptESP_Visual"
        espSG.ResetOnSpawn = false
        espSG.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        espSG.DisplayOrder = - 1000
        pcall(function()
            espSG.Parent =(gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
        end)
        if not espSG.Parent then
            espSG.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        end
        local function attachHL(player, char)
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local old = char:FindFirstChild("AdaptESP_HL");
            if old then
                old:Destroy()
            end
            local col = _G._AdaptESPColor
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "AdaptESP_HL"
            hl.FillColor = col;
            hl.OutlineColor = col
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.4;
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 1
            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            hl.Enabled = _G._AdaptESPEnabled
            hl.Adornee = char;
            hl.Parent = char
            return hl
        end
        local function buildVisuals(player)
            local col = _G._AdaptESPColor
            local box = Instance.new("Frame", espSG)
            box.Name = "ESP_BOX_" .. player.Name
            box.BackgroundColor3 = col
            box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            box.BorderSizePixel = 0
            box.Visible = false;
            box.ZIndex = 9999
            local boxSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", box)
            boxSt.Color = col;
            boxSt.Thickness = 1.5
            boxSt.Transparency = 0.1
            boxSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            local tracer = Instance.new("Frame", espSG)
            tracer.Name = "ESP_TRACER_" .. player.Name
            tracer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            tracer.BackgroundColor3 = col
            tracer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
            tracer.BorderSizePixel = 0;
            tracer.Visible = false;
            tracer.ZIndex = 9998
            local offscreen = Instance.new("TextLabel", espSG)
            offscreen.Name = "ESP_DIRECTION_" .. player.Name
            offscreen.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            offscreen.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
            offscreen.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            offscreen.Text = utf8.char(0x25B2)
            offscreen.TextColor3 = col
            offscreen.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            offscreen.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
            offscreen.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            offscreen.TextSize = 21
            offscreen.Visible = false
            offscreen.ZIndex = 10002
            return box, tracer, offscreen
        end
        local function refreshESPColor(newColor)
            _G._AdaptESPColor = newColor
            for _, d in pairs(espData) do
                if d.box then
                    local st = d.box:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if st then
                        st.Color = newColor
                    end
                    d.box.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
                end
                if d.tracer then
                    d.tracer.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
                end
                if d.offscreen then
                    d.offscreen.TextColor3 = newColor
                end
                if d.hl then
                    d.hl.FillColor = newColor;
                    d.hl.OutlineColor = newColor
                end
            end
        end
        _G._AdaptRefreshESPColor = refreshESPColor
        local function createForPlayer(player)
            if player == LP then
                return
            end
            if espData[player] then
                return
            end
            local box, tracer, offscreen = buildVisuals(player)
            local d = {
                box = box,
                tracer = tracer,
                offscreen = offscreen,
                hl = nil
            }
            espData[player] = d
            if player.Character then
                d.hl = attachHL(player, player.Character)
            end
            d.charConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                task.wait(0.4)
                d.hl = attachHL(player, char)
            end)
        end
        local function clearPlayer(player)
            local d = espData[player];
            if not d then
                return
            end
            if d.charConn then
                pcall(function()
                    d.charConn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            for _, key in ipairs({
                "box",
                "tracer",
                "offscreen",
                "hl"
            }) do
                if d[key] then
                    pcall(function()
                        d[key]:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
            espData[player] = nil
        end
        hubConnect(Players.PlayerAdded, createForPlayer)
        hubConnect(Players.PlayerRemoving, clearPlayer)
        task.spawn(function()
            while espSG.Parent do
                task.wait(2)
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LP then
                        if not espData[p] then
                            pcall(createForPlayer, p)
                        else
                            local d = espData[p]
                            local char = p.Character
                            if char and(not d.hl or d.hl.Parent ~= char) then
                                pcall(function()
                                    if d.hl then
                                        d.hl:Destroy()
                                    end
                                end)
                                d.hl = attachHL(p, char)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        hubConnect(RunService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera;
            if not cam then
                return
            end
            local boxOn = _G._AdaptESPShowBox == true
            local tracerOn = _G._AdaptESPShowTracer == true
            local on = boxOn or tracerOn
            local viewSize = cam.ViewportSize
            local startX, startY
            local myChar = LP.Character
            local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myHRP then
                local myScr = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(myHRP.Position + Vector3.new(0, - 0.5, 0))
                if myScr.Z > 0 then
                    startX = math.clamp(myScr.X, 10, viewSize.X - 10)
                    startY = math.clamp(myScr.Y, 10, viewSize.Y - 10)
                end
            end
            if not startX then
                startX = viewSize.X / 2;
                startY = viewSize.Y * 0.85
            end
            for player, d in pairs(espData) do
                local char = player.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not on or not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                    d.box.Visible = false;
                    d.tracer.Visible = false
                    d.offscreen.Visible = false
                else
                    local topS = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))
                    local botS = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, - 3.0, 0))
                    if topS.Z > 0 then
                        local boxH = math.abs(botS.Y - topS.Y)
                        local boxW = boxH * 0.55
                        local cx =(topS.X + botS.X) / 2
                        local cy =(topS.Y + botS.Y) / 2
                        d.box.Position = UDim2.new(0, cx - boxW / 2, 0, cy - boxH / 2)
                        d.box.Size = UDim2.new(0, boxW, 0, boxH)
                        d.box.Visible = boxOn
                        local dx, dy = cx - startX, cy - startY
                        local length = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
                        d.tracer.Position = UDim2.new(0,(startX + cx) / 2, 0,(startY + cy) / 2)
                        d.tracer.Size = UDim2.new(0, length, 0, 1)
                        d.tracer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
                        d.tracer.Visible = tracerOn
                        d.offscreen.Visible = false
                    else
                        d.box.Visible = false
                        local rootS = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                        local centerX, centerY = viewSize.X * 0.5, viewSize.Y * 0.5
                        local targetX, targetY = rootS.X, rootS.Y
                        if rootS.Z <= 0 then
                            targetX = viewSize.X - targetX
                            targetY = viewSize.Y - targetY
                        end
                        local dx, dy = targetX - centerX, targetY - centerY
                        if math.abs(dx) < 0.001 and math.abs(dy) < 0.001 then
                            dy = - 1
                        end
                        local margin = 30
                        local tx =(centerX - margin) / math.max(math.abs(dx), 0.001)
                        local ty =(centerY - margin) / math.max(math.abs(dy), 0.001)
                        local edgeScale = math.min(tx, ty)
                        local edgeX = centerX + dx * edgeScale
                        local edgeY = centerY + dy * edgeScale
                        local lineDx, lineDy = edgeX - startX, edgeY - startY
                        local length = math.sqrt(lineDx * lineDx + lineDy * lineDy)
                        d.tracer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((startX + edgeX) * 0.5,(startY + edgeY) * 0.5)
                        d.tracer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(length, 1)
                        d.tracer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(lineDy, lineDx))
                        d.tracer.Visible = _G._AdaptESPShowTracer == true
                        d.offscreen.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(edgeX, edgeY)
                        d.offscreen.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)) + 90
                        d.offscreen.Visible = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
        _G._AdaptESPSetEnabled = function(on)
            _G._AdaptESPEnabled = on and true or false
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LP and not espData[p] then
                    pcall(createForPlayer, p)
                end
            end
            for _, d in pairs(espData) do
                if d.hl then
                    d.hl.Enabled = _G._AdaptESPEnabled
                end
            end
        end
        _G._AdaptESPSetShowTracer = function(on)
            _G._AdaptESPShowTracer = on and true or false
        end
        _G._AdaptESPSetShowBox = function(on)
            _G._AdaptESPShowBox = on and true or false
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then
                pcall(createForPlayer, p)
            end
        end
        _G._AdaptESPSetEnabled(_G._VynxAuraESP == true)
    end
    enableOptimizer = function()
        Util.antilag = true;
        Enabled.Optimizer = true;
        pcall(_G._AdaptStartAntiLag)
    end
    disableOptimizer = function()
        Util.antilag = false;
        Enabled.Optimizer = false;
        pcall(_G._AdaptStopAntiLag)
    end
    enableUltraMode = function()
        Util.potato = true;
        ultraModeEnabled = true;
        pcall(_G._AdaptStartVisualStrip)
    end
    disableUltraMode = function()
        Util.potato = false;
        ultraModeEnabled = false;
        pcall(_G._AdaptStopVisualStrip)
    end
    startRemoveAccessories = function()
        Enabled.ShinyGraphics = true;
        Enabled.RemoveAccessories = true;
        pcall(startShiny)
    end
    stopRemoveAccessories = function()
        Enabled.ShinyGraphics = false;
        Enabled.RemoveAccessories = false;
        pcall(stopShiny)
    end
    _G._AdaptSetNoCamCollision = setNoCamCollision
    _G._AdaptSetAuraESP = function(on)
        pcall(_G._AdaptESPSetEnabled, on)
    end
    _G._AdaptSetHeadless = function(on)
        _G._VynxHeadless = on and true or false
        pcall(setHeadless, LP.Character, _G._VynxHeadless)
    end
    _G._AdaptSetKorblox = function(m)
        pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, m or "Off")
    end
    _G._AdaptSetAntiLag = function(on)
        if on then
            enableOptimizer()
        else
            disableOptimizer()
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptSetPotato = function(on)
        if on then
            enableUltraMode()
        else
            disableUltraMode()
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptSetShiny = function(on)
        if on then
            startRemoveAccessories()
        else
            stopRemoveAccessories()
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptSetDarkMode = function(on)
        pcall(_G._RaVeSetDarkMode, on)
    end
    do
        local lastESP, lastBox, lastTrk = nil, nil, nil
        local lastHeadless, lastKorblox = nil, nil
        local lastDark, lastDarkLevel = nil, nil
        local acc = 0
        hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            acc = acc + dt
            if acc < 0.2 then
                return
            end
            acc = 0
            local esp = _G._VynxAuraESP == true
            if esp ~= lastESP then
                lastESP = esp;
                pcall(_G._AdaptESPSetEnabled, esp)
            end
            local box = _G._VynxBoxedESP == true
            if box ~= lastBox then
                lastBox = box;
                _G._AdaptESPShowBox = box
            end
            local trk = _G._VynxShowTracker == true
            if trk ~= lastTrk then
                lastTrk = trk;
                _G._AdaptESPShowTracer = trk
            end
            local hl = _G._VynxHeadless == true
            if hl ~= lastHeadless then
                lastHeadless = hl
                pcall(setHeadless, LP.Character, hl)
            end
            local kb = _G._VynxKorblox or "Off"
            if kb ~= lastKorblox then
                lastKorblox = kb;
                pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, kb)
            end
            local dark = _G._VynxDarkModeOn == true
            if dark ~= lastDark then
                lastDark = dark;
                pcall(_G._RaVeSetDarkMode, dark)
            end
            local lvl = tonumber(_G._VynxDarkness) or 2
            if lvl ~= lastDarkLevel then
                lastDarkLevel = lvl;
                pcall(_G._RaVeSetDarkLevel, lvl)
            end
        end))
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function(char)
        task.wait(0.3)
        if _G._VynxHeadless then
            pcall(setHeadless, char, true)
        end
        for _ = 1, 10 do
            task.wait(0.5)
            if char.Parent == nil then
                return
            end
            local mode = _G._RaVeKorbloxMode
            if mode == "Off" then
                return
            end
            local needLeft =(mode == "Left" or mode == "Both") and char:FindFirstChild("Korblox_LeftLeg") == nil
            local needRight =(mode == "Right" or mode == "Both") and char:FindFirstChild("Korblox_RightLeg") == nil
            if needLeft or needRight then
                pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, mode)
            end
        end
    end)
    _G._VioletteccVisualRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopAntiLag)
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopVisualStrip)
            pcall(stopShiny)
            pcall(_G._RaVeSetDarkMode,
            false)
            pcall(stopFov);
            pcall(stopStretch)
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccVisualRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if Enabled.Optimizer then
        enableOptimizer()
    end
    if _G._VezyDisplayMode == "FOV" then
        startFov()
    elseif _G._VezyDisplayMode == "STRETCH" then
        startStretch()
    end
    if noCamCollisionEnabled then
        setNoCamCollision(true)
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    local SAVE_FILE = "VioletteHub_Auto.json"
    if _G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime and _G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local canWrite =(writefile ~= nil)
    local canRead =(readfile ~= nil and isfile ~= nil)
    local GLOBAL_KEYS = {
        "_VynxSpeedMethod",
        "NormalSpeed_Normal",
        "NormalSpeed_Carry",
        "LaggerSpeed_Normal",
        "LaggerSpeed_Carry",
        "_VynxAutoSpeedOn",
        "_VynxAutoSpeedMode",
        "_VynxAutoSpeedRange",
        "_VioletteccFakeSpeed",
        "_VynxAutoStealMode",
        "_VynxAutoGrabPause",
        "_VynxAutoStealVersion",
        "_AdaptStealBarScale",
        "_VynxStealRadiusNormal",
        "_VynxStealRadiusSemi",
        "_VynxStealDelayRadius",
        "_VezyBatAimbotSpeed",
        "_VezyBatAimbotSpeedLagger",
        "_VezyBatAimbotMode",
        "_VezyBatAimbotOn",
        "_VezyAutoSwingEnabled",
        "_VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing",
        "_VioletteccAutoMedusa",
        "_VezyBatCounterOn",
        "_VynxMirrorTPDown",
        "_VynxRemoveCamShake",
        "_VezyBypassChaseSpeed",
        "_VezyJumpMode",
        "_VezyInfiniteJumpPower",
        "_AdaptInfJumpMode",
        "_VynxRagdollMode",
        "_VynxDropType",
        "_VynxTPDownMode",
        "_VynxAutoTPDownEnabled",
        "_VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger",
        "_VynxAnimPack",
        "_AdaptAnimPack",
        "_VioletteccIntroSong",
        "_VioletteccSkipIntro",
        "_VynxAntiDie",
        "_VynxAntiFling",
        "_VynxSafeMode",
        "_VynxKickWarning",
        "_AdaptAutoPlayMode",
        "_KawatanPathMode",
        "_VezyDisplayMode",
        "_VezyCustomFOV",
        "_VezyStretchFOV",
        "_VynxStretchValue",
        "_VezyCustomSkyMode",
        "_VynxAuraESP",
        "_VynxBoxedESP",
        "_VynxShowTracker",
        "_VynxHeadless",
        "_VynxKorblox",
        "_VynxDarkModeOn",
        "_VynxDarkness",
        "_VynxCustomSkin",
        "_KawatanSkinColor",
        "_VlonEBodyType",
        "_VynxAvatarESP",
        "_VynxRagdollCountdown",
        "_VynxESPSelection",
        "_VynxESPOn",
        "_VynxBodyLockOn",
        "_VynxBodyLockRange",
        "_VynxMobileBtnScale",
        "_VynxMobileCircle",
        "_VezyHideSideBtns",
        "_VezyBgOpacity",
        "_VezyBtnOpacity",
        "_VezyBgImageId",
        "_VynxInstaResetKey",
        "_VynxUILocked",
    }
    local function isScalar(v)
        local t = type(v)
        return t == "string" or t == "number" or t == "boolean"
    end
    local function collect()
        local cfg = {
            version = 1
        }
        cfg.globals = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(GLOBAL_KEYS) do
            local v = _G[key]
            if isScalar(v) then
                cfg.globals[key] = v
            end
        end
        local settingPrefixes = {
            "_Vynx",
            "_Vezy",
            "_Adapt",
            "_Violettecc",
            "_RaVe",
            "_Kawatan",
            "_Vl",
            "_Ambitious",
            "_Candy",
            "_VX7",
        }
        for key, value in pairs(_G) do
            if type(key) == "string" and isScalar(value) then
                for _, prefix in ipairs(settingPrefixes) do
                    if string.sub(key, 1, # prefix) == prefix then
                        cfg.globals[key] = value
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        cfg.keybinds = {}
        pcall(function()
            for name, kc in pairs(Keybinds) do
                if typeof(kc) == "EnumItem" then
                    cfg.keybinds[name] = kc.Name
                end
            end
        end)
        cfg.enabled = {}
        pcall(function()
            for name, on in pairs(Enabled) do
                cfg.enabled[name] = on == true
            end
        end)
        cfg.infiniteJump = Enabled.InfiniteJump == true
        cfg.jumpMode =(_G._VezyJumpMode == "Manual") and "Manual" or "Hold"
        cfg.jumpPower = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VezyInfiniteJumpPower) or 55, 20, 150)
        cfg.autoTpDown = _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled == true
        cfg.autoTpDownY = tonumber(_G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger) or 20
        cfg.autoStealVersion =(_G._VynxAutoStealVersion == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
        cfg.globals._VynxAutoStealVersion = cfg.autoStealVersion
        cfg.settings = {}
        pcall(function()
            cfg.settings.StealRadius = Settings.StealRadius
            cfg.settings.AutoStealEnabled = Settings.AutoStealEnabled == true
        end)
        pcall(function()
            cfg.speed = {
                family = Spd.family,
                carry = Spd.carry == true
            }
        end)
        cfg.flags = {}
        pcall(function()
            cfg.flags.autoBat = autoBatToggled == true
            cfg.flags.autoSwing = autoSwingEnabled == true
            cfg.flags.medusaCounter = medusaCounterEnabled == true
            cfg.flags.batCounter =(BC and BC.enabled) == true
            cfg.flags.noCamCollision = noCamCollisionEnabled == true
            cfg.flags.ultraMode = ultraModeEnabled == true
            cfg.flags.desync = desyncEnabled == true
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local c = _G._VioletteccAccent
            if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
                cfg.accent = {
                    math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5),
                    math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5),
                    math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
                }
            end
        end)
        cfg.ui = {}
        pcall(function()
            cfg.ui.scale = UI_SCALE
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local outer = _G.VynxOuterRef
            if outer and outer.Parent then
                local p, s = outer.Position, outer.Size
                cfg.ui.winPos = {
                    p.X.Scale,
                    p.X.Offset,
                    p.Y.Scale,
                    p.Y.Offset
                }
                cfg.ui.winSize = {
                    s.X.Scale,
                    s.X.Offset,
                    s.Y.Scale,
                    s.Y.Offset
                }
                if _G._VioletteccIntroActive == true then
                    cfg.ui.winVisible = true
                    cfg.ui.userHidHub = _G._VioletteccUserHidHub == true
                else
                    cfg.ui.userHidHub = _G._VioletteccUserHidHub == true
                    if cfg.ui.userHidHub then
                        cfg.ui.winVisible = false
                    else
                        cfg.ui.winVisible = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G._VlPbPos) == "table" and # _G._VlPbPos == 4 then
                cfg.stealBarPos = _G._VlPbPos
            end
            cfg.stealBarScale = tonumber(_G._AdaptStealBarScale) or 1.0
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local frame = _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame
            local parent = frame and frame.Parent
            if parent then
                local out = {}
                for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("TextButton") and child.Name:sub(1, 3) == "MB_" then
                        local p = child.Position
                        out[child.Name:sub(4)] = {
                            xs = p.X.Scale,
                            xo = p.X.Offset,
                            ys = p.Y.Scale,
                            yo = p.Y.Offset
                        }
                    end
                end
                if next(out) then
                    cfg.mobileBtnPos = out
                    cfg.mobileBtnLayout = _G._VynxMobileLayoutVersion
                end
                if type(_G._VynxMobileShown) == "table" then
                    local hidden = {}
                    for k, v in pairs(_G._VynxMobileShown) do
                        if v == false then
                            hidden[k] = false
                        end
                    end
                    if next(hidden) then
                        cfg.mobileBtnShown = hidden
                    end
                end
                cfg.ui.mobileVisible =(_G._VezyHideSideBtns ~= true)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if _G._VioletteccCollectPanels then
                cfg.panels = _G._VioletteccCollectPanels()
            end
        end)
        return cfg
    end
    local function apply(cfg)
        if type(cfg) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        if type(cfg.globals) == "table" then
            for key, v in pairs(cfg.globals) do
                if isScalar(v) then
                    _G[key] = v
                end
            end
        end
        local savedAutoStealVersion = cfg.autoStealVersion
        if savedAutoStealVersion == nil and type(cfg.globals) == "table" then
            savedAutoStealVersion = cfg.globals._VynxAutoStealVersion
        end
        if savedAutoStealVersion == "V1" or savedAutoStealVersion == "V2" then
            _G._VynxAutoStealVersion = savedAutoStealVersion
        end
        if cfg.jumpMode == "Manual" or cfg.jumpMode == "Hold" then
            _G._VezyJumpMode = cfg.jumpMode
            _G._AdaptInfJumpMode = string.upper(cfg.jumpMode)
        end
        if tonumber(cfg.jumpPower) then
            _G._VezyInfiniteJumpPower = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.jumpPower), 20, 150)
        end
        if cfg.infiniteJump ~= nil then
            Enabled.InfiniteJump = cfg.infiniteJump == true
        end
        if cfg.autoTpDown ~= nil then
            _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = cfg.autoTpDown == true
        end

    local lastJson = nil
    local pending = false
    _G._VioletteccBootDone = false
    local function writeNow()
        if not canWrite then
            return
        end
        if not _G._VioletteccBootDone then
            return
        end
        if _G._VioletteccSettingsReset == true then
            return
        end
        pending = false
        local ok, json = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONEncode(collect())
        end)
        if not ok or type(json) ~= "string" then
            return
        end
        if json == lastJson then
            return
        end
        local writeOk = pcall(writefile, SAVE_FILE, json)
        if writeOk then
            lastJson = json
        end
    end
    local function writeSoon()
        if pending then
            return
        end
        pending = true
        task.delay(0.6,
        function()
            if pending then
                writeNow()
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.KRIXSaveNow = writeSoon
    _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant = writeNow
    saveConfig = writeSoon
    _G._VioletteccSaveNow = writeNow
    _G._VioletteccCollectConfig = collect
    _G._VioletteccApplyConfig = apply

        acc = acc + dt
        if acc < 5 then
            return
        end
        acc = 0
        writeNow()
    end))
    pcall(function()
        hubConnect(LP.AncestryChanged,
        function(_, parent)
            if not parent then
                writeNow()
            end
        end)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        game:BindToClose(function()
            writeNow()
        end)
    end)
    _G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()

            c in ipairs(_conns) do

                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if canRead and isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, SAVE_FILE)
            if not ok or type(raw) ~= "string" then
                task.wait(2);
                _G._VioletteccBootDone = true
                return
            end
            local ok2, cfg = pcall(function()
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
            end)
            if not ok2 or type(cfg) ~= "table" then
                task.wait(2);
                _G._VioletteccBootDone = true
                return
            end
            lastJson = raw
            task.wait(0.4)
            pcall(apply, cfg)
            task.wait(1.2)
            pcall(function()
                for name, lbl in pairs(KB) do
                    local kc = Keybinds[name]
                    if lbl and lbl.Parent then
                        lbl.Text = _G._VioletteccKeyName(kc)
                    end
                end
            end)
            _G._VioletteccBootDone = true
        end)
    else
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.5)
            local DEFAULT_CFG = {
                version = 1,
                globals = {
                    _VynxSpeedMethod = "V2",
                    _VynxAutoSpeedOn = false,

                    NormalSpeed_Carry = 29,

                    _VynxAutoStealMode = "Normal",
                    _VynxAutoGrabPause = 75,
                    _VezyBatAimbotOn = false,
                    _VezyBatAimbotMode = "v1",
                    _VezyBatAimbotSpeed = 58,
                    _VezyBatAimbotSpeedLagger = 40,
                    _VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing = true,
                    _VioletteccAutoMedusa = true,
                    _VynxMirrorTPDown = false,
                    _VynxRemoveCamShake = false,
                    _VezyJumpMode = "Hold",
                    _VezyInfiniteJumpPower = 55,
                    _VynxRagdollMode = nil,
                    _VynxDropType = "Jump Drop",
                    _VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = false,
                    _VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger = 20,

                    _VezyCustomSkyMode = "Off",
                    _VynxHeadless = false,
                    _VynxKorblox = "Off",
                    _VynxCustomSkin = false,
                    _KawatanSkinColor = "1",

(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccAvatarESPRuntime and _G._VioletteccAvatarESPRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAvatarESPRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local billboards = {}
    local holder = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    holder.Name = "VioletteAvatarESP"
    holder.ResetOnSpawn = false
    holder.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    holder.DisplayOrder = - 999
    pcall(function()
        holder.Parent =(gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    if not holder.Parent then
        holder.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    end
    local function accent()
        return _G._VioletteccAccent or _G._AdaptESPColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    local function createAvatarBillboard(player)
        if billboards[player] and billboards[player].Parent then
            return billboards[player]
        end
        local billboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboardGui.Name = "AvatarRond_" .. player.Name
        billboardGui.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.9, 1.9)
        billboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(3.4, 2.2, 0)
        billboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboardGui.Enabled = false
        billboardGui.Parent = holder
        local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        frame.Parent = billboardGui
        local avatarFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
        avatarFrame.Name = "Ring"
        avatarFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        avatarFrame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.82)
        avatarFrame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        avatarFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        avatarFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
        avatarFrame.Parent = frame
        local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        uiCorner.Parent = avatarFrame
        local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        stroke.Color = accent()
        stroke.Thickness = 2
        stroke.Parent = avatarFrame
        local avatarImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        avatarImage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        avatarImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        avatarImage.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. player.UserId .. "&w=48&h=48"
        avatarImage.Parent = avatarFrame
        local avatarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
        avatarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        avatarCorner.Parent = avatarImage
        billboards[player] = billboardGui
        return billboardGui
    end
    local function clearPlayer(player)
        local bb = billboards[player]
        if bb then
            pcall(function()
                bb:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        billboards[player] = nil
    end
    hubConnect(Players.PlayerAdded,
    function(p)
        if p ~= LP then
            pcall(createAvatarBillboard, p)
        end
    end)
    hubConnect(Players.PlayerRemoving, clearPlayer)
    local AVA_BASE = 1.9
    local AVA_NEAR = 24
    local AVA_FAR = 160
    local AVA_MAX = 1.9
    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local on = _G._VynxAvatarESP == true
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camPos = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LP then
                local bb = billboards[player]
                if on and not bb then
                    bb = createAvatarBillboard(player)
                end
                if bb then
                    local char = player.Character
                    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if on and root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                        bb.Adornee = root
                        bb.Enabled = true
                        if camPos then
                            local dist =(camPos - root.Position).Magnitude
                            local grow = math.clamp(dist / AVA_NEAR, 1, AVA_FAR / AVA_NEAR)
                            grow = math.min(grow, AVA_MAX)
                            bb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(AVA_BASE * grow, AVA_BASE * grow)
                        end
                    else
                        bb.Enabled = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end))
    local function setEnabled(on)
        _G._VynxAvatarESP = on and true or false
        if _G._VynxAvatarESP then
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LP then
                    pcall(createAvatarBillboard, p)
                end
            end
        else
            for _, bb in pairs(billboards) do
                if bb and bb.Parent then
                    bb.Enabled = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccRefreshAvatarESPColor = function()
        local col = accent()
        for _, bb in pairs(billboards) do
            if bb and bb.Parent then
                local ring = bb:FindFirstChild("Ring", true)
                local st = ring and ring:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                if st then
                    st.Color = col
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccSetAvatarESP = setEnabled
    _G._VioletteccAvatarESPRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            bb in pairs(billboards) do
                pcall(function()
                    bb:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            billboards = {}
            pcall(function()
                holder:Destroy()
            end)
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccAvatarESPRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if _G._VynxAvatarESP then
        setEnabled(true)
    end
end)();
(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime and _G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local BodyLock = {
        Enabled = false,
        PlayersOnly = true,
        UseRange = true,
        Range = tonumber(_G._VynxBodyLockRange) or 9,
        TurnSpeed = 30,
    }
    _G._VioletteccBodyLock = BodyLock
    local connection
    local charConn
    local character
    local rootPart
    local humanoid
    local function validTarget(targetHumanoid, targetRoot)
        if not targetHumanoid or not targetRoot or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false
        end
        if BodyLock.PlayersOnly then
            local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetHumanoid.Parent)
            if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == LocalPlayer then
                return false
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function getTarget()
        BodyLock.Range = tonumber(_G._VynxBodyLockRange) or BodyLock.Range
        for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if model ~= character then
                local targetRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local targetHumanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if validTarget(targetHumanoid, targetRoot) then
                    if BodyLock.UseRange and rootPart then
                        local distance =(rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
                        if distance <= BodyLock.Range then
                            return targetRoot
                        end
                    else
                        return targetRoot
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function stop()
        BodyLock.Enabled = false
        _G._VynxBodyLockOn = false
        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
            connection = nil
        end
        if rootPart then
            rootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        end
    end
    local function start()
        BodyLock.Enabled = true
        _G._VynxBodyLockOn = true
        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not BodyLock.Enabled or not character or not character.Parent or not rootPart or not humanoid then
                return
            end
            local target = getTarget()
            if not target then
                rootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                return
            end
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false
            local lookVector = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
            local currentDirection = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)
            local offset = target.Position - rootPart.Position
            local targetDirection = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
            if currentDirection.Magnitude <= 0.001 or targetDirection.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
                return
            end
            currentDirection = currentDirection.Unit
            targetDirection = targetDirection.Unit
            local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(currentDirection:Dot(targetDirection), - 1, 1))
            local cross = currentDirection:Cross(targetDirection)
            rootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, cross.Y * angle * BodyLock.TurnSpeed, 0)
        end))
    end
    local function setupCharacter(newCharacter)
        character = newCharacter
        rootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        humanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if BodyLock.Enabled then
            task.delay(0.3, start)
        end
    end
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        task.spawn(setupCharacter, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)
    BodyLock.Start = start
    BodyLock.Stop = stop
    BodyLock.Toggle = function(enabled)
        if enabled == nil then
            enabled = not BodyLock.Enabled
        end
        if enabled then
            start()
        else
            stop()
        end
        if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.BodyLock then
            pcall(VisualSetters.BodyLock, BodyLock.Enabled)
        end
        return BodyLock.Enabled
    end
    _G._VioletteccStartBodyLock = start
    _G._VioletteccStopBodyLock = stop
    _G._VioletteccToggleBodyLock = BodyLock.Toggle
    _G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            stop()
            if charConn then
                pcall(function()
                    charConn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            charConn = nil
            _G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if _G._VynxBodyLockOn then
        start()
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    local UIS = UserInputService
    if _G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime and _G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local AP = {
        L = false,
        R = false,
        lRef = nil,
        rRef = nil
    }
    _G._AutoPath = AP
    _G._KawatanPathMode =(_G._KawatanPathMode == "AUTO PLAY") and "AUTO PLAY" or "NORMAL"
    local WAYPOINT_ORDER = {
        "L1",
        "LEND",
        "LFINAL",
        "R1",
        "REND",
        "RFINAL"
    }
    local WAYPOINT_DEFAULTS = {
        L1 = Vector3.new(- 474.92,
        - 7.29,
        94.61),
        LEND = Vector3.new(- 481.07,
        - 5.33,
        94.88),
        LFINAL = Vector3.new(- 471.56,
        - 6.83,
        6.73),
        R1 = Vector3.new(- 474.75,
        - 7.29,
        25.36),
        REND = Vector3.new(- 481.09,
        - 5.33,
        25.49),
        RFINAL = Vector3.new(- 470.93,
        - 6.83,
        113.65),
    }
    local NORMAL_L1 = Vector3.new(- 476.48, - 6.28, 92.73)
    local NORMAL_L2 = Vector3.new(- 483.12, - 4.95, 94.80)
    local NORMAL_R1 = Vector3.new(- 476.16, - 6.52, 25.62)
    local NORMAL_R2 = Vector3.new(- 483.06, - 5.03, 25.48)
    local function pathIsAutoPlay()
        if _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode == "Auto Play" then
            _G._KawatanPathMode = "AUTO PLAY"
        elseif _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode == "Normal" then
            _G._KawatanPathMode = "NORMAL"
        end
        return _G._KawatanPathMode == "AUTO PLAY"
    end
    local function getHRP()
        local char = LP.Character
        return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function getHum()
        local char = LP.Character
        return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    local function flatTo(root, target)
        return Vector3.new(target.X - root.Position.X, 0, target.Z - root.Position.Z)
    end
    local function speedPair()
        local n, c = Spd.Values()
        return tonumber(n) or 60, tonumber(c) or 29
    end
    local function autoRouteSpeed()
        local n = speedPair();
        return n
    end
    local function forwardSpeed()
        local n = speedPair();
        return n
    end
    local function returnSpeed()
        local _, c = speedPair();
        return c
    end
    local function routeStep(target)
        local character = LP.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false, nil
        end
        local offset = Vector3.new(target.X - root.Position.X, 0, target.Z - root.Position.Z)
        if offset.Magnitude <= 1 then
            return true, root
        end
        local direction = offset.Unit
        local speed = autoRouteSpeed()
        _G._RaVeLiveSpeed = {
            v = speed,
            t = os.clock()
        }
        local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        humanoid:Move(direction, false)
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(direction.X * speed, velocity.Y, direction.Z * speed)
        return false, root
    end
    local function tryAutoRouteSteal()
        local hook = _G._RaVeTryAutoRouteSteal
        if type(hook) == "function" then
            pcall(hook)
        end
    end
    local function clearAutoRouteMotion()
        local character = LP.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        end
        if root then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end
    local WAYPOINT_FILE = "KawatanAutoPathWaypoints.json"
    local Waypoints = {}
    for key, value in pairs(WAYPOINT_DEFAULTS) do
        Waypoints[key] = value
    end
    _G._KawatanAutoPathWaypoints = Waypoints
    local function saveWaypoints()
        if not writefile then
            return
        end
        local plain = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(WAYPOINT_ORDER) do
            local v = Waypoints[key]
            plain[key] = {
                x = v.X,
                y = v.Y,
                z = v.Z
            }
        end
        local ok, json = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONEncode(plain)
        end)
        if ok then
            pcall(writefile, WAYPOINT_FILE, json)
        end
    end
    local function loadWaypoints()
        if not(isfile and isfile(WAYPOINT_FILE)) then
            return
        end
        local ok, data = pcall(readfile, WAYPOINT_FILE)
        if not ok then
            return
        end
        local ok2, saved = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(data)
        end)
        if not(ok2 and type(saved) == "table") then
            return
        end
        for _, key in ipairs(WAYPOINT_ORDER) do
            local entry = saved[key]
            if type(entry) == "table" and tonumber(entry.x) and tonumber(entry.y) and tonumber(entry.z) then
                Waypoints[key] = Vector3.new(tonumber(entry.x), tonumber(entry.y), tonumber(entry.z))
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(loadWaypoints)
    _G._KawatanAutoPathSetWaypoint = function(key, position)
        if not Waypoints[key] then
            return false
        end
        position = position or(getHRP() and getHRP().Position)
        if not position then
            return false
        end
        Waypoints[key] = position
        saveWaypoints()
        return true
    end
    _G._KawatanAutoPathResetWaypoints = function()
        for key, value in pairs(WAYPOINT_DEFAULTS) do
            Waypoints[key] = value
        end
        saveWaypoints()
    end
    local SPEED_MAX_ACCEL = 1600
    local SPEED_DECEL_RESPONSE = 24
    local SPEED_TURN_RESPONSE = 34
    local speedLV, speedAttachment
    local smoothedVelocity = Vector2.zero
    local lastTargetMagnitude = 0
    local function destroySpeedActuator()
        if speedLV then
            pcall(function()
                speedLV.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.zero
                speedLV.Enabled = false
                speedLV:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if speedAttachment then
            pcall(function()
                speedAttachment:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        speedLV, speedAttachment = nil, nil
        smoothedVelocity = Vector2.zero
        lastTargetMagnitude = 0
    end
    local function getSpeedActuator(root)
        if not(root and root.Parent) then
            return nil
        end
        if not(speedLV and speedLV.Parent == root) then
            destroySpeedActuator()
            speedAttachment = root:FindFirstChild("VilonPathAttachment")
            if not(speedAttachment and speedAttachment:IsA("Attachment")) then
                speedAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                speedAttachment.Name = "VilonPathAttachment"
                speedAttachment.Parent = root
            end
            speedLV = root:FindFirstChild("VilonPathLinearVelocity")
            if not(speedLV and speedLV:IsA("LinearVelocity")) then
                speedLV = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
                speedLV.Name = "VilonPathLinearVelocity"
                speedLV.Parent = root
            end
            speedLV.Attachment0 = speedAttachment
            speedLV.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
            speedLV.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane
            speedLV.PrimaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
            speedLV.SecondaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
            speedLV.ForceLimitsEnabled = true
            speedLV.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
            speedLV.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.zero
        end
        local force = math.max(root.AssemblyMass, 1) * SPEED_MAX_ACCEL
        speedLV.MaxPlanarAxesForce = Vector2.new(force, force)
        return speedLV
    end
    local function driveTowards(root, humanoid, moveDir, speed, dt)
        local lv = getSpeedActuator(root)
        if not lv then
            return
        end
        dt = math.clamp(dt or(1 / 60), 1 / 240, 1 / 30)
        local target = Vector2.new(moveDir.X * speed, moveDir.Z * speed)
        local magnitude = target.Magnitude
        if magnitude > lastTargetMagnitude + 0.01 or(magnitude >= 0.01 and smoothedVelocity.Magnitude < 0.01) then
            smoothedVelocity = target
        else
            local response = SPEED_DECEL_RESPONSE
            if magnitude >= 0.01 and smoothedVelocity.Magnitude >= 0.01 then
                response = smoothedVelocity.Unit:Dot(target.Unit) < 0.96 and SPEED_TURN_RESPONSE or SPEED_DECEL_RESPONSE
            end
            smoothedVelocity = smoothedVelocity:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(- response * dt))
        end
        lastTargetMagnitude = magnitude
        _G._RaVeLiveSpeed = {
            v = speed,
            t = os.clock()
        }
        pcall(function()
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        end)
        lv.Enabled = true
        lv.PlaneVelocity = smoothedVelocity
    end
    local function haltMovement(root, humanoid)
        smoothedVelocity = Vector2.zero
        lastTargetMagnitude = 0
        if humanoid then
            pcall(function()
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            end)
        end
        if speedLV and speedLV.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                speedLV.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.zero
                speedLV.Enabled = false
            end)
        end
    end
    local movementLock = {
        active = false,
        controls = nil,
        jumpConn = nil,
        watchdog = nil,
        originalMoveFunction = nil,
        usedDisableFallback = false,
    }
    local function noopMove()
    end
    local function getPlayerControls()
        local ok, controls = pcall(function()
            local ps = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
            local pm = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
            if not pm then
                return nil
            end
            return require(pm):GetControls()
        end)
        return ok and controls or nil
    end
    local function applyMoveLock(controls)
        if not controls then
            return false
        end
        if controls.moveFunction == nil then
            return false
        end
        if controls.moveFunction ~= noopMove then
            movementLock.originalMoveFunction = controls.moveFunction
        end
        controls.moveFunction = noopMove
        return true
    end
    local function unlockMovement()
        if not movementLock.active then
            return
        end
        movementLock.active = false
        if movementLock.jumpConn then
            movementLock.jumpConn:Disconnect()
            movementLock.jumpConn = nil
        end
        movementLock.watchdog = nil
        local controls = movementLock.controls or getPlayerControls()
        if controls then
            pcall(function()
                if controls.moveFunction == noopMove then
                    controls.moveFunction = movementLock.originalMoveFunction or LP.Move
                end
                if movementLock.usedDisableFallback then
                    controls:Enable()
                end
            end)
        end
        movementLock.originalMoveFunction = nil
        movementLock.usedDisableFallback = false
        movementLock.controls = nil
    end
    local function playerRequestingMove()
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function lockMovement()
        if movementLock.active then
            return
        end
        movementLock.active = true
        movementLock.controls = getPlayerControls()
        movementLock.usedDisableFallback = false
        local ok = true
        if movementLock.controls then
            ok = false
            pcall(function()
                ok = applyMoveLock(movementLock.controls)
            end)
        end
        if not ok then
            movementLock.usedDisableFallback = true
            if movementLock.controls then
                pcall(function()
                    movementLock.controls:Disable()
                end)
            end
            movementLock.jumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
                if not movementLock.active then
                    return
                end
                local humanoid = getHum()
                if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    humanoid.Jump = true
                end
            end)
        end
        local token = {}
        movementLock.watchdog = token
        task.spawn(function()
            while movementLock.active and movementLock.watchdog == token do
                if not(AP.L or AP.R) then
                    unlockMovement()
                    break
                end
                local controls = movementLock.controls
                if not controls then
                    controls = getPlayerControls()
                    movementLock.controls = controls
                end
                if controls then
                    pcall(function()
                        if movementLock.usedDisableFallback then
                            controls:Disable()
                        else
                            applyMoveLock(controls)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
    end
    local orientConstraint = {
        hiddenPart = nil,
        targetAttach = nil,
        alignOrient = nil,
        charAttach = nil,
        charAttachOwned = false,
        originalAutoRotate = true,
    }
    local function cleanupOrientConstraint()
        if orientConstraint.hiddenPart then
            pcall(function()
                orientConstraint.hiddenPart:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if orientConstraint.charAttachOwned and orientConstraint.charAttach and orientConstraint.charAttach.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                orientConstraint.charAttach:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        local humanoid = getHum()
        if humanoid and orientConstraint.originalAutoRotate ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                humanoid.AutoRotate = orientConstraint.originalAutoRotate
            end)
        end
        orientConstraint.originalAutoRotate = nil
        orientConstraint.alignOrient = nil
        orientConstraint.targetAttach = nil
        orientConstraint.hiddenPart = nil
        orientConstraint.charAttach = nil
        orientConstraint.charAttachOwned = false
    end
    local function setupOrientConstraint()
        local root, humanoid = getHRP(), getHum()
        if not root or not humanoid then
            return
        end
        cleanupOrientConstraint()
        local hiddenPart = Instance.new("Part")
        hiddenPart.Name = "TerrainHelper"
        hiddenPart.Anchored = true
        hiddenPart.CanCollide, hiddenPart.CanQuery, hiddenPart.CanTouch = false, false, false
        hiddenPart.Transparency = 1
        hiddenPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
        hiddenPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, - 1000, 0)
        hiddenPart.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("Terrain") or workspace
        local targetAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
        targetAttach.Name = "RootAttachment"
        targetAttach.Parent = hiddenPart
        local charAttach = root:FindFirstChild("RootRigAttachment")
        local charAttachOwned = false
        if not charAttach then
            charAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
            charAttach.Name = "RootRigAttachment"
            charAttach.Parent = root
            charAttachOwned = true
        end
        local alignOrient = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
        alignOrient.Name = "PhysicsConstraint"
        alignOrient.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
        alignOrient.Attachment0 = charAttach
        alignOrient.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(- 1, 0, 0))
        alignOrient.MaxTorque = math.huge
        alignOrient.MaxAngularVelocity = 90
        alignOrient.Responsiveness = 10
        alignOrient.RigidityEnabled = false
        alignOrient.PrimaryAxisOnly = false
        alignOrient.Parent = hiddenPart
        orientConstraint.hiddenPart = hiddenPart
        orientConstraint.targetAttach = targetAttach
        orientConstraint.charAttach = charAttach
        orientConstraint.charAttachOwned = charAttachOwned
        orientConstraint.alignOrient = alignOrient
        orientConstraint.originalAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
    end
    local function updateOrientConstraint(root)
        local ao = orientConstraint.alignOrient
        if ao and ao.Parent and root then
            ao.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(- 1, 0, 0))
        end
    end
    local function engageAssists()
        lockMovement()
        local ok = pcall(setupOrientConstraint)
        if not ok then
            pcall(cleanupOrientConstraint)
            unlockMovement()
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function releaseAssists()
        unlockMovement()
        cleanupOrientConstraint()
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterRemoving,
    function()
        if AP.L then
            pcall(function()
                AP.stopL()
            end)
        end
        if AP.R then
            pcall(function()
                AP.stopR()
            end)
        end
        pcall(releaseAssists)
    end)
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function()
        destroySpeedActuator()
        if not(AP.L or AP.R) then
            pcall(releaseAssists)
        end
    end)
    local alConn, arConn = nil, nil
    local alPhase, arPhase = 1, 1
    AP.stopL = function()
        if alConn then
            alConn:Disconnect();
            alConn = nil
        end
        alPhase = 1
        AP.L = false
        haltMovement(getHRP(), getHum())
        clearAutoRouteMotion()
        destroySpeedActuator()
        if not AP.R then
            releaseAssists()
        end
        if AP.lRef and AP.lRef.SetVisual then
            AP.lRef.SetVisual(false)
        end
    end
    AP.stopR = function()
        if arConn then
            arConn:Disconnect();
            arConn = nil
        end
        arPhase = 1
        AP.R = false
        haltMovement(getHRP(), getHum())
        clearAutoRouteMotion()
        destroySpeedActuator()
        if not AP.L then
            releaseAssists()
        end
        if AP.rRef and AP.rRef.SetVisual then
            AP.rRef.SetVisual(false)
        end
    end
    AP.startL = function()
        if alConn then
            alConn:Disconnect()
        end
        alPhase = 1
        AP.L = true
        if pathIsAutoPlay() then
            engageAssists()
        else
            unlockMovement()
        end
        alConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not AP.L then
                return
            end
            local root, humanoid = getHRP(), getHum()
            if not root or not humanoid then
                return
            end
            if pathIsAutoPlay() then
                updateOrientConstraint(root)
            end
            if not pathIsAutoPlay() then
                if playerRequestingMove() then
                    AP.stopL()
                    return
                end
                local reached, hit = routeStep(alPhase == 1 and NORMAL_L1 or NORMAL_L2)
                if not reached then
                    return
                end
                if alPhase == 1 then
                    alPhase = 2
                    return
                end
                if hit then
                    hit.CFrame = CFrame.new(hit.Position)
                end
                tryAutoRouteSteal()
                AP.stopL()
                return
            end
            if alPhase == 1 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.L1)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    alPhase = 2
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, forwardSpeed(), dt)
            elseif alPhase == 2 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.LEND)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    alPhase = 0
                    haltMovement(root, humanoid)
                    task.delay(0.2,
                    function()
                        if AP.L then
                            alPhase = 3
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, forwardSpeed(), dt)
            elseif alPhase == 0 then
                return
            elseif alPhase == 3 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.L1)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    alPhase = 4
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, returnSpeed(), dt)
            elseif alPhase == 4 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.LFINAL)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    haltMovement(root, humanoid)
                    AP.stopL()
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, returnSpeed(), dt)
            end
        end))
    end
    AP.startR = function()
        if arConn then
            arConn:Disconnect()
        end
        arPhase = 1
        AP.R = true
        if pathIsAutoPlay() then
            engageAssists()
        else
            unlockMovement()
        end
        arConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not AP.R then
                return
            end
            local root, humanoid = getHRP(), getHum()
            if not root or not humanoid then
                return
            end
            if pathIsAutoPlay() then
                updateOrientConstraint(root)
            end
            if not pathIsAutoPlay() then
                if playerRequestingMove() then
                    AP.stopR()
                    return
                end
                local reached, hit = routeStep(arPhase == 1 and NORMAL_R1 or NORMAL_R2)
                if not reached then
                    return
                end
                if arPhase == 1 then
                    arPhase = 2
                    return
                end
                if hit then
                    hit.CFrame = CFrame.new(hit.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
                end
                tryAutoRouteSteal()
                AP.stopR()
                return
            end
            if arPhase == 1 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.R1)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    arPhase = 2
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, forwardSpeed(), dt)
            elseif arPhase == 2 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.REND)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    arPhase = 0
                    haltMovement(root, humanoid)
                    task.delay(0.2,
                    function()
                        if AP.R then
                            arPhase = 3
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, forwardSpeed(), dt)
            elseif arPhase == 0 then
                return
            elseif arPhase == 3 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.R1)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    arPhase = 4
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, returnSpeed(), dt)
            elseif arPhase == 4 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.RFINAL)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    haltMovement(root, humanoid)
                    AP.stopR()
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, returnSpeed(), dt)
            end
        end))
    end
    local function safeBlocked()
        if _G._RaVeSafeMode and _G._RaVeSafeMode.IsLocked then
            local ok, locked = pcall(_G._RaVeSafeMode.IsLocked)
            if ok and locked then
                pcall(_G._RaVeSafeMode.ForceStop)
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function setAutoLeft(on)
        if on and safeBlocked() then
            return
        end
        if on then
            if AP.R then
                AP.stopR()
            end
            AP.startL()
        else
            AP.stopL()
        end
    end
    local function setAutoRight(on)
        if on and safeBlocked() then
            return
        end
        if on then
            if AP.L then
                AP.stopL()
            end
            AP.startR()
        else
            AP.stopR()
        end
    end
    _G._VynxStartFullAutoLeft = function()
        setAutoLeft(true)
    end
    _G._VynxStopFullAutoLeft = function()
        setAutoLeft(false)
    end
    _G._VynxStartFullAutoRight = function()
        setAutoRight(true)
    end
    _G._VynxStopFullAutoRight = function()
        setAutoRight(false)
    end
    _G._VynxToggleAutoLeft = function()
        setAutoLeft(not AP.L)
    end
    _G._VynxToggleAutoRight = function()
        setAutoRight(not AP.R)
    end
    _G._AdaptSetAutoLeft = setAutoLeft
    _G._AdaptSetAutoRight = setAutoRight
    _G._VynxOnPathModeChanged = function()
        setAutoLeft(false)
        setAutoRight(false)
        pathIsAutoPlay()
    end
    hubConnect(UIS.InputBegan,
    function(input, gp)
        if gp then
            return
        end
        if not _isBindableInput(input) then
            return
        end
        if waitingForKey then
            return
        end
        local kc = input.KeyCode
        if Keybinds.AutoLeft and Keybinds.AutoLeft ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and kc == Keybinds.AutoLeft then
            setAutoLeft(not AP.L)
        elseif Keybinds.AutoRight and Keybinds.AutoRight ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and kc == Keybinds.AutoRight then
            setAutoRight(not AP.R)
        end
    end)
    _G._VioletteccAutoPathActive = function()
        return AP.L == true or AP.R == true
    end
    _G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            pcall(AP.stopL);
            pcall(AP.stopR)
            pcall(releaseAssists)
            destroySpeedActuator()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime and _G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local HIT_TIME = 2.6
    local MEDUSA_TIME = 4.5
    local lbl = nil
    local function accent()
        return _G._VioletteccAccent or _G._AdaptESPColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    local function buildTag(char)
        if not char then
            return
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if not head then
            return
        end
        local old = head:FindFirstChild("RaVeRagdollBB")
        if old then
            old:Destroy()
        end
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
        bb.Name = "RaVeRagdollBB"
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 44)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.4, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
        bb.LightInfluence = 0
        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        t.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        t.Text = ""
        t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        t.TextScaled = true
        t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        t.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", t)
        g.Name = "CDTint"
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent())
        lbl = t
    end
    if LP.Character then
        buildTag(LP.Character)
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function(char)
        task.wait(0.3)
        pcall(function()
            buildTag(char)
        end)
    end)
    _G._VioletteccRefreshRagdollCDColor = function()
        if lbl and lbl.Parent then
            local g = lbl:FindFirstChild("CDTint")
            if g then
                g.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent())
            end
        end
    end
    local function isMedusa(char)
        if not char then
            return false
        end
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Anchored and(part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or part.Transparency == 1) then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isDown(hum)
        if not hum then
            return false
        end
        local st = hum:GetState()
        return hum.PlatformStand or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    end
    local function hasRagdollMarker(char, hum)
        if isDown(hum) then
            return true
        end
        for _, holder in ipairs({
            char,
            hum
        }) do
            for _, name in ipairs({
                "Ragdoll",
                "Ragdolled",
                "IsRagdolled",
                "Stun",
                "Stunned"
            }) do
                local attr = holder:GetAttribute(name)
                if attr == true or(type(attr) == "number" and attr > 0) then
                    return true
                end
                local value = holder:FindFirstChild(name, true)
                if value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value then
                    return true
                end
                if value and(value:IsA("NumberValue") or value:IsA("IntValue")) and value.Value > 0 then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        local endTime = LP:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
        if endTime and(endTime - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > 0 then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local active, locked, wasTriggered = false, false, false
    local startedAt, endsAt, total, goUntil = 0, 0, HIT_TIME, 0
    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local char = LP.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        _G._RaVeRagdollCountdown = _G._VynxRagdollCountdown == true
        if _G._VynxRagdollCountdown ~= true then
            if lbl and lbl.Parent and lbl.Text ~= "" then
                lbl.Text = ""
            end
            active, locked, wasTriggered, goUntil = false, false, false, 0
            return
        end
        if not lbl or not lbl.Parent then
            if char then
                pcall(function()
                    buildTag(char)
                end)
            end
            return
        end
        if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then
            if active then
                active = false;
                lbl.Text = ""
            end
            return
        end
        local now = tick()
        local medusa = isMedusa(char)
        local triggered = hasRagdollMarker(char, hum) or medusa
        if triggered and not wasTriggered and not active and not locked then
            active = true
            total = medusa and MEDUSA_TIME or HIT_TIME
            startedAt = now
            endsAt = startedAt + total
            lbl.Text = string.format("%.1f", total)
        elseif active and medusa and total ~= MEDUSA_TIME then
            total = MEDUSA_TIME
            endsAt = startedAt + total
        end
        wasTriggered = triggered
        if not triggered and not active then
            locked = false
        end
        if active then
            local left = endsAt - now
            if left <= 0 then
                active = false
                locked = true
                lbl.Text = "GO"
                goUntil = now + 0.65
            else
                lbl.Text = string.format("%.1f", left)
            end
        elseif goUntil > 0 and now >= goUntil then
            lbl.Text = ""
            goUntil = 0
        end
    end))
    _G._RaVeRagdollTimer = {
        setTimes = function(hit,
        medusa)
            if type(hit) == "number" then
                HIT_TIME = hit
            end
            if type(medusa) == "number" then
                MEDUSA_TIME = medusa
            end
        end,
    }
    _G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            local char = LP.Character
            local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local bb = head and head:FindFirstChild("RaVeRagdollBB")
            if bb then
                pcall(function()
                    bb:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            lbl = nil
            _G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();
