                Volume = 0
            }):Play()
        end)
        task.delay(dur + 0.05,
        function()
            pcall(function()
                snd:Stop()
            end)
            pcall(function()
                snd:Destroy()
            end)
        end)
    end
    _G._VioletteccGetIntroSongAsset = function(name)
        local entry = _G._VioletteccIntroSongs[name]
        if not entry then
            return nil
        end
        if _G._VioletteccIntroSongCache[name] then
            return _G._VioletteccIntroSongCache[name]
        end
        local asset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(asset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local onDisk = false
        pcall(function()
            onDisk = type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(entry.file) and true or false
        end)
        if not onDisk then
            local ok, body = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(entry.url)
            end)
            if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" or # body == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            if not pcall(writefile, entry.file, body) then
                return nil
            end
        end
        local ok, id = pcall(asset, entry.file)
        if not ok or not id then
            return nil
        end
        _G._VioletteccIntroSongCache[name] = id
        return id
    end
    _G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong = function(name, preview)
        _G._VioletteccStopIntroSong()
        if name == nil then
            name = _G._VioletteccIntroSong
        end
        if name == "Off" then
            _G._VioletteccIntroSong = "Off";
            return
        end
        if not _G._VioletteccIntroSongs[name] then
            return
        end
        _G._VioletteccIntroSong = name
        local token = _G._VioletteccIntroSongToken
        task.spawn(function()
            local id = _G._VioletteccGetIntroSongAsset(name)
            if token ~= _G._VioletteccIntroSongToken or not id then
                return
            end
            local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
            snd.Name = preview and "VioletteIntroPreview" or "VioletteIntroMusic"
            snd.SoundId = id
            snd.Volume = INTRO_VOLUME
            snd.Looped = false
            snd.Parent = SoundService
            _G._VioletteccIntroSound = snd
            if not preview then
                snd.Ended:Connect(function()
                    if _G._VioletteccFinishIntro then
                        pcall(_G._VioletteccFinishIntro)
                    end
                end)
            end
            pcall(function()
                snd:Play()
            end)
        end)
    end
    _G._RaVeIntroSong = _G._VioletteccIntroSong
    _G._RaVeIntroSongOrder = _G._VioletteccIntroSongOrder
    _G._RaVeIntroSongs = _G._VioletteccIntroSongs
    _G._RaVePlayIntroSong = _G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong
    _G._RaVeStopIntroSong = _G._VioletteccStopIntroSong
    _G._RaVeGetIntroSongAsset = _G._VioletteccGetIntroSongAsset
end)();

    local function blockRemote()
        local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
        if not rrs then
            return nil
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "SetPlayerBlockList",
            "UpdatePlayerBlockList",
            "SetBlockList",
            "UpdateBlockList"
        }) do
            local r = rrs:FindFirstChild(name)
            if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return r
            end
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(rrs:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("RemoteEvent") and c.Name:find("Block") then
                return c
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function fireBlockList(payload)
        local r = blockRemote()
        if not r then
            return false
        end
        return pcall(function()
            r:FireServer(payload)
        end)
    end
    local SB_DEPTH = 90
    local SB_DELAY = 0.12
    local sbState = {
        running = false,
        thread = nil,
        bomb = nil
    }
    local function sbBuild(power, depth)
        local maintable = {}
        local spammed = {
            {}
        }
        local z = spammed[1]
        for _ = 1, depth do
            local t = {};
            table.insert(z, t);
            z = t
        end
        local maximum = math.floor((power or 100000) /(depth + 2))
        for _ = 1, maximum do
            table.insert(maintable, spammed)
        end
        return maintable
    end
    local function sbFire(bomb)
        local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
        local direct = rrs and rrs:FindFirstChild("SetPlayerBlockList")
        if direct then
            pcall(function()
                direct:FireServer(bomb)
            end)
        else
            fireBlockList(bomb)
        end
    end
    local function sbStop()
        if not sbState.running then
            return
        end
        sbState.running = false
        if sbState.thread then
            pcall(function()
                task.cancel(sbState.thread)
            end);
            sbState.thread = nil
        end
        sbState.bomb = nil
        pcall(function()
            NetworkClient:SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(0)
        end)
    end
    local function sbStart()
        if sbState.running then
            return
        end
        sbState.running = true
        pcall(function()
            NetworkClient:SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
        end)
        local power = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VioletteccSpeedBypass and _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass.power) or 100000, 10000, 150000)
        sbState.bomb = sbBuild(power, SB_DEPTH)
        sbState.thread = task.spawn(function()
            while sbState.running do
                if sbState.bomb then
                    sbFire(sbState.bomb)
                end
                task.wait(SB_DELAY)
            end
        end)
    end

    end

    local plState = {
        running = false,
        remote = nil
    }
    local plBrainrotMode, plLastBrainrot, plManualOverride = false, false, false
    local function plFindRemote()
        return blockRemote()
    end
    local function plPayload(power)
        local main = {}
        local nested = {
            {}
        }
        local current = nested[1]
        for _ = 1, 186 do
            local t = {};
            table.insert(current, t);
            current = t
        end
        local maxRep = math.min(math.floor((power or 100000) / 188), 10000)
        for _ = 1, maxRep do
            table.insert(main, nested)
        end
        return main
    end
    local function plLoop()
        local st = _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        local delay = tonumber(st and st.interval) or 0.125
        while plState.running do
            if not(plState.remote and plState.remote.Parent) then
                plState.remote = plFindRemote()
            end
            if not plState.remote then
                break
            end
            local ok = pcall(function()
                plState.remote:FireServer(plPayload(tonumber(st and st.speed) or 100000))
            end)
            if ok then
                delay = math.max(delay * 0.995, 0.05)
            else
                delay = math.min(delay * 1.5, 0.5)
            end
            task.wait(delay)
        end
        plState.running = false
    end
    local function plStart()
        if plState.running then
            return
        end
        plState.remote = plFindRemote()
        if not plState.remote then
            return false
        end
        plState.running = true
        task.spawn(plLoop)
        return true
    end
    local function plStop()
        plState.running = false
    end
    _G._VioletteccPingLaggerFlip = function(state, isManual)
        state = state == true
        local st = _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        if isManual then
            plManualOverride = plBrainrotMode and not state or false
        end
        st.enabled = state
        if state then
            if plStart() == false then
                st.enabled = false
            end
        else
            plStop()
        end
        if _G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh)
        end
    end

    local function pnlDrag(frame, handle, key)
        local held, from, start, ref
        pnlHomes[key] = {
            frame = frame,
            home = frame.Position
        }
        local saved = _G._VioletteccPanelPos and _G._VioletteccPanelPos[key]
        if type(saved) == "table" and # saved == 4 then
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(saved[1], saved[2], saved[3], saved[4])
        end
        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(p)
            local t = p.UserInputType
            if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                held, from, start, ref = true, p.Position, frame.Position, p
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(p)
            if not held then
                return
            end
            if p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or p == ref then
                local dl = p.Position - from
                frame.Position = UDim2.new(start.X.Scale, start.X.Offset + dl.X, start.Y.Scale, start.Y.Offset + dl.Y)
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(p)
            if held and(p == ref or p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                held, ref = false, nil
                local la = frame.Position
                _G._VioletteccPanelPos = _G._VioletteccPanelPos or {}
                _G._VioletteccPanelPos[key] = {
                    la.X.Scale,
                    la.X.Offset,
                    la.Y.Scale,
                    la.Y.Offset
                }
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

        table.insert(pnlRefresh,
        function()
            rowStroke.Color = C_LINE
        end)
        return row
    end
    local function addChip(row, chipW, text, editable)
        local chip
        if editable then
            chip = Instance.new("TextBox", row);
            chip.ClearTextOnFocus = false
        else
            chip = Instance.new("TextButton", row);
            chip.AutoButtonColor = false
        end
        chip.Name = "Chip";
        chip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
        chip.Position = UDim2.new(1, - 8, 0.5, 0)
        chip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(chipW, 22)
        chip.BackgroundColor3 = accent();
        chip.BorderSizePixel = 0
        chip.Text = text;
        chip.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        chip.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold;
        chip.TextSize = 11;
        chip.ZIndex = 63
        chip.TextScaled = true;
        chip.ClipsDescendants = true do
            local c = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", chip);
            c.MaxTextSize = 11;
            c.MinTextSize = 6
        end
        corner(chip, 7)
        table.insert(pnlRefresh,
        function()
            chip.BackgroundColor3 = accent()
        end)
        return chip
    end
    local function panelTag(st)
        if st == _G._VioletteccDuelLagger then
            return "panel:duelLagger"
        elseif st == _G._VioletteccPingLagger then
            return "panel:pingLagger"
        elseif st == _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass then
            return "panel:speedBypass"
        end
        return nil
    end
    local panelKeyDraws = {}
    local function bindKey(chip, state, onPress)
        local function draw()
            local kc = state.key and Enum.KeyCode[state.key]
            chip.Text = kc and _G._VioletteccKeyName(kc) or "None"
        end
        draw()
        panelKeyDraws[# panelKeyDraws + 1] = draw
        chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            chip.Text = "..."
            if _G._VioletteccBeginKeyCapture then
                _G._VioletteccBeginKeyCapture()
            end
            local conn;
            conn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, g)
                if not(i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or isGamepad(i)) then
                    return
                end
                local kc = i.KeyCode
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    draw();
                    if _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture then
                        _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                    end;
                    conn:Disconnect();
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                    state.key = nil;
                    draw()
                    if _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture then
                        _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                    end
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                    return
                end
                state.key = kc.Name
                if _G._AdaptKeybindSteal then
                    pcall(_G._AdaptKeybindSteal, kc, panelTag(state))
                end
                draw()
                if _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture then
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                end
                conn:Disconnect()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end)
        panelList[# panelList + 1] = {
            state = state,
            onPress = onPress
        }
        return draw
    end
    _G._VioletteccRefreshAllPanelKeys = function()
        for _, d in ipairs(panelKeyDraws) do
            pcall(d)
        end
    end
    do
        local st = _G._VioletteccDuelLagger
        local gui, body, card, setLit = newPanel("duelLagger", "Duel Lagger", - 270, 0,
        function()
            st.enabled = false
        end)
        local power, drawKey
        local function flip(force)
            local want = force
            if want == nil then
                want = not st.enabled
            end
            if want and not gui.Enabled then
                want = false
            end
            st.enabled = want
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
            pcall(_G._VioletteccDuelLaggerApply, st.enabled)
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end
        local modeRow = Instance.new("Frame", body)
        modeRow.Name = "Modes";
        modeRow.LayoutOrder = 1
        modeRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        modeRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        local ml = Instance.new("UIListLayout", modeRow)
        ml.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        ml.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        ml.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        ml.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
        local modeBtns = {}
        local function refreshModes()
            for _, m in ipairs(DL_MODES) do
                local b = modeBtns[m]
                if b then
                    local on =(m == st.mode)
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = on and accent() or C_KEY
                    b.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C_DIM
                end
            end
        end
        for i, m in ipairs(DL_MODES) do
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", modeRow)
            b.LayoutOrder = i
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, - 4, 1, 0)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = C_KEY;
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0;
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.Text = m;
            b.TextColor3 = C_DIM
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold;
            b.TextSize = 11;
            b.ZIndex = 62
            corner(b, 8);
            stroke(b, C_LINE, 1, 0.6)
            modeBtns[m] = b
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if st.mode ~= m then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = C_CTRL;
                    b.TextColor3 = C_TXT
                end
            end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if st.mode ~= m then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = C_KEY;
                    b.TextColor3 = C_DIM
                end
            end)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if st.mode == m then
                    return
                end
                st.mode = m
                refreshModes()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end
        table.insert(pnlRefresh, refreshModes)
        power = addPower(card, 1,
        function()
            flip()
        end, setLit)
        local keyRow = addRow(body, 3, "Keybind", 62)
        local keyChip = addChip(keyRow, 62, "None", false)
        drawKey = bindKey(keyChip, st,
        function()
            flip()
        end)
        power.Refresh = function()
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        end
        power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        refreshModes()
        _G._VioletteccShowDuelLagger = function(on)
            gui.Enabled = on == true
            if not gui.Enabled then
                flip(false)
            end
        end
        _G._VioletteccDuelLaggerRefresh = function()
            drawKey();
            refreshModes();
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        end
    end
    do
        local st = _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        local gui, body, card, setLit = newPanel("pingLagger", "Ping Lagger", 0, 0,
        function()
            st.enabled = false
        end)
        local power, drawKey
        local function flip(force)
            local want = force
            if want == nil then
                want = not st.enabled
            end
            if want and not gui.Enabled then
                want = false
            end
            pcall(_G._VioletteccPingLaggerFlip, want, true)
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end
        power = addPower(card, 1,
        function()
            flip()
        end, setLit)
        local powRow = addRow(body, 1, "Power", 72)
        local powChip = addChip(powRow, 72, tostring(st.speed), true)
        powChip.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            local n = tonumber(powChip.Text)
            if n then
                st.speed = math.clamp(math.floor(n), 1000, 500000)
            end
            powChip.Text = tostring(st.speed)
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end)
        local delRow = addRow(body, 2, "Delay", 72)
        local delChip = addChip(delRow, 72, tostring(st.interval), true)
        delChip.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            local n = tonumber(delChip.Text)
            if n then
                st.interval = math.clamp(n, 0.01, 1)
            end
            delChip.Text = tostring(st.interval)
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end)
        local autoRow = addRow(body, 3, "Auto Brainrot", 52)
        local autoChip = addChip(autoRow, 52, st.autoBrainrot and "ON" or "OFF", false)
        autoChip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            st.autoBrainrot = not st.autoBrainrot
            autoChip.Text = st.autoBrainrot and "ON" or "OFF"
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end)
        local keyRow = addRow(body, 4, "Keybind", 62)
        local keyChip = addChip(keyRow, 62, "None", false)
        drawKey = bindKey(keyChip, st,
        function()
            flip()
        end)
        power.Refresh = function()
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        end
        power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        _G._VioletteccShowPingLagger = function(on)
            gui.Enabled = on == true
            if not gui.Enabled then
                flip(false)
            end
        end
        _G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh = function()
            drawKey()
            powChip.Text = tostring(st.speed)
            delChip.Text = tostring(st.interval)
            autoChip.Text = st.autoBrainrot and "ON" or "OFF"
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        end
    end
    do
        local st = _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass
        local gui, body, card, setLit = newPanel("speedBypass", "Speed Bypass", 270, 0,
        function()
            st.enabled = false
        end)
        local power, drawKey
        local function flip(force)
            local want = force
            if want == nil then
                want = not st.enabled
            end
            if want and not gui.Enabled then
                want = false
            end
            st.enabled = want
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
            pcall(_G._VioletteccSpeedBypassApply, st.enabled)
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end
        power = addPower(card, 1,
        function()
            flip()
        end, setLit)
        local powRow = addRow(body, 1, "Power", 72)
        local powChip = addChip(powRow, 72, tostring(st.power), true)
        powChip.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            local n = tonumber(powChip.Text)
            st.power = n and math.clamp(math.floor(n), 10000, 150000) or 100000
            powChip.Text = tostring(st.power)
            if st.enabled then
                pcall(_G._VioletteccSpeedBypassApply, false)
                pcall(_G._VioletteccSpeedBypassApply, true)
            end
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end)
        local keyRow = addRow(body, 2, "Keybind", 62)
        local keyChip = addChip(keyRow, 62, "None", false)
        drawKey = bindKey(keyChip, st,
        function()
            flip()
        end)
        power.Refresh = function()
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        end
        power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        _G._VioletteccShowSpeedBypass = function(on)
            gui.Enabled = on == true
            flip(false)
        end
        _G._VioletteccSpeedBypassRefresh = function()
            drawKey();
            powChip.Text = tostring(st.power);
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccShowPanel = function(key, on)
        if on and _G._VioletteccIntroActive then
            _G._VioletteccPanelOpen[key] = true
            return
        end
        if key == "duelLagger" and _G._VioletteccShowDuelLagger then
            _G._VioletteccShowDuelLagger(on)
        elseif key == "pingLagger" and _G._VioletteccShowPingLagger then
            _G._VioletteccShowPingLagger(on)
        elseif key == "speedBypass" and _G._VioletteccShowSpeedBypass then
            _G._VioletteccShowSpeedBypass(on)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccRefreshPanels = function()
        for _, fn in ipairs(pnlRefresh) do
            pcall(fn)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccResetPanels = function()
        _G._VioletteccPanelPos = {}
        for _, nh in pairs(pnlHomes) do
            pcall(function()
                nh.frame.Position = nh.home
            end)
        end
        for _, key in ipairs({
            "duelLagger",
            "pingLagger",
            "speedBypass"
        }) do
            _G._VioletteccPanelOpen[key] = false
            pcall(_G._VioletteccShowPanel, key, false)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccRevealPanels = function()
        local queue = {
            {
                "duelLagger",
                _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.duelLagger == true
            },
            {
                "pingLagger",
                _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.pingLagger == true
            },
            {
                "speedBypass",
                _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.speedBypass == true
            },
        }
        local step = 0
        for _, q in ipairs(queue) do
            if q[2] then
                task.delay(step * 0.12,
                function()
                    pcall(_G._VioletteccShowPanel, q[1], true)
                end)
                step = step + 1
            else
                pcall(_G._VioletteccShowPanel, q[1], false)
            end
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshPanels then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshPanels)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns)
        end
    end
    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe then
            return
        end
        if _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive and _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive() then
            return
        end
        if not(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or isGamepad(input)) then
            return
        end
        local name = input.KeyCode.Name
        for _, p in ipairs(panelList) do
            if p.state.key and p.state.key == name then
                pcall(p.onPress)
            end
        end
    end)
    _G._VioletteccCollectPanels = function()
        local dl, sb, pl = _G._VioletteccDuelLagger, _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass, _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        return {
            open = {
                duelLagger = _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.duelLagger == true,
                pingLagger = _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.pingLagger == true,
                speedBypass = _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.speedBypass == true,
            },
            pos = _G._VioletteccPanelPos,
            keys = {
                duelLagger = dl.key,
                speedBypass = sb.key,
                pingLagger = pl.key
            },
            bypassPower = sb.power,
            pingSpeed = pl.speed,
            pingDelay = pl.interval,
            pingAuto = pl.autoBrainrot == true,
            duelMode = dl.mode,
            duelScale = dl.scale,
            duelMini = dl.minimized == true,
            duelLocked = dl.locked == true,
        }
    end
    _G._VioletteccRestorePanels = function(saved)
        if type(saved) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        if type(saved.pos) == "table" then
            _G._VioletteccPanelPos = saved.pos
            for key, nh in pairs(pnlHomes) do
                local p = saved.pos[key]
                if nh.frame and type(p) == "table" and # p == 4 then
                    nh.frame.Position = UDim2.new(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])
                end
            end
        end
        if type(saved.open) == "table" then
            for k, v in pairs(saved.open) do
                _G._VioletteccPanelOpen[k] = v == true
            end
        end
        local dl, sb, pl = _G._VioletteccDuelLagger, _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass, _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        if type(saved.keys) == "table" then
            dl.key, sb.key, pl.key = saved.keys.duelLagger, saved.keys.speedBypass, saved.keys.pingLagger
        end
        do
            local m = saved.duelMode
            if m == "LOW" or m == "MID" or m == "HIGH" or m == "ULTRA" then
                dl.mode = m
            end
            if tonumber(saved.duelScale) then
                dl.scale = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.duelScale), 0.7, 1.5)
            end
            dl.minimized = saved.duelMini == true
            dl.locked = saved.duelLocked == true
        end
        if tonumber(saved.bypassPower) then
            sb.power = math.clamp(math.floor(saved.bypassPower), 10000, 150000)
        end
        if tonumber(saved.pingSpeed) then
            pl.speed = math.clamp(math.floor(saved.pingSpeed), 1000, 500000)
        end
        if tonumber(saved.pingDelay) then
            pl.interval = math.clamp(saved.pingDelay, 0.01, 1)
        end
        pl.autoBrainrot = saved.pingAuto == true
        if _G._VioletteccDuelLaggerRefresh then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccDuelLaggerRefresh)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccSpeedBypassRefresh then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccSpeedBypassRefresh)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRevealPanels then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRevealPanels)
        end
    end
end)();

        local KAWATAN_SKIN_COLORS = {}
        local function applyKawatanSkinColor(character)
            local char = character or LP.Character
            local tint = KAWATAN_SKIN_COLORS[_G._KawatanSkinColor or "1"]
            if not char or not tint then
                return
            end
            for _, object in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local current = object
                    local belongsToSkin = false
                    while current and current ~= char do
                        if current:GetAttribute("_VlonESkin") then
                            belongsToSkin = true;
                            break
                        end
                        current = current.Parent
                    end
                    if belongsToSkin then
                        object.Color = tint
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local function isVlonEAccessoryAllowed(assetId)
            local id = tonumber(assetId)
            if not id then
                return false
            end
            local skin = getVlonESkin()
            for _, allowed in ipairs(skin.accessories or {}) do
                if id == allowed then
                    return true
                end
            end
            for _, allowed in ipairs(skin.clothing or {}) do
                if id == allowed then
                    return true
                end
            end
            for _, list in ipairs({
                skin.hats,
                skin.hair
            }) do
                for entry in tostring(list or ""):gmatch("%d+") do
                    if id == tonumber(entry) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function markVlonESkin(instance)
            pcall(function()
                instance:SetAttribute("_VlonESkin", true)
            end)
            return instance
        end
        local function clearVlonESkinObjects(character)
            if not character then
                return
            end
            for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:GetAttribute("_VlonESkin") then
                    pcall(function()
                        object:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        local function restoreVlonEBodyTransparency(character)
            if not character then
                return
            end
            for _, partName in ipairs({
                "UpperTorso",
                "LowerTorso",
                "LeftUpperArm",
                "LeftLowerArm",
                "LeftHand",
                "RightUpperArm",
                "RightLowerArm",
                "RightHand",
                "LeftUpperLeg",
                "LeftLowerLeg",
                "LeftFoot",
                "RightUpperLeg",
                "RightLowerLeg",
                "RightFoot",
            }) do
                local part = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.Transparency = 0
                    part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                end
            end
        end

            local packageActive = false
            local scaleToken = 0
            local function captureOriginal(character)
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not humanoid then
                    return
                end
                if not originalDescriptions[character] then
                    local ok, description = pcall(function()
                        return humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
                    end)
                    if ok and description then
                        originalDescriptions[character] = description:Clone()
                    end
                end
                if not originalScales[character] then
                    local scales = {}
                    for _, name in ipairs(SCALE_VALUES) do
                        local value = humanoid:FindFirstChild(name)
                        if value then
                            scales[name] = value.Value
                        end
                    end
                    originalScales[character] = scales
                end
            end
            _G._KawatanCaptureBody = captureOriginal
            local function getOriginalDescription(character)
                local saved = originalDescriptions[character]
                if saved then
                    return saved:Clone()
                end
                local ok, description = pcall(function()
                    return Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(LP.UserId)
                end)
                if ok and description then
                    return description
                end
                return nil
            end
            local function writeScales(character, scales)
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not humanoid or not scales then
                    return
                end
                for name, target in pairs(scales) do
                    local value = humanoid:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if value and value:IsA("NumberValue") and value.Value ~= target then
                        pcall(function()
                            value.Value = target
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            local function watchScales(character, scales)
                scaleToken = scaleToken + 1
                local token = scaleToken
                task.spawn(function()
                    while token == scaleToken and character.Parent do
                        writeScales(character, scales)
                        task.wait(0.5)
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function restoreScales(character)
                scaleToken = scaleToken + 1
                writeScales(character, originalScales[character])
            end
            local function resolvePackageParts(spec)
                local result = {}
                for property, id in pairs(spec.fallback or {}) do
                    result[property] = id
                end
                if not spec.bundle then
                    return result
                end
                local ok, details = pcall(function()
                    return game:GetService("AssetService"):GetBundleDetailsAsync(spec.bundle)
                end)
                if ok and type(details) == "table" then
                    local valid = {
                        Torso = true,
                        RightArm = true,
                        LeftArm = true,
                        LeftLeg = true,
                        RightLeg = true
                    }
                    for _, item in ipairs(details.Items or {}) do
                        local property = tostring(item.AssetType or ""):gsub("^Enum%.AvatarAssetType%.", "")
                        if valid[property] and item.Id then
                            result[property] = item.Id
                        end
                    end
                end
                return result
            end
            local SWAPPABLE = {
                {
                    "UpperTorso",
                    Enum.BodyPartR15.UpperTorso

                    "LowerTorso",

            local function buildRig(description)
                local ok, rig = pcall(function()
                    return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
                end)
                if not ok or not rig then
                    ok, rig = pcall(function()

                    end)

                if ok then

            local function reassertCosmetics(character)
                task.defer(function()
                    if _G._RaVeKorbloxMode ~= "Off" then
                        pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, _G._RaVeKorbloxMode)
                    end
                    local wantHeadless = _G._VlonEStandaloneHeadless == true
                    if vloneSkinEnabled then
                        wantHeadless = wantHeadless or getVlonESkin().headless ~= false
                    end
                    if wantHeadless and _G._KawatanSetHeadless then
                        pcall(_G._KawatanSetHeadless, character, true)
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function swapParts(character, humanoid, description)
                local rig = buildRig(description)
                if not rig then
                    return false
                end
                for _, entry in ipairs(SWAPPABLE) do
                    local source = rig:FindFirstChild(entry[1])
                    if source and source:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local replacement = source:Clone()
                        local replaced = false
                        pcall(function()
                            replaced = humanoid:ReplaceBodyPartR15(entry[2], replacement)
                        end)
                        if not replaced and replacement.Parent == nil then
                            replacement:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                end
                rig:Destroy()
                reassertCosmetics(character)
                return true
            end
            local function restorePackage(character, humanoid)
                if not packageActive then
                    return true
                end
                local description = getOriginalDescription(character)
                if not description then
                    return false
                end
                local ok = swapParts(character, humanoid, description)
                if ok then
                    packageActive = false
                end
                return ok
            end
            local function applyPackage(character, humanoid, spec)
                local description
                pcall(function()
                    description = humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
                end)
                if not description then
                    description = getOriginalDescription(character)
                end
                if not description then
                    return false
                end
                for property, id in pairs(resolvePackageParts(spec)) do
                    pcall(function()
                        description[property] = id
                    end)
                end
                local ok = swapParts(character, humanoid, description)
                if ok then
                    packageActive = true
                end
                return ok
            end
            setVlonEBodyType = function(mode)
                if mode ~= "OFF" and not BODY_TYPES[mode] then
                    mode = "OFF"
                end
                _G._VlonEBodyType = mode
                local character = LP.Character
                local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not humanoid then
                    return false
                end
                captureOriginal(character)
                if humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
                    return false
                end
                restoreScales(character)
                restorePackage(character, humanoid)
                if mode == "OFF" then
                    reassertCosmetics(character)
                    return true
                end
                local spec = BODY_TYPES[mode]
                local ok = true
                if spec.bundle then
                    ok = applyPackage(character, humanoid, spec)
                end
                if spec.scale then
                    writeScales(character, spec.scale)
                    watchScales(character, spec.scale)
                end
                return ok
            end

        local function attachVlonEAccessory(character, humanoid, accessory)
            if not accessory or not accessory:IsA("Accessory") then
                return false
            end
            markVlonESkin(accessory)
            pcall(function()
                humanoid:AddAccessory(accessory)
            end)
            if accessory.Parent ~= character then
                accessory.Parent = character
            end
            local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if not handle or not handle:IsA("BasePart") then
                return accessory.Parent == character
            end
            if handle:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld") then
                return true
            end
            local handleAttachment = handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment")
            if not handleAttachment then
                return accessory.Parent == character
            end
            local bodyAttachment
            for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("Attachment") and object.Name == handleAttachment.Name and not object:IsDescendantOf(accessory) then
                    bodyAttachment = object
                    break
                end
            end
            local bodyPart = bodyAttachment and bodyAttachment.Parent
            if bodyPart and bodyPart:IsA("BasePart") then
                handle.Anchored = false
                handle.CanCollide = false
                handle.CanTouch = false
                handle.CanQuery = false
                handle.Massless = true
                handle.CFrame = bodyPart.CFrame * bodyAttachment.CFrame * handleAttachment.CFrame:Inverse()
                local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                weld.Name = "VlonEAccessoryWeld"
                weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = bodyPart, handle, handle
            end
            return true
        end
        local function ensureVlonEHats(character, humanoid)
            local skin = getVlonESkin()
            local description = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
            description.HatAccessory = skin.hats or ""
            local rig
            local ok = pcall(function()
                rig = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
            end)
            if not ok or not rig then
                pcall(function()
                    rig = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
                end)
            end
            description:Destroy()
            if not rig then
                return false
            end
            local added = false
            for _, sourceAccessory in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
                if sourceAccessory:IsA("Accessory") then
                    local duplicate = character:FindFirstChild(sourceAccessory.Name)
                    if not duplicate then
                        local clone = sourceAccessory:Clone()
                        if attachVlonEAccessory(character, humanoid, clone) then
                            added = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            rig:Destroy()
            return added
        end
        local function addVlonEAssetToDescription(description, assetId)
            local ok, info = pcall(function()
                return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(assetId, Enum.InfoType.Asset)
            end)
            if not ok or not info then
                return false
            end
            local assetType = tonumber(info.AssetTypeId)
            if assetType == 11 then
                description.Shirt = assetId
                return true
            elseif assetType == 12 then
                description.Pants = assetId
                return true
            elseif assetType == 2 then
                description.GraphicTShirt = assetId
                return true
            end
            local property = vloneDescriptionPropertyByAssetType[assetType]
            if not property then
                return false
            end
            local current = ""
            pcall(function()
                current = tostring(description[property] or "")
            end)
            pcall(function()
                description[property] = current == "" and tostring(assetId) or(current .. "," .. tostring(assetId))
            end)
            return true
        end;
        (function()
            local function idInList(list, id)
                for entry in tostring(list or ""):gmatch("%d+") do
                    if tonumber(entry) == id then
                        return true
                    end
                end
                return false
            end
            local PREVIEW_CLEAR = {
                "HatAccessory",
                "HairAccessory",
                "FaceAccessory",
                "NeckAccessory",
                "ShouldersAccessory",
                "FrontAccessory",
                "BackAccessory",
                "WaistAccessory",
                "ShirtAccessory",
                "PantsAccessory",
                "JacketAccessory",
                "SweaterAccessory",
                "ShortsAccessory",
                "TShirtAccessory",
                "DressSkirtAccessory",
            }
            _G._KawatanBuildSetDescription = function(setName)
                local skin = VLONE_SKINS[setName]
                if not skin then
                    return nil
                end
                local base
                pcall(function()
                    local humanoid = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if humanoid then
                        base = humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
                    end
                end)
                if not base then
                    pcall(function()
                        base = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(LP.UserId)
                    end)
                end
                local description = base and base:Clone() or Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
                if not base then
                    local tone = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    for _, property in ipairs({
                        "HeadColor",
                        "TorsoColor",
                        "LeftArmColor",
                        "RightArmColor",
                        "LeftLegColor",
                        "RightLegColor"
                    }) do
                        pcall(function()
                            description[property] = tone
                        end)
                    end
                end
                for _, property in ipairs(PREVIEW_CLEAR) do
                    pcall(function()
                        description[property] = ""
                    end)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    description.Shirt = 0
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    description.Pants = 0
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    description.GraphicTShirt = 0
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    description.HatAccessory = skin.hats or ""
                    description.HairAccessory = skin.hair or ""
                end)
                for _, assetId in ipairs(skin.accessories or {}) do
                    if not idInList(skin.hats, assetId) and not idInList(skin.hair, assetId) then
                        pcall(addVlonEAssetToDescription, description, assetId)
                    end
                end
                for _, assetId in ipairs(skin.clothing or {}) do
                    pcall(addVlonEAssetToDescription, description, assetId)
                end
                return description
            end
        end)()
        local function addVlonEAsset(character, humanoid, assetId)
            for _, existing in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if existing:IsA("Accessory") then
                    local sameAsset = false
                    pcall(function()
                        sameAsset = tonumber(existing.SourceAssetId) == tonumber(assetId)
                    end)
                    if sameAsset then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
            end)
            if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" or # objects == 0 then
                local loaded
                local insertOk = pcall(function()
                    loaded = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(assetId)
                end)
                if insertOk and loaded then
                    objects = {
                        loaded
                    }
                else
                    return false
                end
            end
            local added = false
            for _, rootObject in ipairs(objects) do
                local candidates = {}
                if rootObject:IsA("Accessory") or rootObject:IsA("Shirt") or rootObject:IsA("Pants") or rootObject:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
                    table.insert(candidates, rootObject)
                else
                    for _, child in ipairs(rootObject:GetDescendants()) do
                        if child:IsA("Accessory") or child:IsA("Shirt") or child:IsA("Pants") or child:IsA("ShirtGraphic") then
                            table.insert(candidates, child)
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
                    local clone = markVlonESkin(candidate:Clone())
                    if clone:IsA("Accessory") then
                        attachVlonEAccessory(character, humanoid, clone)
                    else
                        for _, existing in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                            if existing.ClassName == clone.ClassName then
                                existing:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                        clone.Parent = character
                    end
                    added = true
                end
                pcall(function()
                    rootObject:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            return added
        end
        local function addVlonEBodyPart(character, property, assetId)
            local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                return game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(assetId))
            end)
            if not ok or not objects or not objects[1] then
                return false
            end
            local source = objects[1]
            local container = markVlonESkin(Instance.new("Folder"))
            container.Name = "VlonEBody_" .. property
            container.Parent = character
            local matched = false
            local sourceParts = source:IsA("BasePart") and {
                source
            } or source:GetDescendants()
            for _, part in ipairs(sourceParts) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local target = character:FindFirstChild(part.Name)
                    if target and target:IsA("BasePart") and target.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        target.Transparency = 1
                        local clone = markVlonESkin(part:Clone())
                        clone.Anchored = false;
                        clone.CanCollide = false;
                        clone.CanTouch = false
                        clone.CanQuery = false;
                        clone.Massless = true;
                        clone.CFrame = target.CFrame
                        for _, joint in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
                            if joint:IsA("JointInstance") or joint:IsA("Constraint") then
                                joint:Destroy()
                            end
                        end
                        clone.Parent = container
                        local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                        weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = target, clone, clone
                        matched = true
                    end
                end
            end
            pcall(function()
                source:Destroy()
            end)
            if not matched then
                container:Destroy()
            end
            return matched
        end
        local function setVlonEHeadless(character, enabled)
            local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not head then
                return
            end
            local transparency = enabled and 1 or 0
            head.Transparency = transparency
            head.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency
            for _, object in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
                if object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") or object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.Transparency = transparency
                    if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                        object.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        _G._KawatanSetHeadless = setVlonEHeadless
        local function applyVlonESkin(character)
            local char = character or LP.Character
            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not humanoid then
                return false
            end
            vloneSkinToken = vloneSkinToken + 1
            local token = vloneSkinToken
            restoreVlonEBodyTransparency(char)
            clearVlonESkinObjects(char)
            local original
            pcall(function()
                original = humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
            end)
            if original and not vloneOriginalDescriptions[char] then
                vloneOriginalDescriptions[char] = original:Clone()
            end
            for _, object in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if object:IsA("Accessory") or object:IsA("Accoutrement") then
                    pcall(function()
                        object:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
            if vloneAccessoryWatchers[char] then
                vloneAccessoryWatchers[char]:Disconnect()
            end
            vloneAccessoryWatchers[char] = char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(object)
                if not vloneSkinEnabled or not(object:IsA("Accessory") or object:IsA("Accoutrement")) then
                    return
                end
                task.defer(function()
                    if not object.Parent or object:GetAttribute("_VlonESkin") then
                        return
                    end
                    local sourceId = 0
                    pcall(function()
                        sourceId = tonumber(object.SourceAssetId) or 0
                    end)
                    if not isVlonEAccessoryAllowed(sourceId) then
                        pcall(function()
                            object:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                end)
            end)
            local appliedDescription
            if original then
                local skinDescription = original:Clone()
                for _, property in ipairs({
                    "HatAccessory",
                    "HairAccessory",
                    "FaceAccessory",
                    "NeckAccessory",
                    "ShouldersAccessory",
                    "FrontAccessory",
                    "BackAccessory",
                    "WaistAccessory",
                    "ShirtAccessory",
                    "PantsAccessory",
                    "JacketAccessory",
                    "SweaterAccessory",
                    "ShortsAccessory",
                    "TShirtAccessory",
                    "DressSkirtAccessory",
                }) do
                    pcall(function()
                        skinDescription[property] = ""
                    end)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    skinDescription.Shirt = 0
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    skinDescription.Pants = 0
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    skinDescription.GraphicTShirt = 0
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    skinDescription.HatAccessory = getVlonESkin().hats or ""
                    skinDescription.HairAccessory = getVlonESkin().hair or ""
                end)
                for _, assetId in ipairs(getVlonESkin().clothing) do
                    pcall(addVlonEAssetToDescription, skinDescription, assetId)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    humanoid:ApplyDescription(skinDescription)
                end)
            end
            task.wait()
            if not vloneSkinEnabled or token ~= vloneSkinToken or not char.Parent then
                return false
            end
            pcall(function()
                appliedDescription = humanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
            end)
            for _, assetId in ipairs(getVlonESkin().accessories) do
                addVlonEAsset(char, humanoid, assetId)
            end
            pcall(ensureVlonEHats, char, humanoid)
            for _, assetId in ipairs(getVlonESkin().clothing) do
                addVlonEAsset(char, humanoid, assetId)
            end
            applyKawatanSkinColor(char)
            task.delay(0.35,
            function()
                if char.Parent then
                    applyKawatanSkinColor(char)
                end
            end)
            setVlonEHeadless(char, getVlonESkin().headless ~= false or _G._VlonEStandaloneHeadless == true)
            local korbloxLegs = getVlonESkin().korblox or "Right"
            if _G._KawatanKorbloxUserSet then
                korbloxLegs = _G._RaVeKorbloxMode or korbloxLegs
            end
            _G._RaVeKorbloxMode = korbloxLegs
            pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, korbloxLegs)
            if _G._VlonEBodyType ~= "OFF" then
                task.defer(setVlonEBodyType, _G._VlonEBodyType)
            end
            return true
        end
        local function clearVlonESkin(character)
            vloneSkinToken = vloneSkinToken + 1
            local char = character or LP.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            if vloneAccessoryWatchers[char] then
                vloneAccessoryWatchers[char]:Disconnect()
                vloneAccessoryWatchers[char] = nil
            end
            clearVlonESkinObjects(char)
            restoreVlonEBodyTransparency(char)
            pcall(_G._RaVeClearKorblox)
            _G._RaVeKorbloxMode = vlonePreviousKorbloxMode or "Off"
            local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local original = vloneOriginalDescriptions[char]
            if humanoid and original then
                local restored = pcall(function()
                    humanoid:ApplyDescriptionClientServer(original:Clone())
                end)
                if not restored then
                    restored = pcall(function()
                        humanoid:ApplyDescriptionReset(original:Clone())
                    end)
                end
                if not restored then
                    pcall(function()
                        humanoid:ApplyDescription(original:Clone())
                    end)
                end
            end
            local keepHeadless = _G._VlonEStandaloneHeadless == true
            setVlonEHeadless(char, keepHeadless)
            if keepHeadless then
                task.delay(0.25,
                function()
                    setVlonEHeadless(char, true)
                end)
            end
            if _G._RaVeKorbloxMode ~= "Off" then
                task.delay(0.2,
                function()
                    pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, _G._RaVeKorbloxMode)
                end)
            end
        end
        setVlonESkinEnabled = function(on)
            if on and not vloneSkinEnabled then
                vlonePreviousKorbloxMode = _G._RaVeKorbloxMode or "Off"
            end
            vloneSkinEnabled = on and true or false
            if vloneSkinEnabled then
                task.spawn(applyVlonESkin, LP.Character)
            else
                clearVlonESkin(LP.Character)
            end
        end
        hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
        function(character)
            if not vloneSkinEnabled then
                return
            end
            character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 3)
            if vloneSkinEnabled then
                task.spawn(applyVlonESkin, character)
            end
        end)
    end
    _G._VioletteccSetCustomSkin = function(on)
        return setVlonESkinEnabled(on)
    end
    _G._VioletteccSetBodyType = function(mode)
        return setVlonEBodyType(mode)
    end
    if _G._VynxCustomSkin == true then
        task.defer(function()
            if _G._VioletteccSetCustomSkin then
                pcall(_G._VioletteccSetCustomSkin, true)
            end
        end)
    else
        task.defer(function()
            if _G._VioletteccSetCustomSkin then
                pcall(_G._VioletteccSetCustomSkin, false)
            end
        end)
    end
    _G._VioletteccCosmeticsRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccCosmeticsRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();

        local function dressPreview(rig, skin)
            rig.PrimaryPart = rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or rig.PrimaryPart
            for _, object in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.CanCollide = false
                    object.CastShadow = false
                elseif object:IsA("Script") or object:IsA("LocalScript") then
                    object:Destroy()
                end
            end
            if skin.headless ~= false then
                local rigHead = rig:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if rigHead then
                    rigHead.Transparency = 1
                    for _, object in ipairs(rigHead:GetChildren()) do
                        if object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") then
                            object.Transparency = 1
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local mode = skin.korblox or "Off"
            for _, entry in ipairs({
                {
                    "Left",
                    "Left Leg"
                },
                {
                    "Right",
                    "Right Leg"
                }
            }) do
                if mode == "Both" or mode == entry[1] then
                    local config = _G._RaVeKorbloxAssets and _G._RaVeKorbloxAssets[entry[2]]
                    local target = config and rig:FindFirstChild(config.targetBodyPart)
                    if target then
                        for _, partName in ipairs(config.partsToHide) do
                            local limb = rig:FindFirstChild(partName)
                            if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
                                limb.Transparency = 1
                            end
                        end
                        local ok, objects = pcall(function()
                            return game:GetObjects(config.id)
                        end)
                        local source = ok and objects and objects[1]
                        local mesh = source and(source:IsA("BasePart") and source or source:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))
                        if mesh then
                            mesh.CanCollide = false
                            mesh.CastShadow = false
                            mesh.CFrame = target.CFrame *(config.offset or CFrame.new())
                            local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
                            weld.Part0, weld.Part1, weld.Parent = target, mesh, mesh
                            mesh.Parent = rig
                        end
                        if source and source ~= mesh and source.Parent ~= rig then
                            pcall(function()
                                source:Destroy()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local function seatStrays(rig)
            local root = rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then
                return
            end
            for _, accessory in ipairs(rig:GetChildren()) do
                if accessory:IsA("Accessory") then
                    pcall(function()
                        local handle = accessory:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                        if not(handle and handle:IsA("BasePart")) then
                            return
                        end
                        if (handle.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= 8 then
                            return
                        end
                        local handleAttachment = handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment")
                        local bodyAttachment
                        if handleAttachment then
                            for _, object in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
                                if object:IsA("Attachment") and object.Name == handleAttachment.Name and not object:IsDescendantOf(accessory) then
                                    bodyAttachment = object
                                    break
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        local bodyPart = bodyAttachment and bodyAttachment.Parent
                        if bodyPart and bodyPart:IsA("BasePart") then
                            handle.CFrame = bodyPart.CFrame * bodyAttachment.CFrame * handleAttachment.CFrame:Inverse()
                        else
                            local rigHead = rig:FindFirstChild("Head")
                            if rigHead then
                                handle.CFrame = rigHead.CFrame
                            end
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
        local function loadCard(setName, card)
            task.spawn(function()

                    end)

                    if rig then
                        pcall(function()
                            rig:Destroy()
                        end)
                    end
                    card.loading.Text = "N/A"
                    return
                end
                pcall(dressPreview, rig, _G._KawatanSkinSets[setName])
                rig.Parent = card.world
                task.wait()
                pcall(seatStrays, rig)
                for _, object in ipairs(rig:GetDescendants()) do
                    if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                        object.Anchored = true
                    end
                end
                pcall(function()
                    rig:PivotTo(CFrame.new())
                end)
                card.shot.rig = rig
                card.loading.Visible = false
            end)
        end

            shots[# shots + 1] = shot
            card.Activated:Connect(function()
                selectSet(setName)
            end)
            card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                shot.target = shot.distance * HOVER_ZOOM
                if _G._KawatanSkinColor ~= setName then
                    tw(cardStroke, Q, {
                        Color = CAT_EDGE_H,
                        Transparency = 0
                    })
                    tw(label, Q, {
                        TextColor3 = CAT_TEXT
                    })
                end
            end)
            card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                shot.target = shot.distance
                if refreshCards then
                    refreshCards()
                end
            end)
            cards[setName] = {
                card = card,
                stroke = cardStroke,
                viewport = viewport,
                world = world,
                camera = camera,
                label = label,
                loading = loading,
                shot = shot
            }
        end
        refreshCards = function()
            local live = accent()
            panelEdge.Color = live
            subtitle.TextColor3 = live
            for setName, entry in pairs(cards) do
                local on = setName == _G._KawatanSkinColor
                tw(entry.stroke, Q, {
                    Color = on and live or CAT_EDGE,
                    Thickness = on and 2 or 1,
                    Transparency = 0,
                })
                tw(entry.label, Q, {
                    TextColor3 = on and CAT_TEXT or CAT_DIM
                })
            end
        end
        refreshCards()
        _G._KawatanRefreshGalleryCards = refreshCards
        local elapsed = 0
        hubConnect(RunService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not catalogOpen then
                return
            end
            elapsed = elapsed + dt
            local ease = math.min(dt * DOLLY_RESPONSE, 1)
            for _, shot in ipairs(shots) do
                if shot.rig and shot.rig.Parent then
                    local breath = math.cos(elapsed * 3 + shot.phase) * 0.035
                    pcall(function()
                        shot.rig:PivotTo(CFrame.new(0, breath, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.pi + elapsed * SPIN_SPEED + shot.phase, 0))
                    end)
                end
                if shot.camera.Parent then
                    shot.current = shot.current +(shot.target - shot.current) * ease
                    shot.camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, CAM_HEIGHT, shot.current), Vector3.new(0, CAM_HEIGHT, 0))
                end
            end
        end))
        local function closeCatalog()
            catalogOpen = false
            tw(backdrop, Q, {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
            })
            tw(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.14, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
                Scale = 0.9
            })
            task.delay(0.16,
            function()
                if not catalogOpen then
                    backdrop.Visible = false
                end
            end)
        end
        _G._KawatanOpenSkinGallery = function()
            catalogOpen = true
            refreshCards()
            for _, shot in ipairs(shots) do
                shot.target = shot.distance
            end
            backdrop.Visible = true
            backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            panelScale.Scale = 0.9
            tw(backdrop, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.42
            })
            tw(panelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Scale = 1
            })
            if built then
                return
            end
            built = true
            task.spawn(function()
                for _, setName in ipairs(_G._KawatanSkinSetOrder or {}) do
                    local entry = cards[setName]
                    if entry then
                        loadCard(setName, entry)
                    end
                    task.wait(0.12)
                end
            end)
        end
        _G._KawatanCloseSkinGallery = closeCatalog
        closeBtn.Activated:Connect(closeCatalog)
        backdrop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if panelDragging or(os.clock() - panelDragEndedAt) < 0.25 then
                return
            end
            closeCatalog()
        end) do
            local startInput, startPosition, dragInput
            head.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    return
                end
                panelDragging, startInput, startPosition, dragInput = true, input.Position, panel.Position, input
            end)
            head.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragInput = input
                end
            end)
            hubConnect(UIS.InputChanged,
            function(input)
                if not panelDragging then
                    return
                end
                if input ~= dragInput and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
                    return
                end
                local delta = input.Position - startInput
                panel.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end)
            hubConnect(UIS.InputEnded,
            function(input)
                if not panelDragging then
                    return
                end
                if input == dragInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    panelDragging, dragInput = false, nil
                    panelDragEndedAt = os.clock()
                end
            end)
        end
    end)()
    _G._VioletteccSkinGalleryRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccSkinGalleryRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)()
task.spawn(function()
    local introPlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local oldIntro = introPlayerGui:FindFirstChild("LordHubIntro")
    if oldIntro then
        oldIntro:Destroy()
    end
    local introGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

    local aspect = Instance.new("UIAspectRatioConstraint")

    local sizeConstraint = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint")

    sizeConstraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(280, 280)
    sizeConstraint.Parent = chainStage
    local rotorData = {

        },
        {
            rot = - 1098.419,
            trans = 0.985
        },
        {
            rot = - 1098.794,
            trans = 0.982
        },
        {
            rot = - 1099.128,
            trans = 0.978
        },
        {
            rot = - 1099.421,
            trans = 0.973
        },
    }
    local rotors = {}
    for i, data in ipairs(rotorData) do
        local rotor = Instance.new("Frame")
        rotor.Name = "ChainSpearRotor" .. i
        rotor.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        rotor.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        rotor.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        rotor.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        rotor.Rotation = data.rot
        rotor.Parent = chainStage
        local trail = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
        trail.Name = "ChainSpearTrail" .. i
        trail.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.73, 0.02)
        trail.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        trail.Size = UDim2.new(0.553, 0, 0.829, 0)
        trail.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        trail.Image = "rbxassetid://118963313877514"
        trail.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(205, 215, 235)
        trail.ImageTransparency = data.trans
        trail.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit
        trail.Parent = rotor
        rotors[i] = rotor
    end
    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Name = "LordHubIntroTitle"
    title.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

    title.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.15
    title.TextSize = 30

    title.ZIndex = 3

    local tapLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    tapLabel.Name = "TapAnywhereToSkip"
    tapLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    tapLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.50, 37)
    tapLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 18)
    tapLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    tapLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210)
    tapLabel.TextTransparency = 0.15

    tapLabel.Parent = intro
    local tapCatcher = Instance.new("TextButton")
    tapCatcher.Name = "TapCatcher"
    tapCatcher.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    tapCatcher.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    tapCatcher.Text = ""
    tapCatcher.AutoButtonColor = false
    tapCatcher.ZIndex = 10
    tapCatcher.Parent = intro
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local finished = false
    local connections = {}
    local function finishIntro()
        if finished then
            return
        end
        finished = true
        if _G._VioletteccFinishIntro then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccFinishIntro)
        end
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            pcall(function()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(intro, fadeInfo, {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
            }):Play()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(title, fadeInfo, {
                TextTransparency = 1,
                TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            }):Play()
        end)
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(tapLabel, fadeInfo, {
                TextTransparency = 1
            }):Play()
        end)
        for _, rotor in ipairs(rotors) do
            local trail = rotor:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel")
            if trail then
                pcall(function()
                    TweenService:Create(trail, fadeInfo, {
                        ImageTransparency = 1
                    }):Play()
                end)
            end
        end
        task.delay(0.35,
        function()
            if introGui and introGui.Parent then
                introGui:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end
    table.insert(connections, tapCatcher.Activated:Connect(finishIntro))
    table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if finished then
            return
        end
        local kind = input.UserInputType
        if kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or kind == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            finishIntro()
        end
    end))
    if _G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong, _G._VioletteccIntroSong or "Song 1", false)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        local deadline = os.clock() + 15
        local sound
        repeat
            sound = _G._VioletteccIntroSound
            if sound and sound.Parent then
                break
            end
            task.wait(0.1)
        until finished or os.clock() >= deadline
        if sound and sound.Parent and not finished then
            sound.Ended:Wait()
            if not finished then
                finishIntro()
            end
        end
    end)
    for i, rotor in ipairs(rotors) do
        local trail = rotor:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel")
        if trail then
            task.delay((i - 1) * 0.035,
            function()
                if finished or not trail.Parent then
                    return
                end
                TweenService:Create(trail, TweenInfo.new(0.45), {
                    ImageTransparency = 0.12
                }):Play()
            end)
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            local speed = 0.38 +(i * 0.045)
            while not finished and rotor.Parent do
                rotor.Rotation = rotor.Rotation + speed
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end)
    end
end)
